b98855627fb7b3bffe8c.description:
Fully remote (never coming onsite)  
  

Representative I - Pharmacy Advisor
  
  
Position Summary
  
The role of Pharmacy Advisor Rep I on the Pharmacy Advisor team, a specially developed, clinical program for the client is to provide support to members and/or prescribers, and Pharmacists assisting members and/or prescribers, regarding the disease state(s) supported by the program. Through the use of sophisticated modeling and systems, we are able to identify members who meet the desired counseling opportunity criteria. Representatives will be making outbound calls to patients (and fielding return inbound calls) in which the Pharmacy Advisor Rep I will assist patients in refilling medications. Rep I may also, as necessary, transfer a member with clinical questions to a consulting Pharmacist. In addition, the Pharmacy Advisor Rep I will be responsible for educating the member on the value and purpose of the program, client-related messages as well as identifying ways to help with medication ordering process and medication cost savings opportunities. Besides assisting with inbound and outbound calls, the Pharmacy Advisor Rep I will also support requests received via fax with the potential, based on business needs, of cross-training to support other clinical services.
  
  
In addition to working very closely with members, prescribers, and Pharmacy Advisor Pharmacists, the Pharmacy Advisor Rep I will also be required to work very closely with key client departments needed to properly support this program. This would include departments such as mail order filling facilities, Fast Start, Diabetic Meter Exchanges, Clinical Care Services, etc.
  
  
About Pharmacy Advisor:
  
Pharmacy Advisor is a specially developed, clinical program for the client. It provides a significant opportunity for all involved to be a part of an exciting, clinical program for the client. The Pharmacy Advisor operations team will have a direct impact on the health and outcomes for patients with chronic disease states. Pharmacists and Reps will receive messaging at critical points in care, use enhanced computer systems and leverage behavior modification/interviewing techniques that can be instrumental in driving optimal health outcomes and to provide personalized support to our targeted members
  
  
Requirements
  
High School Diploma/GED
  
Minimum 1 year customer service or call center experience
  
Healthcare, PBM, insurance, or medical terminology experience preferred
  
Proficiency with Microsoft Office
  
  
Experience
  
Minimum of 1 year in a customer service or call center environment (call center type environments preferred, if doctors office then anything below managing 75 calls/day would not translate to similar environment).
  
Must have effective and empathetic communication style in managing inbound calls and communications with clients and team members.
  
Computer experience is required with proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.
  
Basic alpha number data entry skills with attention to accuracy and quality is essential.
  
Intermediate math skills are required with attention to detail and quality essential.
  
Experience in a health care setting or insurance industry is a plus, including knowledge of basic insurance and third party terms and medical terminology.
  
Ability to work with people in a team environment while meeting individual performance goals.
  
Must be able to read and interpret policies, procedures and instructions.
  
Effective organizational skills and ability to prioritize a fluctuating workload and competing priorities is essential.
  
  
Education
  
High School diploma or GED
  
  
Notes:
  
Fully remote (never coming onsite)
  
Schedule:
  
Monday-Friday
  
8-hour shift within operating hours of 8:00 AM - 8:00 PM CT
  
Training: 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM CT

3e9bca5fe9218294b986.title: Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator
3e9bca5fe9218294b986.description:
Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator

\*\*Residential Window Cleaning | Remote \*\*

About the Role

Mauka Cleaning Co. is a residential window cleaning and exterior cleaning company serving homeowners on Oahu.

We are looking for a reliable, organized, phone-savvy \*\*Customer Experience & Sales Coordinator\*\* to manage the customer journey from first contact through booking, follow-up, service coordination, and reactivation.

This is not a passive data-entry position. Your work will directly impact our booked revenue, schedule utilization, customer satisfaction, and company growth.

You must be available to work \*\*9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Monday through Friday, Hawaii-Aleutian Standard Time.\*\*

Your mission is simple:

\*\*Keep the schedule full, customers informed, technicians supported, and the back office organized.\*\*

---

Key Responsibilities:

1. Inbound Sales, Reactivations and Lead Follow-Up

- Respond quickly to new leads by phone, text, and email.

- Qualify leads and provide basic estimates using company pricing tools and guidelines.

- Move leads through each stage of the sales pipeline.

- Follow up with open estimates and unbooked leads using approved follow-up sequences.

- Reactivate past customers and older leads using approved campaigns and offers.

- Contact flexible customers to fill schedule gaps and pull jobs forward.

- Identify appropriate add-on services and recurring maintenance opportunities.

- Maintain accurate CRM notes and next steps for every lead and customer.

- Ask for the sale confidently and professionally.

-Use Housecall Pro and Slack on the daily

2. Customer Experience and Service Coordination

- Answer customer questions about services, pricing, availability, and scheduling.

- Send booking confirmations, reminders, and service updates.

- Handle reschedules and cancellations professionally.

- Backfill canceled openings using the active sales pipeline.

- Support technicians with access instructions, customer notes, and schedule changes.

- Handle customer complaints calmly and document each issue accurately.

- Coordinate approved touch-ups, go-backs, refunds, and service resolutions.

- Follow up with satisfied customers and request Google reviews.

- Protect the customer experience from booking through completed service.

3. Administrative Operations

- Send internal updates and reminders to the field team.

- Record special instructions, access information, and job notes.

- Track technician bonuses and commissions based on completed jobs and upsells.

- Plan and document yard sign routes for technicians.

- Process approved refunds and document them correctly.

- Set up and track customer payment plans when approved.

- Monitor overdue invoices and conduct polite follow-up calls and messages.

- Keep calendars, customer records, and internal systems accurate and current.

---

\*Success Metrics\*

Your performance will be measured by:

- Speed to lead

- Estimate-to-sale conversion rate

- Reactivation calls and bookings

- Booked revenue and gross profit

- Schedule utilization

- Customer response time

- Cancellation recovery rate

- Review requests and customer satisfaction

- Accuracy of CRM notes and administrative records

We care about results, not just activity.

---

Requirements:

- Strong spoken and written English.

- A natural, confident, and professional phone presence.

- Comfortable making and receiving a high volume of calls and messages. \*\*If the phone ringing makes you want to hide under your desk, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

- Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple customers, leads, jobs, and follow-ups without dropping the ball.

- Able to follow scripts, checklists, and documented processes consistently.

- Comfortable asking for the sale and requesting customer reviews.

- Comfortable using email, calendars, spreadsheets, and online communication tools.

- Reliable, self-motivated, and able to work independently without constant supervision.

- Able to work from a quiet, professional environment with no loud background noises, interruptions, or distractions during working hours.

- Must have a reliable, high-speed internet connection capable of supporting phone calls, video meetings, CRM software, and multiple online systems.

- Reliable availability

- Must have a reliable laptop to use on the daily along with a headset/mic to take calls on

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with residential window cleaning or exterior cleaning.

- Experience with customer reactivation or estimate follow-up.

- Experience coordinating field technicians.

- Experience requesting online reviews.

- Experience handling payment follow-up or basic accounts receivable.

---

Who This Role Isn’t For

This role is \*\*not\*\* a good fit if you:

- Dislike talking on the phone or avoid making outbound calls.

- Need constant supervision to stay productive.

- Struggle to stay organized when managing multiple customers, leads, and tasks.

- Prefer doing things your own way instead of following proven scripts and processes.

- Get discouraged by follow-up, rejection, or customers who need multiple touchpoints before booking.

- Are uncomfortable asking for the sale or requesting customer reviews.

- Frequently miss deadlines, forget follow-ups, or leave CRM notes incomplete.

- Are only looking for a quiet data-entry position. This is a customer-facing, revenue-producing role.

- Have frequent background noise, interruptions, or an unreliable internet connection.

- Cannot reliably work the required schedule.

\*\*If your ideal workday involves avoiding the phone, hiding from follow-up, and hoping the schedule fills itself, this probably is not the role for you.\*\*

---

Compensation

-Base pay starting at $16/hr, with growth opportunities.

- Performance bonuses tied to:

- Revenue sold and collected

- Completed upsells

- Service plans sold

- Reactivated customers

- Other agreed-upon performance targets

You will receive training on our systems, scripts, pricing guidelines, and processes.

The right person can grow into a \*Customer Experience & Sales Manager\* by proving they can independently own the customer journey and consistently produce results.

If you are organized, competitive, dependable, and enjoy helping customers while closing business, we want to hear from you.

Pay: From $16.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

fec21c08f494f1efc485.description:
**About Apex Skin:**

We are Apex Skin, and our mission is to provide the highest quality dermatology and dermatologic surgery care to patients across Northeast Ohio with promptness, compassion, and excellence. We pride ourselves on delivering exceptional patient experiences, offering same-day appointments, and serving our communities through education and meaningful care. Our team is dedicated to creating a supportive, patient-focused environment where excellence, empathy, and teamwork thrive.

**Position Overview**

Apex Skin is a physician-led and rapidly growing dermatology practice committed to delivering exceptional patient experiences. We are seeking a professional, customer-focused **Call Center Representative** to serve as the first point of contact for our patients. This role is responsible for answering inbound calls, scheduling appointments, collecting and updating patient information, verifying insurance eligibility, and supporting patient communication needs while maintaining a high level of accuracy and compassion.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong communication and organizational skills, and is comfortable navigating multiple systems while providing exceptional patient service.

**Compensation**

Hourly Wage: $17-19.00 per hour

**Schedule**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday (8:00 am-4:30 pm)
* **Remote position for North East Ohio residents only**
* Schedule may vary slightly based on business and patient needs

**Essential Functions**

* Answer inbound patient calls promptly, professionally, and courteously
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments in accordance with Apex Skin protocols
* Complete patient pre-registration and accurately collect demographic and insurance information
* Verify insurance eligibility using EMR systems and verification platforms such as Optum or Availity
* Maintain accurate patient records while adhering to HIPAA and privacy standards
* Process pre-authorizations and assist with payment collection as needed
* Transmit correspondence and medical documentation securely and appropriately
* Collaborate with clinical and administrative teams to support patient care and scheduling needs
* Participate in required training sessions, team meetings, and operational updates
* Provide temporary support for on-site call center operations when business needs require
* Perform additional administrative duties as assigned
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills
* Basic computer proficiency including Microsoft Office, email platforms, and EMR systems
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and remain calm under pressure
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Must reside in the state of Ohio
* Ability to maintain a quiet, professional, and distraction-free remote work environment
* One (1) year of experience in a medical office, healthcare scheduling, or call center environment preferred
* Familiarity with insurance verification processes and EMR systems preferred
* Prior dermatology or specialty healthcare experience preferred

**Career Growth Opportunities**

Motivated **Call Center Representative** may pursue:

* Apex Skin provides training, mentoring, and development opportunities for individuals who demonstrate skill, reliability, compassion, and clinical accuracy

**Remote Work Requirements**

* Apex Skin will provide a company phone and access to required call center software
* Employee must maintain reliable high-speed internet service (50 Mbps download recommended)
* Designated workspace must remain private, professional, and free from distractions during scheduled work hours
* All company equipment and patient information must be handled in compliance with Apex Skin privacy and security standards

**Physical Requirements & Work Environment**

* Prolonged periods of sitting while using a computer, headset, and phone system
* Frequent speaking, listening, and viewing of computer monitors throughout the workday
* Manual dexterity required for typing and operating standard office equipment
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 15 pounds for equipment or files
* Work is performed in a home office environment with controlled lighting and limited distractions
* Requires strong attention to detail, professionalism, and the ability to maintain productivity in a remote setting
* Required to adhere to HIPAA, OSHA, and Apex Skin privacy and safety standards

**Apex Skin Culture**  
Apex Skin fosters a collaborative, patient-first environment built on compassion, clinical excellence, and teamwork. We believe in a respectful and supportive workplace where employees feel valued, trusted, and empowered to contribute to exceptional patient experiences and meaningful clinical care.

**Employee Health & Safety Requirements:**  
All patient-facing employees are required to provide proof of a TB test within the past 12 months and an annual flu vaccination as part of Apex Skin’s employee health and safety protocols. The Hepatitis B vaccination series is also strongly recommended for clinical staff due to potential occupational exposure risks. Apex Skin complies with federal and Ohio law by providing reasonable accommodations for medical conditions or sincerely held religious beliefs that prevent vaccination. Employees seeking an accommodation should contact Human Resources for more information.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement:**  
Apex Skin provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Apex complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

63562ca4bb5fe244e72e.title: Academic Enrollment Advisor (Remote - Full-time)
63562ca4bb5fe244e72e.description:
**Consultative Sales | Education & Student Success**

Novastar Prep | Full-Time | Remote — United States

**Base Salary:** $60,000–$65,000 annually  
**On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $100,000–$130,000 annually  
**Commission:** Performance-based, uncapped earning potential

**Help Families Make Confident Decisions About Their Children's Education**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------

At Novastar Prep, we believe that every student has extraordinary potential—and that the right educational support can make a lasting difference in their confidence, academic performance, and future opportunities.

For more than 17 years, Novastar Prep has helped thousands of students achieve their academic goals through personalized, one-on-one tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, advanced academic support, and college readiness services.

As we continue expanding our national presence, we are seeking an accomplished, results-driven **Academic Enrollment Advisor** who combines strong consultative sales capabilities with exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, and a commitment to helping families make informed educational decisions.

This is not a traditional high-pressure sales position. It is a relationship-driven, performance-oriented role where your ability to listen, identify needs, communicate value, and guide families toward appropriate solutions directly influences student success and your earning potential.

**No cold calling.** You will work primarily with company-generated inquiries, qualified prospects, existing client relationships, and referral opportunities.

If you thrive in a consultative sales environment, enjoy engaging with discerning clients, and take pride in achieving measurable results, we would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

**The Role**
------------

As an Academic Enrollment Advisor, you will serve as a trusted resource for families navigating important academic decisions.

You will engage with parents to understand their children's academic needs, challenges, and aspirations, then recommend personalized tutoring and test preparation solutions that align with their goals.

You will take ownership of the enrollment process—from initial consultation and needs assessment through recommendation, follow-up, and successful enrollment.

The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable establishing rapport with families, confidently discussing the value of premium educational services, and consistently achieving ambitious sales goals.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Consultative Enrollment & Sales**

* Conduct thoughtful consultations with parents to understand students' academic needs, goals, learning challenges, and educational priorities.
* Recommend appropriate tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, academic enrichment, AP/IB support, and college readiness services.
* Communicate the value of personalized tutoring clearly and persuasively while addressing questions and objections about pricing, timing, and program effectiveness.
* Convert qualified inquiries into enrollments while ensuring recommendations align with students' needs.
* Consistently achieve or exceed monthly and quarterly revenue, enrollment, and conversion targets.

### **2. Lead Management & Relationship Development**

* Manage a robust pipeline of company-generated leads, incoming inquiries, referrals, and reactivation opportunities.
* Conduct timely follow-up through phone, email, text, and video consultations.
* Develop trusted relationships with prospective and existing families, identifying opportunities to expand or resume academic support.
* Maintain accurate CRM records, including consultation notes, pipeline status, follow-up commitments, and enrollment activity.
* Demonstrate disciplined pipeline management and ownership of individual performance.

### **3. Client Experience & Student Success**

* Partner with Novastar's academic and tutor-support teams to ensure a seamless transition from enrollment to service delivery.
* Set realistic expectations about tutoring services, the learning process, and student progress.
* Support a positive family experience through thoughtful communication, responsiveness, and professionalism.
* Identify additional academic needs as students advance through different educational stages.
* Represent Novastar's commitment to individualized learning, student confidence, and long-term academic development.

### **4. Performance Excellence & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor individual sales performance, conversion rates, revenue production, and pipeline effectiveness.
* Participate in coaching, skills development, and performance reviews.
* Demonstrate openness to feedback, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.
* Contribute ideas to strengthen the enrollment process, customer experience, and overall team effectiveness.
* Collaborate with colleagues while maintaining a high degree of individual accountability.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* 3+ years of demonstrated success in consultative sales, inside sales, enrollment advising, or another relationship-driven sales environment.
* Proven ability to meet or exceed established revenue or sales quotas.
* Strong discovery, needs-assessment, relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication, with the ability to engage professionally and confidently with parents.
* Experience selling services where trust, personalization, and perceived value significantly influence purchasing decisions.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
* Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and virtual communication platforms.
* Ability to manage a substantial volume of client interactions and sales opportunities in a remote work environment.
* Self-motivation, accountability, emotional intelligence, and a results-oriented mindset.
* Genuine interest in education, student development, and helping families make informed decisions.

### **Preferred**

* Experience in K–12 tutoring, SAT/ACT preparation, college admissions services, educational consulting, or EdTech.
* Experience selling premium, personalized, or high-consideration services to families or individual consumers.
* Working knowledge of K–12 academic pathways, AP/IB programs, standardized testing, and college readiness.
* Experience managing qualified inbound leads and maintaining strong consultation-to-enrollment conversion rates.
* A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, education, communications, or a related field.
* Demonstrated ability to coach peers, improve processes, or contribute to team-wide sales effectiveness.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

At Novastar Prep, success is measured by more than sales volume. We value advisors who build trust, make thoughtful recommendations, and establish relationships that create lasting value for students and families.

High-performing advisors demonstrate:

* Consistent achievement of monthly and quarterly enrollment and revenue goals.
* Strong consultation-to-enrollment conversion rates and effective pipeline management.
* Excellent communication, client relationship management, and timely follow-up.
* Thoughtful recommendations that align with student needs and family priorities.
* Strong collaboration, professional accountability, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

**Compensation & Benefits**
---------------------------

We believe exceptional performance deserves meaningful rewards.

Our compensation structure is designed to attract accomplished professionals who want both income stability and the opportunity to increase their earnings through results.

### **Compensation**

* **Annual Base Salary:** $60,000–$65,000, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
* **On-Target Earnings (OTE):** $100,000–$130,000 annually, including base salary and performance-based compensation at established targets.
* **Uncapped Commission:** Additional earning potential for exceptional sales performance.
* **Performance Incentives:** Opportunities to earn additional compensation based on defined goals and achievements.

*OTE represents estimated annual earnings at target performance and is not guaranteed. Actual variable compensation is governed by the applicable commission and incentive plan.*

### **Benefits & Professional Development**

* Health insurance reimbursement.
* Retirement benefits.
* Full-time, remote work environment.
* Flexible scheduling within established business and client service requirements.
* Ongoing training, professional coaching, and sales development.
* Opportunities for expanded responsibilities and advancement as Novastar grows.
* Collaborative, mission-driven team culture focused on excellence, accountability, and student success.

**Work Environment & Schedule**
-------------------------------

This is a full-time, remote position open to qualified candidates based in the United States.

The role provides professional autonomy and schedule flexibility while requiring consistent availability, reliable communication, and responsiveness to families. Because many parents are available outside traditional working hours, candidates should be comfortable with scheduled consultations and occasional evening availability as needed.

You will spend significant time communicating with prospective and existing families through phone, email, and video consultations. Success requires strong self-management, disciplined follow-through, and professionalism in a remote environment.

**Professional Growth & Career Development**
--------------------------------------------

Novastar Prep is committed to developing and recognizing talented professionals.

As our organization expands, successful advisors may have opportunities to assume additional responsibilities in areas such as:

* Senior Academic Enrollment Advising
* Advisor Training and Mentorship
* Enrollment Process Improvement
* Team Leadership and Sales Management
* Client Relationship Development and Strategic Growth

Advancement is based on demonstrated performance, leadership potential, organizational needs, and available opportunities.

**Why Join Novastar Prep?**
---------------------------

**Make an Impact That Matters**

Help families make meaningful educational decisions that can positively influence a student's confidence, academic progress, and future opportunities.

**Represent an Established, Trusted Brand**

Join an organization with more than 17 years of experience delivering personalized academic support to thousands of students.

**Build a Rewarding Career**

Combine professional development, meaningful client relationships, and competitive performance-based earnings.

**Enjoy Autonomy With Accountability**

Work remotely in an environment that values initiative, sound judgment, consistent performance, and collaboration.

**Be Part of a Mission Beyond Sales**

Our educational philosophy is grounded in three core beliefs:

* Every student learns differently.
* Every student possesses tremendous gifts and potential.
* Every student deserves the investment necessary to become the best version of themselves.

We believe the right advisor helps families recognize what is possible—and connects them with the support to make it happen.

**Ready to Take the Next Step?**
--------------------------------

If you are an experienced consultative sales professional who combines strong business results with a genuine desire to help students and families succeed, we invite you to apply.

Join Novastar Prep and help families invest confidently in their children's futures.

**Apply Online:** https://careers.novastarprep.com

*Novastar Prep is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business requirements, without regard to legally protected characteristics.*

9c99cf948cc4ed0ffed1.title: Care Ambassador
9c99cf948cc4ed0ffed1.description:
*This position is National Remote. You'll enjoy the flexibility to telecommute\* from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.*

Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us in making healthcare work better for everyone through people-led, responsible AI while **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The **Care Ambassador** in Optum Frontier Therapies will be on the team of an exciting new business serving patients with rare diseases, pharma manufacturers, and providers by dispensing and servicing therapies at the frontier of healthcare. As a new Optum business, we are building on our strengths but also challenging the status quo. We are creating a business that is designed to specifically serve the unique needs of rare disease patient populations and support the emerging therapies, which require enhanced services and new capabilities over traditional specialty pharmacies. Our mission, 'supporting people with compassion while creating access to therapies at the frontier of health care,' and vision, 'that all people, no matter how unique, can access a better tomorrow' are what drive and motivate us, as part of the larger UnitedHealth Group mission 'to make the health system work better for everyone.

The Care Ambassador will be responsible for responsible for acting as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for a portfolio of healthcare providers, customers, and patients. The role is designed to provide solutions regarding product and program-related issues. Additionally, drive patient adherence to therapies and is responsible for onboarding and welcoming the patient to Optum Frontier Therapies. The Care Ambassador develops and builds on long-term effective relationships with healthcare providers, affiliated staff, and support personnel. This role educates the patient, caregivers, and all those involved in a patient's care plan on program services and solutions. Build trust in the program and long-term relationships.

As a Care Ambassador, you will serve patients, providers, pharmacy manufacturers and insurance carriers. You will work with a team of about 40 other Care Ambassadors where you will review daily plans of action for assignments, serve as a first point of contact for patient resolution, handle inbound calls as needed, support and communicate with a diverse patient population, make outbound calls to patient dispenses, triage calls, and attend meetings as needed. You will navigate about 14 programs daily in this position so computer proficiency is a must, as it the ability to handle multiple projects, multitask, prioritize your time, and remain self-motivated. Success in this role is measured by a productivity ranking, timecard accuracy, an average answer speed of under 30 seconds call monitoring quality scores and meeting service level agreements of 85% or more for inbound and outbound calls.

This position is full-time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 9:00 pm EST. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime.

We offer 8 weeks of training (6 week-long virtual classroom training followed by peer shadowing for 2 additional weeks) during normal scheduled shift of Monday - Friday, 9:00 am - 5:30 pm EST.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Serves as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for patient, caregivers, pharma, and providers.
* React with a professional and empathetic demeanor when addressing physician office and patients complaints and concerns.
* Identifies the most appropriate, efficient and effective means to streamline communication for healthcare providers with multiple patients in the program.
* Thinks critically and strategically to identify and resolve roadblocks for customers in a proactive fashion.
* Ensures Service Level Agreements are met by managing workflow and taking ownership of quality customer care.
* Supports achievement of program satisfaction.
* Develops and maintains productive and effective relationships with physicians, nurses, office managers, and other applicable customers.
* Builds trust in and engagement with program services by proactively interacting and promptly following-up on inquiries.
* Develops and implements tailored customer support plans, focusing on customer service solutions that improve patient outcomes.
* Maintains Customer Improvement focus and provides customers with unique, critical perspective on partnering with the program by laying out a vision for collaboration that positively grows relationship.
* Manages inbound and outbound e-mail, phone calls, and faxes for customer service support and follow up.
* Demonstrates an understanding of program operations process, the assigned product, and the patient journey. Understands and supports internal processing functions and personnel.
* Demonstrates an understanding of the disease state(s), competitors, and health care industry trends.
* Collaborates and works closely with management, colleagues, and other departments in the organization.
* Demonstrates competency in using information technology, PCs and a variety of databases.
* Ability to comprehend and manage any problems that may arise. Using problem solving skills to produce an appropriate resolution for physician offices and patients.
* Contributes to the achievement of the goals, objectives, and outcomes of the program by demonstrating knowledge of product, disease state, and program information as it applies to the specific program.
* Completes all appropriate training including, but not limited to New Hire Orientation, In-Services, internal training, client provided training and competency assessments.
* Maintains patient confidentiality and accurate documentation of calls to and from all parties.
* Adheres to all Company policies and standard operating procedures.
* Completes special duties or projects as assigned by the leadership.

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma / GED OR equivalent work experience
* Must be 18 years of age OR older
* 3+ years of case/account management, relationship management, customer support or professional customer service experience
* Call center experience
* Experience with Computers and Windows based programs
* Must work EST time zone
* Ability to work full-time, Monday - Friday. Employees are required to have flexibility to work any of our 8-hour shift schedules during our normal business hours of 8:00 am - 9:00 pm EST. It may be necessary, given the business need, to work occasional overtime

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Valid license, registration and/or certification, in good standing, to practice as a Pharmacy Technician as required by the Board of Pharmacy in the state employed
* Specialty Pharmacy experience
* Pharmacy Accreditation experience
* Work history working in a matrixed environment, and operations environment

**Telecommuting Requirements:**

* Ability to keep all company sensitive documents secure (if applicable)
* Required to have a dedicated work area established that is separated from other living areas and provides information privacy.
* Must live in a location that can receive a UnitedHealth Group approved high-speed internet connection or leverage an existing high-speed internet service.

**Soft Skills:**

* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
* Ability to comprehend and apply principles of basic math while analyzing data and generating reports.
* Ability to apply principles of logical thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures.

* All employees working remotely will be required to adhere to UnitedHealth Group's Telecommuter Policy

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The hourly pay for this role will range from $20.00 to $36.00 per hour based on full-time employment. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

***Application Deadline:*** *This will be posted for a minimum of 2 business days or until a sufficient candidate pool has been collected. Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.*

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcomed, valued, heard and respected, empowering people to bring their authentic selves to work and strengthening our collective impact through diverse talents, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives.*

**About Dutchie**

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is an all-in-one technology platform powering the cannabis industry with **Point of Sale**, **E-commerce**, **Payments**, and **Loyalty & Marketing**. Through our technology, we’re helping cannabis businesses start, operate, and grow with confidence.

With software that simplifies their operations, our customers can focus on what matters most—bringing the benefits of cannabis safely to consumers.

Dutchie aims to further support the positive societal change the cannabis industry brings to the world through wellness benefits, social justice, and empowering local communities through tax revenue. Powering thousands of dispensaries across 40+ markets throughout the United States and Canada, Dutchie is the leading technology company in the cannabis space and was named in Fast Company’s 10 Most Innovative Companies in North America and listed two years in a row on LinkedIn’s Top 50 Startups.

Dutchie has raised over $600M in funding to date, backed by D1 Capital Partners, Tiger Global, Dragoneer, DFJ Growth, Thrive Capital, Howard Schultz, Snoop Dogg’s Casa Verde Capital, Gron Ventures, members of the founding team at DoorDash, Kevin Durant’s Thirty Five Ventures, and other notable angel investors.

#### **About This Job**

Dutchie is on a mission to make cannabis accessible — and we do that by building the technology that powers dispensaries end-to-end: point of sale, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, and marketing. Our Support team sits at the center of that mission. When something isn't working for a dispensary, we're the ones who make it right; fast, sharp, and calm.

The Product Support Specialist is our frontline expert across the full Dutchie platform. You'll own inbound contacts for our full stack of products, troubleshoot technically complex issues, navigate multiple systems, and be the person dispensary staff rely on when things get hard in the middle of a busy shift. Many of the analysts, engineers, implementation strategists, operations specialists, and more started in this exact position or very similar, meaning this can be a launchpad for future career growth.

One more thing worth being direct about: Dutchie is actively building AI into how cannabis retail operates. We utilize AI-powered support products, and we're rolling out agentic modules across the platform that change how dispensaries interact with their technology. AI isn't a tool we use on the side, it's woven into the product you'll be supporting and the workflow you'll operate in every day. We're looking for someone genuinely curious about these tools, invested in learning them, and willing to push on them when they fall short. If you've been waiting for a support role where the technology is actually interesting, this is it.

#### **What You’ll Do**

Customer interaction and resolution

* Handle inbound contacts via email, phone, and live chat across POS, ecommerce, payments, loyalty, hardware, and integrations
* Troubleshoot complex platform issues: back office configuration, register transactions, receipt reconciliation, menu sync failures, discount and pricing issues
* Support hardware setup and troubleshooting across registers, printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, scales, and computers
* De-escalate high-urgency situations, dispensary customers are often mid-shift, and the stakes are real
* Know when to escalate to a higher level or move to a call or Zoom rather than continuing to trade messages

Payments and compliance

* Triage Pay by Bank issues: bank linking, funding delays, authorization errors, returns, and suspected fraud
* Support basic METRC and compliance workflows: package tags, manifest generation, transfer workflows
* Escalate compliance-adjacent issues to Tier 2 with complete documentation

Inventory, products, and integrations

* Assist with inventory receiving, package creation, inventory room management, and audit workflows
* Support catalog management, label configuration, and pricing updates
* Validate integration setup, triage syncing issues, and process API key requests

AI tool usage and platform evolution

* Work alongside AI-assisted support tooling as a daily part of how you triage, troubleshoot, and route issues — not as a workaround, but as the workflow
* Support customers using Dutchie’s AI-native products and agentic platform modules that are actively expanding
* Bring genuine curiosity: experiment with new tools as they roll out, flag gaps when you find them, and contribute to how the tooling improves
* Contribute to internal documentation when you resolve something that wasn’t written down. Every gap you close makes the whole team faster

Documentation and escalation

* Write complete ticket documentation on every contact: issue reported, steps taken, outcome, and next steps
* Apply the 20-minute rule: if meaningful progress toward resolution hasn’t been made, escalate with full context
* Apply correct classifications, tags, and macros before closing or escalating

#### **What you Bring**

* 2+ years in a customer-facing support role, preferably supporting a SaaS platform
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, you can explain a technical issue in plain language
* Comfort troubleshooting across multiple product surfaces simultaneously
* Strong documentation habits: your internal notes are actionable without follow-up
* Professional composure with frustrated customers in high-urgency situations
* Comfort working in web-based software, CRMs, and Google Workspace
* Genuine appetite for AI tooling, you’re curious about how these tools work, willing to push on them, and energized rather than anxious when the technology around you is evolving fast
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays. This is a 7-day operation (5am–9pm PST)

#### **It’s a Bonus if You Have…**

* Experience with POS systems, retail operations technology, or cannabis compliance
* Familiarity with Zendesk, Salesforce, Slack, and Zoom
* Background in the cannabis industry or dispensary operations
* Experience with the Dutchie platform

#### **Schedule**

Full-time, remote. Hours of operation are 5am–9pm PST, 7 days a week. Availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays is required - schedules are set through a vacation bid process that gives you structure and predictability while keeping the team covered.

#### **What you’ll get**

The hourly rate is $24.04 based on the intended level.

In addition to cash compensation, our total rewards package includes:

* Medical benefits including dental and vision plans to ensure you always have the best care.
* Equity packages in the form of stock options to all employees.
* Technology (hardware, software, reading materials, etc..) allowance
* Flexible vacation and sick days

At Dutchie, we’re committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Dutchie believes that diversity and inclusion among our teammates is critical to our success, and we seek to recruit, develop and retain the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool.

46e7de5daba0d0691a95.title: Senior Analyst, EKS Beef Operations
46e7de5daba0d0691a95.description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**

**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.** **At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**

**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**

**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**

**Your Role:** Senior Analyst, EKS Beef Operations

Elanco Knowledge Solutions (EKS) provides comprehensive data solutions that empower producers to improve their bottom line and prioritize the health and welfare of their animals. Our EKS Operations Beef team is dedicated to helping Elanco’s commitment to farm animal productivity through the development and support of the Benchmark Program, Experior data collection and PenPoint Sort on-farm system which support beef producers in understanding and managing their operational goals.

**Your Responsibilities:**

Data Strategy and Reporting

* Assess the accuracy of and find outliers and issues in biological data sets using technology (Excel, JMP, SQL, custom automation etc).
* Excel at finding, investigating, and resolving data anomalies in the data transformation flow, from external data sources to final data repositories.
* Understand, implement, and document best practices for collecting, securing, validating, matching, and maintaining data.
* Master, optimize, and automate existing data processes, collaborating with internal and external teams to improve data flows and system integrations.
* Proactively identifying system enhancements to ensure continuous improvements and system ROI.
* Maintain the highest standards of data privacy and security, complying with regulations and internal policies.

Customer Focus

* Provide expert consultation and troubleshooting on customer data issues, collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to resolve issues effectively and timely via phone, email, and live chat support.
* Resolve or escalate issues appropriately, ensuring customer needs are met through strong personal accountability and follow-up.
* Collaborate across internal teams and customers to identify and implement feedback enabling a frictionless user experience.
* Create and maintain training materials for EKS Operations process and procedures.
* Train new team members in EKS Operations processes and procedures.
* Help prepare training materials for sales teams and external users.

Platform Development

* Facilitate and collaborate efforts with the EKS Beef Operations team, internal stakeholders, and IT vendors to accurately define critical customer needs, create system requirements, identify solutions, and deliver mobile and web-based applications.
* Accountable to create and implement project management plans to track milestones, manage dependencies and risks, and ensure cross-functional team accountability both internally and externally.
* Effectively communicate project status and risks to key stakeholders on a regular basis.
* Coordinate and execute successful cross-functional user testing and launch activities of new solutions.
* Utilize process efficiency, learning agility and critical thinking skills for continuous improvement of technical solutions, existing systems, tools, and processes.

**What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):**

* **Education**: Bachelor’s Degree
* **Required Experience:** Minimum of 4 years of related experience as a business analyst, project manager, or related role in the farm animal industry.
* Experience in generating process documentation and reports, collaborating with business partners to translate business needs into written requirements to create or enhance web or mobile-based tools.
* Proficiency with Microsoft applications.
* Excellent communication skills translating data into actionable insights, adept at questioning stakeholders objectively, facilitating cross-functional teams, and adapting projects to evolving business needs.
* Self-motivated with a strong work ethic, proactive approach, capacity to manage multiple projects with varied teams, taking ownership of workload, and ensuring follow-up communication on action items and project status while being open about mistakes and resolving issues.

**What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):**

* Bachelor’s degree in Animal Science, Environmental Science, Data Science, Agriculture, Agricultural Economics, Agribusiness.
* Master’s degree.
* Experience working in beef cattle production, animal health, or proficiency in technology that supports those industries.
* Proficiency in SQL, Databricks, Pytho.n or R, Smartsheets or JMP.
* Experience designing, building and maintaining Power BI dashboards/reports and automated data quality alerts.
* Experience with both agile and waterfall development methodologies.
* Experience in customer service, compliance procedures, and technical writing.

**Additional Information:**

* Location: US - Remote
* Travel: 10-25% annually

**Elanco Benefits and Perks**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package focusing on financial, physical, and mental well-being while encouraging our employees to pursue our purpose! Some highlights include:

* Multiple relocation packages
* Two week-long shutdowns (mid-summer and year-end) in the US (in addition to PTO)
* 8-week parental leave
* 8 Employee Resource Groups
* Annual bonus offering
* Flexible work arrangements
* Up to 6% 401K matching

*Elanco currently anticipates that the base salary for this position could range from $82,600.00 to $120,600 depending partly on the successful candidate’s qualifications, including education and experience. Full-time equivalent employees also will be eligible for a company bonus (depending partly on company and individual performance). Additionally, Elanco offers a comprehensive benefit program to eligible employees that includes a company-matching 401(k); vacation benefits; eligibility for medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug benefits; flexible benefits (e.g., healthcare and/or dependent day care flexible spending accounts); life insurance and death benefits; certain time off and leave of absence benefits; and well-being benefits (e.g., employee assistance program, fitness benefits, and employee clubs and activities). Of course, the compensation is subject to change and could be higher or lower than the range described above. Elanco reserves the right to amend, modify, or terminate its compensation and benefit programs in its sole discretion, and Elanco’s compensation practices and guidelines will apply regarding the details of any promotion or transfer of Elanco employees.*

6ee45d8cebb6ec5f8304.title: GGU One Contact Center Operations Manager
6ee45d8cebb6ec5f8304.description:
**Position Title: GGU One Contact Center Operations Manager**

**Department Name: Office of the Provost**

**Position Reports To: Vice Provost of Academic Operations**

**FLSA STATUS: Salaried**

**Salary: $110,000 - $140,000**; this position is eligible for an annual performance-based bonus incentive.

**Benefits:** The University's comprehensive benefits program.

**Location:** Remote; some travel may be required for in-person collaboration and campus events.

**Days & Hours:** Standard work schedule is Monday through Friday, 37.5 hours per week, generally 9am – 5:30pm PST but can be adjusted and/or staggered to support team coverage across the team’s coverage window; flexible schedule may require some evening and weekend hours during peak periods or to handle escalations.

**BASIC FUNCTION AND SCOPE OF JOB:**

Build, stabilize, and lead GGU One’s student support operation. Manage the Navigator team (Navigators are Golden Gate University’s first contact for all student inquiries), establish dependable coverage and follow-up, improve service quality, and lead implementation of the agreed operating model and roadmap in partnership with university departments and IT.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Team Leadership & Development:** Hire, onboard, supervise, coach, and evaluate the GGU One Navigator team. Establish clear responsibilities and ongoing training.
* **Daily Operations & Coverage:** Own staffing schedules, absence coverage, queue monitoring, callback oversight, and daily priorities across phone and email support. Designate backup operational coverage during planned and unplanned absences.
* **Service Implementation & Improvement:** Lead execution of the approved GGU One operating model and roadmap, translating pilot findings into sustainable workflows, staffing practices, and service improvements.
* **Vision & Service Evolution:** Shape the long-term vision for GGU One in partnership with university leadership. Evaluate opportunities to improve student support through AI, self-service, and additional channels such as chat and text, prioritizing student needs, service quality, and operational readiness.
* **Case Ownership & Tier 2 Follow-Through:** Establish clear ownership, response expectations, and escalation procedures with university departments. Monitor unresolved and overdue inquiries, address stalled handoffs, and ensure students receive updates through resolution.
* **Knowledge & Guidance:** Coordinate with departmental subject-matter experts to maintain accurate, approved Navigator resources. Establish content owners and a process for addressing gaps, conflicting guidance, and policy changes.
* **Quality Assurance & Training:** Review call recordings, email interactions, and case documentation. Provide timely coaching and targeted training on accuracy, empathy, identity verification, escalation, and follow-up.
* **Technology & Workflow Coordination:** Partner with IT and Salesforce administrators to improve inquiry management and support the transition from interim Teams and tracker workflows to the approved Salesforce-based approach. Define operational requirements, lead user testing, and prepare the team to adopt new workflows, while technical teams own system configuration and integrations.
* **Reporting & Capacity Planning:** Produce regular reporting on demand, answering, callbacks, resolution, unresolved work, and quality. Validate metric definitions and data accuracy and recommend staffing adjustments as demand and service scope evolve.
* **Other Duties:** As assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* **Education Requirement:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Higher Education, or any other related field from an accredited college or university.
* **Years of Experience:** 5+ years of relevant service-operations experience, including direct supervision of a customer support, contact center, or higher education student-services team.
* **Operational Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to build or stabilize an evolving service operation, establish workflows, manage queue coverage, and lead teams through process and technology changes.
* **Contact Center Management:** Experience with staffing and shift scheduling, quality assurance scorecards, coaching, case management/ticketing systems, and operational reporting.
* **Cross-Departmental Collaboration:** Ability to establish accountability, establish and monitor Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and resolve student service issues across departments, including teams outside the role’s direct reporting line.
* **Technical Aptitude:** Working knowledge of CRM and contact-center tools (ideally Salesforce Education Cloud/Service Cloud), with experience partnering with IT/technical teams on operational implementations.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Higher-education student-services experience, familiarity with FERPA regulations, and knowledge of military-connected and veteran student needs are strongly preferred.
* **Skills and Abilities:**
  + Excellent communication, leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  + Ability to remain calm under pressure, handle difficult or emotional clients, and manage a busy, high-stakes service department.
  + Proven experience leading a diverse team with varied expertise, including coaching, training, and employee development.
  + Ability to compile and synthesize data from multiple sources into reports and presentations for leadership.
  + Self-directed and able to work effectively with minimal supervision.

Supplemental Information

*To apply: Please go to* *http://www.ggu.edu/jobs* *to submit an application, letter of interest, and a resume.*

*In applying for a position, candidates sign a consent authorizing a broader inquiry which may include reference checks, a motor vehicle check, and a third-party background check.*

*University policy prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion/creed, national origin, ancestry, age, sex/gender, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, physical or mental disability, gender stereotyping, and gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, taking a protected leave (e.g., family medical or pregnancy leave), or on any other basis protected by applicable laws.*

*The University has a strong commitment to the principles of diversity and inclusion, and to maintaining working and learning environments that reinforces these practices. The University welcomes and encourages applications from all demographics.*

09ad122e30b18740a48e.title: Service Coordinator
09ad122e30b18740a48e.description:
At Home Instead, we believe great homecare starts with great relationships.

We aren't simply filling shifts. We are building lasting relationships, creating dependable care experiences, supporting families, and making it possible for older adults to remain safely and comfortably at home.

We are a small, close-knit office team with a big responsibility and an even bigger heart for what we do. Our days move quickly, our schedules are full, and our work matters. We take pride in being responsive, dependable, resourceful, and there for one another. We share responsibility in building an excellent client experience, step in when help is needed, take ownership of challenges, and understand that our collective success depends on how well we work together.

We are looking for a ***Service Coordinator*** who shares that commitment.

This is an opportunity for someone who genuinely loves working with people, thrives on solving problems, brings organization to a fast-paced environment, and finds purpose in making a meaningful difference every day.

**The Opportunity**

The Service Coordinator is a central part of our team and plays a critical role in creating dependable, consistent homecare experiences for our clients. This person is responsible for thoughtfully coordinating Care Professional (CP) schedules, managing staffing needs, responding to feedback, and supporting important human resources functions.

Beyond scheduling, this role helps build and maintain the relationships that are at the heart of our business. It requires someone who understands that every schedule represents a commitment to a client, a family, and a CP.

A last-minute call-off isn't just a shift to fill. It's an opportunity to demonstrate our commitment to a client, support a CP, and find a solution that works for everyone.

We move towards solutions quickly, manage a tremendous amount of activity, and hold ourselves and each other to high standards. The right person will enjoy that pace, anticipate what needs to happen next, and take pride in being someone the entire team can count on.

**What You'll Do**

**Coordinate Dependable, Relationship-Driven Care**

* Coordinate CP assignments based on client needs, care plans, skills, availability, and personal preferences.
* Proactively manage schedules to ensure consistent, dependable coverage for our clients.
* Handle call-offs, shift changes, and last-minute staffing challenges with urgency, resourcefulness, and sound judgment.
* Communicate schedules, changes, and expectations clearly and promptly to clients and CPs.
* Support clients and families with scheduling concerns, always keeping the relationship and continuity of care in mind.
* Build familiarity with our clients and CPs to make thoughtful assignments that encourage consistency and lasting relationships.
* Monitor scheduling efficiency, utilization, and overtime.
* Anticipate scheduling needs and identify potential challenges before they become problems.
* Provide on-call scheduling support as needed.

**Support and Care for Our Care Professionals**

* Track and manage Paid Time Off requests and balances.
* Maintain accurate employee benefit eligibility records and documentation.
* Help ensure CPs meet all applicable state, local, and franchise requirements.
* Assist with employment verifications, unemployment claims, workers' compensation claims, and incident reporting.
* Respond to CP questions and concerns with professionalism, fairness, and a genuine desire to help.
* Build positive working relationships with CPs and help create an environment where they feel supported, respected, and valued.

**Strengthen Our Team and Operations**

* Maintain accurate, complete, and timely employee and scheduling records.
* Monitor compliance with company policies, procedures, and applicable requirements.
* Manage documentation related to benefits, compliance, claims, and PTO.
* Address internal complaints and feedback promptly, professionally, and constructively.
* Collaborate closely with Client Care, Human Resources, and the management team.
* Communicate proactively and keep teammates informed so that important details don't fall through the cracks.
* Take ownership of responsibilities and follow through on commitments.
* Look for opportunities to improve processes, solve problems, and make our operation stronger.
* Be willing to step outside your defined responsibilities and help wherever the team needs you.

**The Person We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone who brings more than organizational skills and scheduling experience. We want a person who genuinely cares about people, takes pride in their work, and understands that being part of a small team means everyone contributes to the client experience and success of the business.

You will thrive here if you:

* Love working in a people-oriented business and genuinely believe in the importance of the work we do.
* Are dependable, approachable, and someone others naturally enjoy working with.
* Have a strong internal drive to get things done and take initiative without waiting to be asked.
* Are comfortable taking ownership of problems and seeing them through to resolution.
* Enjoy a fast-moving environment where priorities change throughout the day.
* Are exceptionally organized and can manage multiple moving pieces without losing sight of the details.
* Think ahead, anticipate needs, pivot and change directions, and enjoy finding practical solutions.
* Communicate clearly, calmly, and thoughtfully, especially during high-pressure situations, conflict, or unexpected challenges..
* Have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to navigate challenging conversations with empathy, expertise, and good judgment.
* Are flexible and willing to jump in wherever needed, understanding that team success comes before individual job descriptions.
* Are receptive to feedback, willing to learn, and always looking for ways to improve.
* Bring a positive, can-do attitude and take pride in making a difference.
* Lead with humility, empathy, and respect, recognizing that how we treat people is just as important as the work we accomplish.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* College degree preferred, or equivalent relevant work experience.
* Experience in scheduling, staffing coordination, customer service, human resources, or operations preferred.
* Knowledge of the senior care or homecare industry is a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to prioritize competing demands.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise discretion, maintain confidentiality, and use sound judgment.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive working relationships with employees, clients, families, colleagues, and community partners.
* Ability to work independently while remaining highly collaborative.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and general computer applications.
* Ability to learn and operate Home Instead technology systems.
* Professional demeanor, patience, and a congenial telephone presence.
* Willingness to work evenings or weekends as business needs require.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position in a professional office environment.

Pay: $24.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 – 45.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

85c769167795b0e0c9ea.title: Director of Operations - CRS
85c769167795b0e0c9ea.description:
**Join a Team That Changes Lives**

For more than 170 years, Elwyn has been leading the way in supporting children, teens, and adults with autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, and behavioral health challenges. As a mission-driven nonprofit, we’re here to create real change – helping people lead meaningful, fulfilling lives.

Now, we’re looking for passionate team members to join us. Here, your work will change lives – including your own. You’ll make an impact every day, find purpose in what you do, and grow in a career that truly matters.

At Elwyn, we take care of you while you care for others. We offer:

* Generous Paid Time Off
* Comprehensive Medical/Dental/Vision Benefit Packages
* Earned Wage Access/On-Demand Pay
* Paid On-the-Job Training
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Career Advancement Opportunities and Growth
* Flexible Schedules
* Retirement Savings Plan

**Join us and be a part of something bigger. Apply today.**

Elwyn seeks a **Director of Operations** to oversee the designated department programs and provides support to all assigned CRS managers. The Director of Operations is also responsible for the development and implementation of policies and procedures, and oversight of program operations.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Ensure through review and delegation that assigned programs meet the needs of individuals supported, including, but not limited to, up to date annual plans, assessments, outcome implementation, monthly and quarterly reviews of progress, all required documentation, data collection, and completion of medical appointments
* Ensure the identification of changes in individuals’ needs and implementation of changes in the individual’s programming
* In the absence of Operations Manager, ensure ongoing review and implementation of individual’s annual plan as needed; this includes ensuring justification and request of Needs Group reassessment sent to the assigned Supports Coordinator.
* Ensure through review and delegation that programs comply with day to day operations requirements according to established policies, including but not limited to insurance of compliance with HIPAA, support of individuals’ rights, individuals’ funds security, and all other policies and standard operating procedures pertinent to individuals supported, staff, vehicle, and program requirements
* Ensure through review and delegation that assigned programs meet all regulatory requirements
* Work with, understand, and comply with terms and conditions of collective bargaining agreements (CBA) within a unionized environment with tasks including but not limited to adherence to scheduling procedures, processing transfers and promotions, administering disciplinary actions, adjudicating grievances, where appropriate, etc
* Review and facilitate staff compliance with training requirements
* Ensure through review and delegation required staffing implementation and efficient scheduling of all assigned areas, along with accurate accounting of staff time and processing of payroll
* Provide supervision of assigned staff in the areas including, but not limited to, recruitment, selection, leadership, coaching, training, performance management, promotion, corrective action, and termination
* Coordinate with Human Resources (HR) for the hiring and discipline of all personnel, including investigations of disciplinary infractions as needed
* Support the Operations Manager to ensure accurate and timely census setting
* Ensure program performance at budget levels as identified
* Interpret agency philosophy and establish standards of excellence for assigned program staff
* Lead the development and implementation of assigned programs’ service priorities, goals and objectives
* Develop and implement systems for ensuring programmatic compliance in assigned areas
* Participate in Supports for Living (SFL) Quality Improvement Department activities, including implementing Office of Developmental Programs’ (ODP) quality assurance/quality improvement requirements in assigned areas  
  Perform on-call duties off hours as assigned, providing guidance and support to managers and staff per established on-call and operational policies and protocols
* Participate in committees and sub-committees as requested
* Continuously improve operations through actions including but not limited to encouragement and utilization of feedback from individuals supported, staff, families, peers and other stakeholders, response to audit results, implementation of established best practices, and identification and prevention of potential problems
* Share information and lessons learned toward continuous improvement with peers and administration for the benefit of all programs

08985f4799e6150771cc.description:
At Accendra Health, we understand that healthcare is complex, and we’re here to make it easier. We help deliver care beyond traditional settings, making essential products and services more accessible through every stage of life. As part of the care team, our teammates play a critical role in delivering personalized, long-term care for the patients we serve.

With deep expertise promoting health outside the hospital and a presence in communities nationwide through our Apria and Byram Healthcare brands, Accendra Health does more than just deliver the essentials.

If you’re interested in meaningful work with impact, explore our career opportunities and join us in our purpose of Bringing Care To Life™.

The anticipated salary range for this position is $22 - $27 hourly. The actual compensation offered may vary based on job related factors such as experience, skills, education and location.

**JOB SUMMARY**

Our Branch Coordinators positively impact the lives of patients and their caregivers, by phone and in person, delivering excellent customer service during each interaction. Working collaboratively with patients, providers and other team members, Branch Coordinators ensure orders are received and processed timely, efficiently, and accurately. Branch Coordinators play an important role in ensuring Apria is paid for the services we provide by obtaining all necessary documentation required to bill health insurance plans.

  

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Act as first point of contact to patients arriving in person.
* Answer inbound calls from customers on a multi-line phone system; provide information to new and existing patients, troubleshoot common issues, work with the branch team and other departments to find appropriate resolutions and escalate queries or concerns when necessary.
* Perform processing duties for the branch; including, but not limited to, creating, and working with new orders, reviewing multiple systems simultaneously to assist customers, confirming delivery appointments, verifying insurance, obtaining authorization of equipment based on payor guidelines, monitoring incoming faxes, and performing data entry.
* Work with sales team, referrals and/or patients to gather documentation/information needed to meet insurance guidelines. Requests health plan authorizations/information as required; either electronically or verbally.
* Review of new and recurring patient accounts, obtain all necessary documentation from the referral source to bill the individual health insurance plans, allowing our patients to maximize their available health plan benefits and to receive the much-needed care as soon as possible.
* Collect credit card payments and billing information, reconcile daily receivables, and submit to the lock box.
* Perform outbound customer satisfaction calls to patients and referrals.
* May conduct downloads of recording devices such as apnea monitors, oximeters, CPAP devices and other respiratory equipment.
* May perform functional tests on certain respiratory equipment.
* Performs other duties as required.

* Organizing
* Problem Solving/Analysis
* Patient Focused
* Teamwork
* Time Management/Multi-tasking
* Effective communication in person, on the phone and electronically

**Computer Skills**

* Intermediate to advanced computer skills
* Proficient working within multiple systems at once

**Mathematical Skills**

* Intermediate level math skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

**Education and/or Experience**

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS**

While performing the duties of this job, the employee uses his/her hands to finger, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, or crouch; talk or hear.

* The employee uses computer and telephone equipment.
