Inizio Engage has a long-standing partnership with a leading Biotechnology company, across Commercial, Patient Solutions and Medical Affairs businesses.

The Call Center Supervisor is a critical member of the Business Unit having accountability for all aspects of call floor operations, including direct management and coaching of team members.

The Call Center Supervisor is responsible for ensuring the team delivers service that meets or exceeds agreed client goals, while fostering a culture that strives for operational and compliance excellence. As a member of the Business Unit Management Team, the Call Center Supervisor is also accountable for delivering the service in a fiscally responsible manner.

This is your opportunity to join Inizio Engage and represent a top biotechnology company!

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**

We believe great people deserve great support—at work and beyond. That’s why we offer a rewards experience designed to help you thrive personally, professionally, and financially:

* Competitive pay that recognizes your experience, expertise, and impact
* Comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage; accrued paid time off; 401(k) with company match; disability and life insurance; and paid maternity and paternity leave
* Company-paid holidays so you can rest, recharge, and focus on what matters most
* Recognition programs, contests, and awards that celebrate your contributions
* Continuous growth opportunities through learning, leadership development, and career advancement support
* A collaborative culture where your ideas are valued and your work makes a difference

We’re also proud to be recognized for creating an exceptional employee experience:

* Best Place to Work in BioPharma — 2022, 2023, 2025
* Certified Great Place to Work® — 2021, 2023, 2025, 2026

Learn more: https://www.greatplacetowork.com/certified-company/7003732

**What will you be doing?**

* Supervise call center staff, including active performance management
* Provide day-to-day supervision of the communicators. Implement and communicate performance standards
* Provide Clarity, Gain Commitment and Hold Accountable on performance expectations
* Coach team members for success and support individual development of direct reports
* Conduct performance evaluations for designated staff members
* Conduct new hire interviewing and training
* Address performance issues, including disciplinary actions and terminations in a timely manner and according to Inizio policies
* Proactively monitor staffing levels
* Coordinate and deliver program trainings as required by program
* Create and Implement initiatives designed to encourage teamwork and increase employee engagement.
* Supervise call floor operations
* Deliver service that meets or exceeds client KPI’s
* Maintain all service levels
* Ensure that all client needs are met with a high degree of quality and compliance to applicable Policies and Standard Operating Procedures
* Manage call center operations in a fiscally responsible manner
* Strategize and collaborate with internal teams to foster a culture and service of continuous quality improvement, offering creative solutions to client
* Monitor inbound/outbound customer service calls to ensure script adherence, call integrity, adverse events compliance, HIPAA compliance and proper phone technique.
* Develop a contingency plan to maintain adequate coverage levels, in the event of staff shortages. This will include serving as backup handling inbound/outbound calls when needed.
* Analyze daily, weekly and monthly call metric and productivity reports and database metrics, share analysis with Business Unit Leadership Team, and offer recommendations based on analysis.
* Oversee the handling of alternate channel requests as appropriate including, email, voice mail and white mail, and ensuring the timely completion of all.
* As needed, assist with the implementation of program modifications and the scheduling of special call programs.
* Assist Client Account Manager or designee in the development and implementation of new client programs.
* Assist in the development of quality improvement programs as a means to increase productivity and improve service levels.
* Develop contact center policies and procedures.
* Must safeguard patient privacy and confidentiality by following the guidelines set forth in the Privacy and Security Rules of the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA).

**What do you need for this position?**

  

* Five years experience supervising within a Call Center, preferably in Team Lead or Supervisor role; or equivalent experience.
* General understanding of call management systems, such as CentreVuSupervisor.
* Adept at all applicable computer software, i.e., Word, Excel, Powerpoint, Outlook and Avaya CMS.
* Outstanding customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Must possess the ability to train and motivate staff members.

The base pay range for this position is $42K – $78K per year. The final compensation offered to a successful candidate will be determined by factors such as experience, skills, internal equity, and business needs.

**About Inizio Engage**

aa9bd80b2bb6cd7a0d19.title: Patient Experience Coordinator (Central Time)
aa9bd80b2bb6cd7a0d19.description:
Heartbeat Health is the leading virtual-first cardiovascular care company in the country, providing patients with convenient, high-quality heart care through a combination of telemedicine, diagnostics, and virtual care programs. By leveraging real-time data and AI-powered insights, Heartbeat Health empowers providers and patients with personalized treatment plans, reducing hospitalizations and improving long-term heart health outcomes. Heartbeat Health is redefining how cardiovascular care is delivered in the digital age, led by our medical group of cardiologists, advanced practitioners, nurses, and care coordinators.

  

### **About the Job:**

We are seeking a Patient Experience Coordinator to join our virtual clinic team. This is a full-time, remote position requiring availability to work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT).

This entry-level opportunity is ideal for individuals who are passionate about delivering exceptional patient experiences and eager to grow their careers in the healthcare technology industry. As a Patient Experience Coordinator, you will serve as a key point of contact for patients, helping them navigate their cardiovascular care journey while ensuring a seamless and supportive experience.

Key Responsibilities:

* **Patient Outreach & Engagement:** Proactively connect with patients via phone, text, and email to coordinate virtual appointments, schedule diagnostic testing (such as stress tests and echocardiograms), and support ongoing patient engagement.
* **Patient Support & Experience:** Deliver a high-quality, concierge-level experience by assisting patients with technical questions, navigating virtual care platforms, and ensuring they feel informed and supported throughout their care journey.
* **Operational Support:** Maintain accurate patient information, document interactions, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support efficient daily clinic operations.
* **Collaboration & Growth:** Work closely with clinical and operational teams to improve patient workflows, support new healthcare programs, and contribute to the continued growth of our virtual care services.

### **About You:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field, such as Social Work, Communications, Education, Sociology, Psychology, Health Sciences, or a related discipline.
* **Experience:** At least 6 months of professional work or internship experience, preferably in a customer-facing or service-oriented environment.
* **Customer Service Focus:** Experience in high-touch, customer-facing roles such as hospitality, retail, food service, or call centers, with the ability to navigate fast-paced environments while maintaining professionalism and empathy.
* **People-Oriented:** Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a passion for helping others, building relationships, and creating positive experiences.
* **Mission-Driven:** Genuine enthusiasm for supporting patients and making a meaningful impact on their healthcare experience and outcomes.
* **Tech-Savvy & Adaptable:** Comfortable navigating technology, maintaining accurate records, and learning new systems and healthcare platforms in a fast-paced, virtual environment.
* **Organization & Attention to Detail:** Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accurate documentation, and provide timely follow-up to ensure a seamless patient experience.
* **Schedule Availability:** Ability to consistently work Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Central Time (CST/CDT), regardless of location.

### **About Our Culture:**

* **We are mission-driven:** we're revolutionizing the way cardiovascular care is delivered
* **We are fast-paced & agile:** we move quickly, iterate often, and value experimentation
* **We are remote-first:** ownership, autonomy, and trust are at the core of how we operate
* **We care about diversity**: diversity allows us to build an excellent patient experience
* **We care about each other:** we are stronger together through a culture of mutual respect and active support.
* **We invest in our people:** Eligible employees have access to a competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid holidays, sick time, a 401(k), and additional benefits designed to support you and your family.
* **We are an equal opportunity employer:** we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

$24 - $26 an hour

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

28aac809dc3704d1959f.description:
**Job Description**

***A Bit About This Role:***  
As a Member Service Guide II, Complaint Resolution at Devoted Health, you will play a vital role in resolving member grievances with accuracy, efficiency, and compassion. You’ll ensure cases are handled in compliance with regulatory requirements and within established timeframes, while also helping build trust with our members. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to work across teams to ensure grievances are resolved fairly and thoroughly.

This position is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, empathetic, and committed to both regulatory compliance and delivering an exceptional member experience. You will uncover what members really need, recommend solutions that make things easier for them, help identify opportunities for process improvements, strengthen member relationships, and contribute to Devoted’s mission of caring for every person like family.

***Responsibilities and Impact Will Include:***

* Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Devoted Health products, benefits, policies, and procedures
* Support a culture of continuous learning and member advocacy, helping Devoted fulfill its mission
* Conduct thorough investigations by reviewing case details, member records, and relevant policies and procedures to identify the root cause of member needs
* Independently resolve the majority of grievances, analyzing information across systems to determine appropriate solutions
* Recommend clear, practical solutions that address the root cause and minimize member effort, connecting members to Devoted programs and resources when appropriate
* Use sound judgment to escalate more complex situations when additional expertise is required
* Effectively triage work to ensure grievances are accurately categorized and routed
* Communicate with members through both written correspondence and telephone contact, meeting all regulatory requirements while fostering trust
* Adapt tone, pacing, and explanation to member needs, proactively clarify information, and confirm next steps
* Complete accurate documentation and data entry across multiple systems
* Ensure all grievances are resolved within required regulatory and departmental timelines
* Independently manage workload, adjust priorities based on volume and complexity, and flag capacity constraints or competing priorities early
* Collaborate with internal partners and teammates to gather information, resolve cases thoroughly, and share knowledge that helps peers improve
* Contribute to identifying themes and opportunities for improvement in processes or member experience
* Actively seek feedback, apply it consistently, and adjust quickly to changes in workflows, tools, or priorities
* **Flex into other teams’ work for short periods during non-peak volume as business priorities evolve.**

***Required Skills and Experience:***

* Experience with Medicare Advantage appeals and grievances
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy
* Adaptability: Handles changing regulations, priorities, or case volumes with resilience and teamwork
* Excellent customer service and conflict resolution skills, particularly when interacting with members who may be frustrated or vulnerable
* Strong time management and organizational skills, with the ability to meet deadlines consistently
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely explain complex information
* Ability to obtain and maintain access to the CMS Health Plan Management System (HPMS), including completing any required access, security, and training steps.

***Desired Skills and Experience:***

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in healthcare, conflict resolution, or related field
* Working knowledge of insurance products, policies, procedures, and claims processes
* Superior investigative, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Experience escalating cases and collaborating with internal stakeholders when additional support is needed
* Strong computer and documentation skills, with comfort using multiple platforms

***Hours of Operation & Scheduling Expectations:***

* This is a five-day-a-week role. Our hours of operation are 8:00 AM – 2 AM ET, Monday through Friday. Your shift will be 8.5 hours, including a 30-minute lunch, and will fall within this window.
* This role may include weekend coverage on a rotating basis, up to one weekend per month. Schedules are subject to change based on business needs, including weekend on-call support.

***Salary range:*** $22.00 - $25.00 hourly

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

* Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium
* Generous paid time off
* $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend
* Stock options for all employees
* Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles
* Parental leave program
* 401K program
* And more....

* *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.*

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.

Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business. We value diversity and collaboration. Individuals are respected for their skills, experience, and unique perspectives. This commitment is embodied in Devoted’s Code of Conduct, our company values and the way we do business.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Company does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy status, marital status, national origin, disability, age, sexual orientation, veteran status, genetic information, gender identity, gender expression, or any other factor prohibited by law. Our management team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities and general treatment during employment.

  

We have been made aware of instances of fraudulent job postings and/or fraudulent recruiting activity by individuals purporting to represent Devoted Health. These fraudulent schemes often seek monetary contributions or payments from job seekers (such as for “start up costs” or “equipment”), or seek to collect sensitive personal information. These job postings and offers are **NOT**authorized by Devoted Health and Devoted is not responsible for fraudulent offers, personal information that you may have disclosed, or payments made to third parties purporting to represent Devoted. We have reported this matter and are cooperating with law enforcement agencies. Devoted Health will never ask for financial commitment or contribution from a candidate at any stage of the recruitment process.

### ***Patient Scheduler II – Be the Go-To Support for Patient Care!***

Are you passionate about helping patients and thrive in a fast-paced healthcare environment? Do you love staying organized, solving problems, and making a real impact on the patient experience? Join GetixHealth as a Patient Scheduler and become a key part of our Patient Support Center team!

This is your opportunity to make a difference every day by helping patients get scheduled, verified, and prepared for care. From appointment coordination to insurance verification, your work helps ensure patients receive timely, accurate, and compassionate service.

If you have strong customer service skills, healthcare scheduling experience, and enjoy helping patients navigate the healthcare process, we’d love to hear from you.

-

**Position:** Full- Time

**Potential Start Date:** 11/30/2026

**Location:** Remote (Must pass an internet speed test/ we provide the equipment)

**Reports to**: Patient Support Center Supervisor

**Compensation:** $18- $20 per hour

**Operational Hours:** The operating hours for this position are 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM CST. Employees will be scheduled to work 40 hours per week within these hours, including rotating weekends. (*Schedules are subject to change and based on the business need*)

-

#### **POSITION SUMMARY:**

Provide day-to-day support for patient scheduling operations, ensuring timely appointment scheduling, insurance verification, and excellent communication between patients, providers, and medical staff.

You’ll serve as the first point of contact for patients by scheduling appointments, confirming visits, collecting insurance details, and helping patients understand their financial responsibility prior to care. Strong communication skills, multitasking ability, and attention to detail are essential.

  

#### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for patients and external facilities to schedule appointments by phone and electronic correspondence
* Collect, verify, and communicate benefit details of patient insurance policies during scheduling
* Educate patients on the insurance verification process and estimated patient responsibility prior to their visit
* Confirm patient appointments and provide appointment details, location information, and special instructions
* Create and maintain patient records including demographic information and required paperwork
* Contact referring provider offices to obtain necessary records and visit preparation details
* Coordinate with healthcare providers and medical staff to ensure appointments are scheduled efficiently and effectively
* Respond to patient inquiries professionally and in a timely manner via phone and written communication
* Collaborate with internal teams and third-party systems to support coordinated patient care
* Assist insurance verification associates when needed
* Maintain HIPAA compliance and confidentiality at all times
* Other duties as assigned

#### **EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* High school diploma or GED required
* Bachelor’s degree preferred
* 2+ years of customer service, appointment scheduling, or healthcare experience required
* 1+ years of EHR system experience (Epic preferred)
* 1+ years of remote work experience preferred, especially in high-volume inbound and outbound call environments
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problem-solving and conflict resolution skills
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Microsoft Office, and other computer systems
* Strong customer service mindset with compassion and professionalism
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and comply with HIPAA regulations

  

#### **SKILLS & COMPETENCIES:**

* Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate records
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Dependable, punctual, and able to manage time effectively
* Adaptable and open to change in a dynamic healthcare environment
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think critically
* Team-oriented mindset with strong collaboration skills
* Empathetic and patient-focused approach to service
* Professional communication and customer service skills

  

#### **WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Remote position requiring high-speed internet and a secure HIPAA-compliant workspace
* Prolonged sitting and regular computer use required
* Exposure to sensitive and confidential patient information
* Occasional overtime may be required based on workload and business demands

  

#### **WHY JOIN GETIXHEALTH?:**

Founded in 1992, GetixHealth is a trusted leader in healthcare revenue cycle management, with offices across the U.S. and India. We’re more than revenue cycle experts—we’re a mission-driven team dedicated to helping healthcare organizations improve financial outcomes while delivering compassionate care. With over 1,800 employees, we foster a culture that values professionalism, innovation, and—above all—people.

  

#### **BENEFITS & INCENTIVES:**

* **Comprehensive Health Benefits:** Choose from a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans designed to support your overall well-being.
* **Life & Disability Coverage:** Receive company-paid Basic Life and AD&D insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage, with the option to purchase additional voluntary Life and AD&D benefits.

***GetixHealth is an Equal Opportunity and E-Verify Employer.***

About Green Medical Consulting

Green Medical Consulting, LLC is a growing, nurse-owned healthcare agency providing skilled nursing, Direct Support Professional (DSP) services, companion services, respite care, and other Pennsylvania Office of Developmental Programs (ODP) services to individuals with intellectual disabilities and autism.

We are seeking a highly organized, motivated, and experienced **ODP Operations Coordinator** to assist with daily office operations, referral development, employee recruitment, onboarding, scheduling, and regulatory compliance.

**This is an in-office position. Candidates must have prior experience working with Pennsylvania ODP providers and understand ODP policies, procedures, and service requirements.**

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can work independently, solve problems, communicate professionally, and help our agency expand while maintaining quality services.

Key Responsibilities

* Experience communicating with Supports Coordinators and SCOs.
* Experience with employee recruitment, onboarding, and scheduling.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, email, spreadsheets, and electronic documentation systems.

Preferred Qualifications

What We're Looking For

4b3f794314d6693feb5f.description:
**Help build a growing law firm serving the people building what comes next.**

Our clients build things involving science, technology, and intellectual property. Your mission: make sure their first inquiry does not disappear into an inbox, their consultation lands on the right calendar, and the next step is clear.

We are seeking a resourceful, organized, tech-savvy professional to work directly with our founder, manage intake and follow-up, coordinate outside specialists, and bring structure to the everyday work of a growing business.

Think client traffic control: keep inquiries moving, coordinate arrivals, and flag problems early. No runway experience required.

**About the Firm**

The SciTech & IP Law Firm PLLC is a technology-focused boutique at the intersection of science, technology, and law. We advise innovators, entrepreneurs, startups, technology companies, and research-driven ventures on patents, trademarks, technology transactions, and related matters.

Our clients work across software, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, healthcare, robotics, defense, gaming, media, and consumer products.

**The Role**

Your priorities are client intake, first conversations, lead follow-up, scheduling, client communication, vendor coordination, and accurate use of our CRM and intake tools.

You will work alongside our marketing intern, website and SEO specialist, and outsourced providers. The Managing Attorney sets priorities, approves significant changes and spending, and retains oversight. You do not need to know every tool on day one, but you do need to learn quickly, communicate clearly, and follow through.

**Key Responsibilities**

· Serve as a professional first point of contact by phone, email, and approved intake channels.

· Conduct non-legal intake conversations using approved questions and templates; gather accurate information and route legal questions to the attorney.

· Follow up with prospects and referral sources, schedule consultations, send reminders, and coordinate rescheduling.

· Maintain accurate CRM records, lead sources, follow-up tasks, and next steps.

· Coordinate attorney-approved engagement paperwork, onboarding communications, and administrative client updates.

· Keep administrative calendars, task lists, operational timelines, subscriptions, and firm records organized.

· Create practical checklists and document repeatable processes.

· Coordinate vendor requests, meetings, updates, and deliverables; flag delays and decisions requiring approval.

· Work with bookkeeping, payroll/HR, IT, cybersecurity, website/SEO, marketing, and automation providers as engaged. Support IP-vendor logistics as directed by the attorney.

· Coordinate billing information and administrative payment questions with the Managing Attorney and bookkeeper.

· Test intake forms, booking links, and approved workflows; document issues, coordinate specialist support, and confirm fixes.

· Make routine administrative or website-content updates within your training and access permissions.

· Support approved outreach and marketing activities with the marketing intern and specialists.

· Track lead sources, response times, bookings, and follow-up completion; provide concise operational updates.

· Follow firm policies for confidentiality, system access, and approved AI use.

**Required Qualifications**

· Tech-savvy: Comfortable learning and using digital tools, navigating unfamiliar software, troubleshooting routine issues, and explaining problems clearly when specialist support is needed. Coding and advanced IT expertise are not required.

· Comfort with Microsoft 365, shared calendars, online scheduling, CRM or contact-management systems, and shared documents.

· Excellent written and verbal communication and a professional phone presence.

· Relevant experience in administration, operations, intake, client service, customer service, or a comparable role. Internships, campus leadership, and substantive projects may qualify.

· Strong organization, attention to detail, reliable follow-through, and sound judgment about confidentiality, priorities, and escalation.

· Ability to work independently while keeping the Managing Attorney appropriately informed.

· Reliable availability for at least 20 hours per week within the stated schedule.

Required: Comfort in a Startup or Founder-Led Environment

You must be comfortable working in a startup, early-stage company, or founder-led business where processes are still developing and priorities may evolve.

You should be able to turn agreed priorities into practical next steps, bring structure to incomplete processes, ask clarifying questions, and follow through without step-by-step instructions. You must also recognize when to seek approval or specialist support and work within agreed hours, priorities, and role boundaries.

Prior startup experience is preferred, not required. Comfort with this working style is required.

**Preferred Experience**

· WordPress: Experience editing pages, formatting content, uploading images, and updating forms or service listings. Familiarity with Bricks, FluentCRM, Fluent Forms, or FluentBooking is a plus. Custom development, hosting, security, and complex integrations remain with technical specialists.

· Working with a founder or in a startup, small business, law firm, or growing professional services business.

· Client intake, scheduling, onboarding, referral follow-up, vendor coordination, or process improvement.

· Marketing coordination, professional outreach, or basic operational reporting.

· Administrative use of SharePoint, Teams, Teams Phone, Microsoft Bookings, or Stripe.

· Interest in or exposure to intellectual property, science, technology, or life sciences.

A technical degree, coding portfolio, advanced SEO expertise, and specialist accounting experience are not required. Law students and graduates interested in firm operations are welcome; this is not a legal internship.

**Clear Role Boundaries**

You are not expected to be an entire professional services department. Legal advice, substantive legal decisions, docketing, and the backup legal deadline calendar remain with the attorney and designated legal operations staff. Accounting specialists handle trust accounting, reconciliations, payroll, and tax filings. Technical specialists handle cybersecurity, custom development, and complex systems work.

Your role is coordination, dependable communication, and practical execution—not independent authority over specialist work, firm strategy, or spending.

**What Success Looks Like**

Timely responses, consistent follow-up, accurate records, coordinated consultations, tracked vendor commitments, and problems surfaced early with useful context. Fewer loose ends—and more time for the attorney to focus on legal work.

Bring non-urgent updates to an agreed morning check-in on scheduled workdays. Escalate time-sensitive client issues and suspected security incidents promptly.

**Compensation, Schedule & Training**

Starting compensation: $20–$30 per hour during the initial 60-day training period, based on experience.

Compensation growth: After training, compensation reviews will consider documented progress against a clearly defined skills-and-responsibilities checklist established by the firm and shared during onboarding. You will build a record of mastered skills over time.

Progressive hourly rate increases will be evaluated using measurable criteria, demonstrated proficiency, consistent performance, and responsibilities handled independently—not simply time in the role. Increases are subject to firm needs, budget, and approval and are not automatic or guaranteed.

· Fully remote, part-time employee position; minimum 20 hours per week.

· An agreed schedule Monday–Friday within 10:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. Central Time, supporting client coverage and team coordination. Additional hours require prior approval.

· Hands-on training from the Managing Attorney.

· Long-term opportunity with potential for expanded responsibilities; full-time conversion is not promised.

The initial 60 days include a 1–2 week assessment of fit. Employment is at will throughout; completing either period does not change that status.

**Why Join Us?**

Work directly with the founder, help build practical systems, and see the impact of your contributions. Gain exposure to innovative businesses while developing your capabilities through direct feedback, specialist collaboration, and a defined skills-development framework.

**How to Apply**

Apply through Indeed and include:

· Your resume and, if available, LinkedIn profile.

· A brief note describing your relevant experience and interest in this role.

· A short writing sample, such as a professional follow-up email or process guide, with confidential information removed.

· Your pay expectations and availability within the stated schedule.

· A brief response: A prospect submits an incomplete intake form but has not booked a consultation. How would you follow up, document the interaction, and decide what to route to the attorney?

· A brief response: A vendor misses a promised delivery date for an intake-system update. How would you coordinate next steps and keep the Managing Attorney informed?

* If you have startup or founder-led business experience, include an example of improving a process or keeping work moving as priorities changed. Otherwise, explain what makes you comfortable in that environment. Applications must include a writing sample and answers to both questions. No coding portfolio is required.

5d6ae666b114d0741b5f.description:
**Job Overview**

Uncapped 50/50 commission split with consistent company- or team-provided leads, mentorship, and administrative/transaction support. We are a small Veteran Owned Freight Brokerage looking to add another teamate dedicated to learning and growing in the freight industry.

**Freight Broker**

Act as the intermediary connecting shippers who need to move freight with reliable carriers. You’ll negotiate rates, source capacity, book loads, and manage shipments from pickup through delivery while building relationships on both sides. Your impact: Matching the right capacity to customer needs keeps freight moving on time, supports competitive pricing and healthy margins, and strengthens a profitable book of business.

**Duties**

* Source and negotiate freight rates with shippers and carriers; prepare quotes and rate confirmations that balance service quality with margin.
* Identify, vet, and book carriers through load boards (DAT, Truckstop, etc.), your carrier network, and TMS; coordinate pickups, deliveries, and in-transit tracking.
* Monitor shipment status, provide proactive updates, and resolve exceptions such as delays, capacity issues, or service failures.
* Manage key documentation including rate confirmations, bills of lading, carrier packets, and proof of delivery; ensure compliance with FMCSA requirements (authority, insurance, safety ratings).
* Build and maintain relationships with shippers and carriers; support account management, new business opportunities, and overall revenue goals.
* Analyze lane rates, market conditions, and load performance using Excel, TMS platforms, and rate tools to improve coverage and profitability.
* Serve as the primary point of contact between shippers and carriers for domestic (and international, as needed) transportation planning and customer service.

**Experience**

* Experience in freight brokerage, transportation sales, carrier relations, dispatch, or logistics operations is relevant. Direct freight broker or agent experience is preferred.
* Strong negotiation, relationship-building, communication, and problem-solving skills; ability to manage multiple loads and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with transportation management systems (TMS), load boards, rate tools, and standard freight documentation.
* Knowledge of freight modes (truckload, LTL, intermodal), pricing, contracts, margins, and basic FMCSA compliance is valuable.
* Analytical skills including Excel; experience with market rate analysis is an asset. Physical warehouse or material-handling experience is not required.

Pay: $15,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

fa8a8ceca0956cbc94c8.title: da Vinci Specialist
fa8a8ceca0956cbc94c8.description:
* Wilmington, DE, United States
* Remote Available
* Sales
* JOB220547

  

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare, you’ll find your purpose here.

### **Job Description**

* **Please note: Candidates must live within or be willing to relocate to the Wilmington, DE area to perform the duties of this role.**

**Primary Function of Position**  
The DaVinci Specialist (DVS) will provide expert clinical & technical support, build, customize and coordinate education & training to physicians, nurses, and hospital staff on the use of DaVinci surgery, devices and therapies. This role partners closely with the sales team, specifically the Clinical Sales Representative and Clinical Sales Manager, to ensure safe and effective product adoption and quality control while driving positive patient outcomes.

The DaVinci Specialist is a dedicated program execution & clinical education partner for hospitals running a da Vinci robotic surgery program. Based on its expertise, this role focuses on identifies and tailors the nature and extent of staff in-servicing, day-to-day program execution, technology onboarding and operational support, communicating identified needs to hospital OR operations and leadership. The DVS will work alongside the da Vinci Clinical Sales Representative .

**Essential Job Duties**

**Collaboration & Field Partnership (Within a CSM Team)**

* Partner with the local CSR/CSM and cross-functional business partners to create, own, scale and execute best practices and deployment of ecosystem resources.
* Lead account support plans that drive safe program execution and increase customer autonomy over time, including setting objectives, timelines and resources for relevant customers, in consultation with CSR/CSM.
* Identify, solicit and provide field feedback and customer insights to internal teams to improve training, support resources, and customer experience.
* Support adoption of digital solutions by helping customers build comfort and capability through in-servicing and troubleshooting.

**Clinical & Technical Support**

* Identify and provide on-site, non-scrubbed operating room support for procedures utilizing the da Vinci Surgical System and associated technologies.

* Support OR teams with room readiness and procedural workflow, including system setup support, docking workflow support, and intraoperative troubleshooting.
* Serve as a clinical product expert to help ensure optimal, safe system use and adherence to applicable IFUs, hospital policies, and safety protocols.
* Motivate and support adoption of advanced instruments and accessories by ensuring teams understand proper setup, handling, and intended use.

* Partner with and promote consistent readiness and workflow by supporting day-to-day execution of the robotic program, coordinating with OR leadership, nursing, SPD/sterile processing, and biomedical teams.
* Assist with operational support activities such as facilitating appropriate internal handoffs for service needs.
* Ensure the right stakeholders are aligned (OR, SPD, biomed, IT) for successful day-to-day operation and new technology onboarding to help reduce friction.
* Maintain accurate internal documentation of support activities per company process (e.g., case support notes, training records, service/escalation tracking).

**Training & Education (Care Team Enablement)**

* Determine the need for, customize and deliver customer-specific hands-on training and in-services to nurses, surgical technologists, SPD teams, and other care team members on safe and effective use of da Vinci platforms and associated technologies.
* Support onboarding and education for new users through structured training touchpoints (e.g., new staff orientation, refresher training, workflow standardization).
* Lead new site start-ups by identifying and delivering onboarding programs and coordinating training logistics with the CSR/CSM and hospital stakeholders.
* Support new technology installs by coordinating readiness activities and providing post-install education to care teams.
* Act as a resource for ongoing education, product updates, and workflow optimization.

**Escalation & Customer Issue Management**

* Analyze and leverage utilization, turnover, and other relevant case data to recommend operational changes to customers
* Provide first-line support and expertise for common setup and workflow issues during live cases and training sessions.
* Identify, resolve and where necessary escalate issues appropriately to internal partners (e.g., Technical Support, Field Service, Clinical/Medical counterparts).

**Market & Clinical Insights**

* Collect and communicate customer feedback *and experiences* to clinical counterparts and internal business partners. Prioritizing, distilling and reporting relevant customer feedback, in real time.
* Stay up to date on clinical literature, competitive products, and evolving treatment guidelines.
* Assist in clinical trial support when required.
* Assist in field action activities when necessary.

### **Qualifications**

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Experience: 2+ years in an operating room-related role

The Service Coordinator – Service & Parts is responsible for coordinating the end-to-end flow of service work orders, including field & depot service activities, while also managing service parts coordination & inventory support. Service Coordination & Workflow Management

Assign, prioritize, & track service activities to ensure timely completion & effective resource utilization.

ddc3306f87043e705bb8.description:
Posted Rate is for Consult Coordinator I. Experienced Consult Coordinators may be eligible for higher rates for II and III position levels.

#### **POSITION SUMMARY**

The Consult Coordinator serves as the primary point of contact for prospective patients from initial inquiry through the surgical consultation, guiding them through the intake and pre-consultation stage of gender-affirming surgery. This role reviews new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions to confirm that required paperwork and documentation are complete; schedules consultations; and coordinates with providers, insurance verification, and financial counseling so that patients arrive at their consultation informed and prepared. Once a patient has completed the consultation and is confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, the Consult Coordinator completes a documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, who manages the patient through surgery scheduling, surgery, and postoperative follow-up. This is a nonclinical position and does not involve clinical assessment, medical advice, or medical decision-making.

#### **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and new patients from initial inquiry through completion of the surgical consultation.
* Respond to new patient inquiries, referrals, and intake submissions received by phone, email, patient portal, or other approved channels within established response timelines.
* Explain the practice’s intake and consultation process, required documentation, general timelines, and what patients can expect before and after their consultation.
* Review intake packets and referral submissions for completeness, confirming receipt of required items such as demographic information, insurance information, identification, intake and consent forms, medical records, and letters of support or referral, as required by practice protocols and payer requirements.
* Identify missing, incomplete, expired, or inconsistent documentation and follow up with patients, referring providers, and outside offices to obtain it within established timelines.
* Route documentation requiring clinical review to the appropriate provider or clinical staff. The Consult Coordinator confirms that documents are present and complete but does not evaluate their clinical content or adequacy.
* Coordinate with insurance verification and financial counseling to confirm that eligibility, benefits, and any consultationrelated referral or authorization requirements are addressed before the consultation.
* Schedule, confirm, and reschedule inperson and telehealth consultations, and send appointment details, preconsultation instructions, and reminders.
* Serve as a liaison between assigned providers and prospective patients during the preconsultation stage for nonclinical questions, scheduling, and documentation needs.
* Conduct regular checkins with patients during the preconsultation period to keep them informed of outstanding requirements and next steps.
* Track each prospective patient’s status from inquiry through consultation, and maintain an accurate, current consult pipeline in the appropriate systems.
* Following the consultation, confirm the provider’s documented outcome and communicate nonclinical next steps to the patient.
* For patients confirmed to proceed with a surgical course, complete a timely, documented handoff to the Surgery Coordinator, including documentation status, any outstanding items, and relevant patient communication preferences.
* For patients who are not proceeding, or who must complete additional requirements before proceeding, communicate next steps as directed by the provider and document the patient’s status accordingly.
* Communicate outstanding requirements, scheduling changes, and next steps clearly and compassionately.
* Escalate complex patient concerns, documentation barriers, or operational issues to the appropriate department or leader.
* Accurately document patient communication, documentation review, status updates, and completed milestones in the appropriate systems.
* Maintain patient confidentiality and comply with HIPAA and practice policies, including when requesting and receiving records from outside providers.
* Provide respectful, compassionate, and genderaffirming support without providing clinical advice, medical education, or medical decisionmaking.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance sufficient to meet the position’s operational, patientservice, and team obligations, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Comply with applicable laws, regulations, accreditation requirements, privacy and security standards, and organizational policies relevant to the position.
* Other duties as assigned.

The essential functions listed are intended to describe the fundamental duties of the position. A qualified individual must be able to perform these functions with or without reasonable accommodation. The organization will engage in a timely, good-faith interactive process when an accommodation is requested or the need for accommodation is known.

353bcd287161a3db128a.title: Assistant Construction Project Manager
353bcd287161a3db128a.description:
***FULL-TIME, ON-SITE POSITION — MEDIA, PA***

***Residential construction or skilled-trades experience required. This is not a remote, hybrid, IT, or software project management position.***

**Chimney Cricket** is a full-service chimney, fireplace, and hearth company serving homeowners throughout the greater Philadelphia region. Our work includes chimney restoration and masonry, fireplace installation, venting systems, gas and wood appliances, and other residential construction and home-service projects.

We are looking for an experienced **Project Operations Coordinator** to coordinate residential fireplace and hearth restoration and installation projects from approval through completion.

**This is not an entry-level administrative project coordinator position. We are specifically looking for someone with experience coordinating construction, remodeling, trades, or field-service projects.** The right candidate understands what it takes to move a physical project from a sold scope of work to a completed job—including scheduling crews, reviewing job requirements, coordinating materials and equipment, working with vendors, communicating with customers, and working with field techs to solve problems when conditions change.

The Project Operations Coordinator works closely with our Operations Manager, sales team, technicians, installers, vendors, and customers to make sure every project is properly prepared before a crew arrives and stays on track through completion.

**Construction Project Coordination**

You will manage the operational side of multiple active residential construction and installation projects. This requires understanding project scope, anticipating what crews need to complete the work, and identifying potential problems before they affect the schedule.

* Manage projects from sales approval through completion and closeout
* Review scopes of work, estimates, job documentation, photos, measurements, and project requirements
* Coordinate project readiness, deposits, scheduling, materials, equipment, and crew requirements
* Maintain communication between sales, customers, field crews, vendors, and management
* Track multiple active projects and proactively identify scheduling, material, or job-readiness issues
* Coordinate changes or unexpected field conditions that affect project execution
* Visit active job sites to review progress, quality, project conditions, customer satisfaction, and crew needs
* Help ensure crews arrive with the information, materials, equipment, and preparation necessary to complete the project successfully

**Project Administration & Closeout**

Strong documentation matters, but this position requires more than simply maintaining paperwork. You will use project documentation to understand what is happening in the field and help keep projects moving.

* Review technician paperwork, job notes, photos, and project documentation
* Monitor project labor and technician timesheets
* Ensure required project documentation is complete and accurate
* Track outstanding project items and follow them through resolution
* Coordinate project completion, closeout, and handoff to billing

**Purchasing & Material Coordination**

Construction experience is particularly valuable in this area. Our projects may require appliances, venting components, masonry materials, fabricated products, specialty parts, and other job-specific materials.

* Review project material and equipment requirements
* Order materials, venting, equipment, and specialty components
* Coordinate purchasing with manufacturers, distributors, and local suppliers
* Track purchase orders, lead times, backorders, and delivery dates
* Verify orders for accuracy before projects are staged
* Identify material issues that could affect project schedules
* Maintain organized purchasing and project records

**Safety Program Coordination**

Safety is one of Chimney Cricket's core values. This position also supports the Operations Manager in coordinating and maintaining our company safety program.

* Maintain company safety documentation, incident records, and OSHA logs
* Coordinate safety meetings, training sessions, and toolbox talks
* Track employee safety certifications and training requirements
* Maintain SDS, equipment, and other required safety documentation
* Assist with incident documentation and coordination with outside safety consultants

**Required Qualifications**

* **Minimum 2 years of experience coordinating residential construction, remodeling, installation, or skilled-trade field projects. Experience exclusively in IT, software, or corporate project management does not meet this requirement.**
* Experience coordinating **multiple active field projects** involving crews, schedules, materials, customers, vendors, and changing job-site conditions
* Working understanding of how residential construction or skilled-trade projects move from estimate/sale through planning, procurement, field execution, and completion
* Experience reviewing scopes of work, job documentation, material requirements, and project schedules
* Ability to anticipate project needs and identify missing information, materials, or job-readiness issues before sending a crew
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
* Confident communication with homeowners, field technicians, vendors, salespeople, and management
* Comfortable visiting active residential construction/job sites
* Proficient with business software, project-management systems, and Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in one or more of the following industries is strongly preferred:

* Residential construction or remodeling
* HVAC
* Roofing
* Chimney, fireplace, or masonry
* Plumbing
* Electrical
* General contracting
* Specialty trades or home services

Additional preferred experience includes:

* Construction purchasing and material procurement
* Coordinating subcontractors and field crews
* Inventory or warehouse coordination
* Reading construction scopes, plans, specifications, or manufacturer documentation
* OSHA documentation, safety programs, or construction safety compliance

**Who Will Be Successful in This Role**

This position is a good fit for someone who has worked around construction projects long enough to understand that **the plan on paper and what happens in the field aren't always the same thing**.

You should be comfortable looking at a project and asking questions such as: Do we have everything the crew needs? Are the materials correct? Is the site actually ready? Are there access or scheduling issues? Is something missing from the scope? Does the customer understand what is happening? What could prevent us from completing this job as scheduled?

We're looking for someone who doesn't simply track problems after they happen—we want someone who **anticipates them and helps solve them before they affect the project.**

**Our Core Values**

* **RESPECT** – We are prepared, on time, and treat people right.
* **INTEGRITY** – We do what we say and own the outcome.
* **SAFETY** – We protect people, property, and the reputation of our company.
* **EXCELLENCE** – We pursue quality outcomes and continuous improvement.

8da62b51bca6ff392367.title: Client Experience Coordinator
8da62b51bca6ff392367.description:
Help us make money feel a little less complicated.

At **Money Honey Financial**, we believe great financial service should feel personal, approachable, and empowering.

We're a growing, woman-owned accounting firm helping individuals and business owners navigate taxes, bookkeeping, and financial decisions with confidence. We take our work seriously, but we believe the experience of working with an accountant should feel anything but intimidating.

We're building something special, and we're looking for the right person to grow with us.

**The Opportunity**

We're looking for a **Client Experience Coordinator** who loves people, thrives on organization, and takes pride in making things run smoothly.

You'll be the friendly voice, organized mind, and dependable presence that helps keep our clients informed, supported, and confident throughout their experience with Money Honey.

From welcoming new clients to coordinating tax appointments and keeping important documents moving, you'll play a key role in ensuring our clients receive the exceptional service they deserve.

**This isn't a tax preparation position.** Instead, you'll work alongside our accountants and bookkeepers, helping create the seamless experience that allows our entire team to do its best work.

And because we're a growing firm, you'll have opportunities to contribute ideas, improve processes, take ownership of projects, and grow professionally.

What You'll Be Doing

**Create an exceptional client experience**

* Be a welcoming and professional first point of contact for clients by phone, email, and in person.
* Guide new clients through onboarding, including welcome communications, engagement letters, questionnaires, and document collection.
* Help clients navigate our online portals, scheduling systems, and administrative processes.
* Coordinate appointments, respond to inquiries, and ensure clients receive timely updates.
* Build genuine relationships with clients and help them feel valued, informed, and supported.

**Keep our team organized and moving forward**

* Monitor outstanding client requests, missing documents, and upcoming deadlines.
* Proactively follow up with clients to keep tax and bookkeeping projects moving.
* Maintain accurate client records, contact information, and important documentation.
* Coordinate administrative aspects of client offboarding and transitions.
* Help ensure that no client request, important document, or follow-up falls through the cracks.

**Support our tax and bookkeeping operations**

* Coordinate the collection of bank statements, financial records, and account access needed by our bookkeeping team.
* Assist with sending tax organizers, appointment reminders, and seasonal communications.
* Prepare and coordinate administrative tax forms, including IRS authorization forms.
* Assist with IRS and state correspondence, document submissions, and tracking notices.
* Monitor administrative deadlines and keep the team informed of outstanding items.

**Help us create the Money Honey experience**

* Coordinate thoughtful client appreciation initiatives, including holiday gifts and special milestones.
* Identify opportunities to make our client communications and processes even better.
* Collaborate with our team to streamline workflows and improve efficiency.
* Bring fresh ideas, positive energy, and a solutions-oriented mindset to the office.

**What Success Looks Like in This Role**

We're looking for someone who does more than complete a to-do list. Our ideal candidate takes ownership, anticipates needs, and finds satisfaction in keeping people and processes organized.

You'll thrive here if you:

* Have 2+ years of experience in administrative coordination, client services, or office operations, preferably in a professional services environment.
* Are a natural problem-solver who takes initiative and follows through without constant reminders.
* Can confidently manage multiple client requests, competing priorities, and deadlines.
* Communicate professionally and warmly, even when handling difficult conversations.
* Are comfortable holding clients accountable for providing the information our team needs.
* Have strong attention to detail and take pride in getting things right.
* Enjoy creating systems, improving processes, and finding more efficient ways to work.
* Understand the importance of discretion when handling confidential financial information.

**You don't need to know everything about taxes or accounting to succeed here.** We're happy to train someone who brings the right attitude, strong organizational skills, and a genuine commitment to client service.

Why Join Money Honey Financial?

We're not your traditional accounting firm, and that's intentional.

We're creating a workplace where professionalism meets personality, clients feel like people rather than numbers, and team members have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.

**Here's what you can look forward to:**

* **Stability:** A permanent, year-round position with a growing firm.
* **Meaningful work:** You'll play an important role in helping entrepreneurs and individuals feel more confident about their finances.
* **A supportive team:** Work alongside a collaborative group that values communication, accountability, and helping one another succeed.
* **Professional development:** Receive hands-on training in our systems, processes, and accounting firm operations.
* **Room to grow:** As our firm expands, we want our team members to have opportunities to expand their skills and responsibilities.
* **A workplace with personality:** We believe you can deliver exceptional professional service while still being approachable, authentic, and human.

**Ready to Grow With Us?**

If you're organized, people-focused, proactive, and excited about joining a growing business where your work truly matters, we'd love to meet you.

**Come help us deliver the Money Honey experience.**

Pay: $19.00 - $24.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

**About Sagility**
------------------

Sagility combines industry-leading technology and transformation-driven BPM services with decades of healthcare domain expertise to help clients draw closer to their members. The company optimizes the entire member/patient experience through service offerings for clinical, case management, member engagement, provider solutions, payment integrity, claims cost containment, and analytics. Sagility has more than 25,000 employees across 5 countries.

**Job title:**

Remote Customer Service Representative (Healthcare)

**Job Description:**

**Work From Home | Healthcare Coverage Review Representative**
==============================================================

**Build Your Career in Healthcare, From the Comfort of Home!**
--------------------------------------------------------------

  
  

**Are you passionate about helping others, solving problems, and making a difference in healthcare? Your next career opportunity could be with Sagility!**

  
  

At Sagility, we believe every interaction is an opportunity to make healthcare simpler, more accessible, and more personal. We're looking for motivated, detail-oriented professionals with healthcare and customer service experience to join our growing team of **Coverage Review Representatives**.

In this role, you'll help members, healthcare providers, and medical offices navigate prescription medication coverage, understand benefits, and obtain important information about prior authorizations.

  
  

If you enjoy helping people, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and want to build your career with a healthcare industry leader, **we want to hear from you!**

  
  

**What Makes This Opportunity Great?**
--------------------------------------

* **100% Remote:** Work from home in an eligible U.S. location.
* **Weekly Pay:** Get paid every week!
* **Competitive Compensation:** Earn $16.00 per hour during training and nesting, increasing to $16.50 per hour once in production.
* **Earn More During Training:** Qualify for performance incentives of up to an additional $2.00 per hour during training and nesting, bringing your potential earnings to **$18.00 per hour!**
* **Paid Training:** Receive two weeks of structured training followed by two weeks of supported, hands-on nesting.
* **Meaningful Work:** Help patients and healthcare providers navigate important medication coverage decisions.
* **Career Development:** Gain valuable experience in healthcare operations, pharmacy benefits, and coverage review.

*Performance incentives are based on meeting established quality, accuracy, attendance, and schedule adherence requirements. Additional details will be provided during training.*

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As a Coverage Review Representative, you'll serve as a trusted resource for members, healthcare providers, and other healthcare professionals seeking information about prescription medication coverage.

Your daily responsibilities will include:

* Answer inbound calls from members, physicians' offices, and healthcare partners regarding prescription medication benefits and coverage.
* Verify member eligibility and determine medication coverage under applicable healthcare plans.
* Assist callers with understanding medication coverage options and prior authorization requirements.
* Provide updates on prior authorization requests and coordinate with appropriate departments.
* Review medication inquiries, documentation, and requests for additional information.
* Contact healthcare providers to obtain necessary information and support timely resolution.
* Accurately document interactions, update records, and enter information into multiple systems.
* Deliver professional, compassionate, and accurate customer service while meeting established quality and performance expectations.
  

  

**Your attention to detail and commitment to service will help make a meaningful difference in the healthcare experience.**

**What You'll Bring to the Team**
---------------------------------

  
  

We're looking for individuals who are dependable, adaptable, comfortable with technology, and committed to delivering exceptional service.

  
  

**Required Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* At least 6 months of call center experience.
* At least 1 year of experience in healthcare, medical claims, or medical administration.
* At least 1 year of recent continuous employment with a previous employer.
* Working knowledge of medical and healthcare terminology.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Excellent computer navigation, keyboarding, and data entry skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Windows, Microsoft Office, and the ability to learn multiple software applications.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to multitask.
* Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team environment.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  

  

**Your Work Schedule & Training**
---------------------------------

  
  

**Business Hours:** MondayâFriday, 7:00 AMâ8:00 PM Central Time. Candidates must be available to work an assigned schedule within these hours.

**Training Schedule:** MondayâFriday, 7:30 AMâ4:00 PM Central Time.

**Training Program:**

* 2 weeks of instructor-led training.
* 2 weeks of supported nesting to help you transition into production.

**Important:** Full attendance is required during training, and candidates must commit to no planned time off during their first 90 days of employment.

  
  

**Work From Home Requirements**
-------------------------------

To be successful in this remote position, you'll need a dedicated, secure workspace and reliable technology.

**Internet Requirements:**

* Reliable, hardwired internet connection.
* Internet speeds exceeding 25 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload.
* Ethernet connection required; Wi-Fi and mobile hotspots are not permitted.

**Equipment You Will Provide:**

* Monitor measuring 19 inches or larger with VGA or HDMI connectivity and the corresponding cable.
* USB wired mouse.

**Equipment Sagility Provides:**

This position uses BHIVE, a virtual workplace platform designed to support remote team collaboration, communication, productivity, and time tracking.

BHIVE requires an active webcam positioned to provide a continuous profile view of your workspace, including your monitors, keyboard, head, shoulders, and hands throughout the workday.

Candidates must be comfortable working in this camera-enabled virtual environment.

  
  

**Ready to Make Your Next Career Move?**
----------------------------------------

**Your healthcare experience matters. Put it to work in a role where you can help others, develop valuable skills, and grow professionally all while working from home!**

  
  

**Don't wait for the perfect opportunity to find you. Take the next step toward your future with Sagility today!**

### **About Sagility**

Sagility is a leading healthcare business process management services provider dedicated to improving the experiences of healthcare members, patients, and providers.

By combining healthcare industry expertise, innovative technology, and compassionate service, we help our clients deliver better healthcare experiences.

At Sagility, our people make the difference. Join a team where your skills, dedication, and commitment to helping others can create a lasting impact.

  
  

**Your next chapter starts here. Apply today!**

  
  

**Sagility is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Vet/Disability.**

United States of America
