**Job Description:**

**Job Title: Director, Data Acquisition**

**Location:** Remote | Canada, USA
  
**Reports to:** VP, Data Operations & Governance

**Employment Type:** Full-time

This is an existing vacancy

**About the Role:**

The Director, Data Acquisition leads the strategy, procurement, acquisition, and management of vehicle source data for the Data Operations organization. This role ensures the company has reliable, cost-effective, and scalable access to various types of OEM vehicle data used in the processing of data for JD Power products and analytics solutions.

The Director works closely with Data Operations leadership, Procurement, Legal, Technology, and Commercial teams to oversee data supplier relationships, licensing, sourcing coverage, and supply continuity. The role requires a strategic and proactive approach to data acquisition while maintaining strong governance, cost discipline, and risk mitigation across the data supply ecosystem.

**In this role, you will:**

**Data Sourcing & Acquisition**

* Lead the sourcing and acquisition strategy for Data Operations, building on its existing network foundation to meet future needs.
* Identify and evaluate new data sources and various acquisition approaches that improve Data Operations sourcing coverage and operational requirements.
* Partner with Data Operations and Product leaders to understand evolving data needs and priorities.
* Make strategic sourcing decisions that balance quality, coverage, cost, and business value.
* Partner with commercial teams to build strategic relationships at OEMs, expanding Data Operations access to global and digital data streams.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop the data acquisition team, setting clear priorities, goals, and performance expectations.
* Grow the team's relationship network across data assets, including OEM, data supplier, and digital data relationships.
* Coach team members on negotiation, supplier management, and governance practices, and build backup coverage for critical supplier relationships.

**Supplier & Licensing Management**

* Manage relationships with external data suppliers and strategic partners.
* Lead supplier evaluations, contract negotiations, renewals, and performance reviews.
* Oversee data licensing, usage rights, and contractual obligations.
* Partner with Procurement, Legal, and Data Governance to ensure effective oversight.

**Supply Management & Resiliency**

* Establish contingency and backup sourcing plans for critical data assets.
* Monitor supplier risk and develop mitigation strategies to ensure uninterrupted data access.
* Ensure primary and secondary source coverage for critical data assets.

**Cost & Performance Management**

* Manage data supplier spend and identify opportunities to improve value and efficiency.
* Develop reporting and performance measures for sourcing, costs, and supplier effectiveness.
* Provide leadership with clear visibility into data supply risks, opportunities, and investment needs.

**Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Establish standards and processes for data sourcing, acquisition, and supplier management.
* Promote consistent practices across all data domains and business areas.
Drive continuous improvement to enhance sourcing efficiency, scalability, and effectiveness.  

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Data Management, Technology, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in business development, data acquisition, data operations, supplier management, procurement, business operations, or a related discipline, including Director-level leadership.
* Experience leading teams.
* Experience negotiating supplier agreements and managing third-party relationships.
* Working knowledge of data licensing, contracts, governance, and risk management practices.
* Strong financial, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proven ability to influence decisions and drive outcomes across complex organizations.
* Polished presentation and negotiation skills.
Ability to personally own key supplier relationships while leading a team.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in the automotive industry, dealership operations, automotive finance, or incentive administration.

* Background in Finance, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Analytics, Data Science, Business, or a related field.

* Experience with Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Power BI, Copilot Studio, or similar technologies.

* Experience with SQL, Python, VBA, or other automation and data tools.

* Understanding of regular expressions (RegEx) for data validation and pattern recognition.

* Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks.

* Experience developing standard operating procedures and process documentation.

* Customer service or customer support experience.

* Experience participating in process improvement or operational excellence initiatives.

**Compensation and Benefits**

This position has a starting salary range of $121,000 - 141,000 USD / $112,000 - 131,000 CAD. The range represents what we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

Eligible employees may participate in medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, retirement savings programs, paid time off, wellness programs, and other company-sponsored benefits. Benefits vary by country and employment status.

  
  

**Why Join JD Power**

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

* **We power our customers’ success.** Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

* **We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data.** We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

* **We make things easy.** We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

* **We get it done.** We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

* **We start with trust and prove it every day.** Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

  

**Equal Opportunity & Accommodations**

JD Power is committed to employing a diverse workforce. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.

JD Power is committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for individuals with disabilities or other protected needs under applicable local laws. Please contact careers@jdpower.com for accommodation request.

  

**Data Privacy**

JD Power does not disclose your personal data to unauthorized third parties. However, as a global corporation consisting of multiple affiliated companies in various countries, JD Power has international sites and JD Power uses resources located throughout the world. JD Power may from time to time also use third parties to act on JD Power’s behalf. You agree to the fact that to the extent necessary your personal data may be transferred and/or disclosed to any company within JD Power group of companies as well as to third parties acting on JD Power’s behalf, including also transfers to servers and databases outside the country where you provided JD Power with your personal data. Such transfers may include for example transfers and/or disclosures outside the European Economic Area and in the United States of America. If you are a California or United Kingdom resident, additional disclosures about the information we collect and how we use that information can be found by clicking here .

**Applications**

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where employment is offered. JD Power does not provide employment sponsorship for this position.

This position is posted exclusively on https://www.jdpower.com/business/careers and select trusted job boards such as LinkedIn or Indeed. All official communication comes from email addresses ending in @jdpower.com or @jdpa.com. We will never ask for payment, equipment purchases, or upfront fees. We may take additional steps to verify candidate information to protect the integrity of our recruitment process.

To all recruitment agencies: JD Power does not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

7626beb2a20cc461a4ad.description:
**This is a Remote USA Role - Preferred Candidate Placement is the San Francisco Bay area.**

  

TE Connectivity (TE) is a leading global provider of highly engineered connectors and sensors with sales of over $15 billion to customers in more than 150 countries. They design, manufacture and market products for customers in a broad array of industries including automotive; consumer electronics; telecommunications; aerospace; defense & military; medical & healthcare; oil & gas/marine; and energy & utilities. With over 80,000 associates including 7,500 engineers and worldwide manufacturing, sales and customer service capabilities, TE Connectivity’s commitment is their customers’ advantage. TE Connectivity is an independent publicly traded company whose common stock is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol “TEL.”

  

TE’s connectivity solutions are key enablers in our increasingly connected world. Safer and more advanced medical devices, smarter factories, connected vehicles, and data everywhere are underlying market trends creating significant opportunities for TE. TE’s dedication to innovation, focus on solutions for harsh environments, and commitment to delivering extraordinary customer experiences enable TE to capitalize on these opportunities and more.

Digital Data Networks Business Unit
  
The Cloud market is changing at an unprecedented pace, and the Digital Data Networks (DDN) Business Unit at TE Connectivity is at the heart of a continuously expanding connected life. Accordingly, DDN provides responsive, iterative, and fundamentally agile capabilities conceived, designed and manufactured to support today's demands. DDN’s customers are building the devices and the infrastructure that is redefining what information technology means. Their products push markets and meet the ever-changing need of the evolving, more connected, data-driven world. They are enhancing the way the world does business, focusing on the most important things and staying agile and responsive to the needs of a faster, more connected world.This business has high performing yet complex manufacturing operations encompassing 10,000+ SKUs, 300,000+ orders and 10 million+ shipments through 10 distribution centers annually, all while launching upwards of 50 new products per year.Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat and Twitter.

**Job Requirements**
--------------------

TE Connectivity seeks an experienced and dynamic Sr. Sales Development Representative to support a global team serving one of the world’s leading hyperscale customers within the AI and Cloud Hyperscale sector. This individual will play a key role in expanding TE’s position within the account by developing customer relationships, identifying and advancing new opportunities, and coordinating TE’s internal resources to successfully execute customer programs.

  

The role will complement existing account coverage while expanding TE’s relationships across customer engineering, sourcing, supply chain, and program management organizations. As part of the front-end team, the Sr. SDR will be a liaison between these customer roles and the internal support from within TE.

  

This individual will be expected to develop strong working relationships with key customer stakeholders, understand and organize project requirements, timelines, commercial opportunities and decision points, and translate those needs into clear actions for TE’s Product Management, Engineering, Operations and other internal teams.

  

The successful candidate will bring a growth-oriented mindset, strong commercial acumen, technical aptitude, and the ability to operate effectively in a highly matrixed global organization. This is a hands-on customer-facing role requiring someone who can independently develop relationships, establish structure around emerging opportunities, and drive actions to closure.

  

The role will appeal to an experienced sales professional who wants substantial ownership within a strategically important hyperscale account and the opportunity for further personal and career growth as TE continues to expand its AI and data center business.

**Specific Job Duties**
-----------------------

**Strategic Account Management**
  

* Support the development and execution of the strategic account plan for one of TE’s largest hyperscale customers.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with project managers, engineering teams, sourcing organizations and other key customer stakeholders.
* Establish credibility as a responsive and knowledgeable commercial partner who can connect customer requirements with TE capabilities.
* Coordinate closely with account leadership to ensure clear ownership, consistent customer communication and alignment on account priorities.

  

**Business Development**
  

* Identify, qualify and develop new design opportunities, with particular focus on data center applications.
* Engage customers early in the design cycle to understand program requirements, architecture, timelines, volumes, commercial value, qualification needs and key decision points.
* Build and maintain a structured pipeline of new programs and design opportunities.
* Collaborate with TE Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Operations and Marketing teams to develop solutions that meet customer requirements and expand TE content.
* Identify opportunities to leverage successful designs across platforms, programs and data center architectures.

Program and Opportunity Management
  

* Translate customer discussions into clear internal requirements, priorities, owners and timelines.
* Maintain visibility to key customer programs from initial engagement through design-in, qualification, sourcing and production.
* Drive internal follow-up across Product Management, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Pricing and other functions to keep customer commitments and commercial opportunities on track.
* Identify risks, gaps and dependencies early and escalate appropriately when additional support or decisions are required.
* Provide clear and concise reporting on program status, opportunity value, milestones, customer actions and internal deliverables.

Market Analysis
  

* Maintain awareness of industry trends, hyperscale data center architectures, AI infrastructure requirements and competitive activity.
* Develop an understanding of emerging architectures and interconnect requirements and translate those trends into actionable opportunities for TE.
* Engage with customers and ecosystem partners to identify market and technology trends that can accelerate growth of TE’s DDN business.

**Specific Job Duties (Continued)**
-----------------------------------

**Customer Engagement**
  

* Maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding customer business needs, technical requirements and program priorities.
* Proactively develop relationships beyond established account contacts to broaden TE’s engagement across the customer organization.
* Establish a regular cadence of customer interaction, including in-person meetings in the Bay Area as appropriate and occasional global travel as needed.
* Identify and respond to key customer needs, converting opportunities in the sales funnel into design wins and revenue.

  

**Delivering Revenue Targets**
  

* Contribute to achievement of annual sales and growth targets within the assigned account.
* Develop and maintain a robust opportunity pipeline, sales forecast and key account metrics.
* Own assigned opportunities from initial identification through commercial award and production.
* Develop credible estimates of program timing, volume, content and revenue potential to support account forecasting and resource prioritization.
* Expand TE content and market share within assigned product areas and customer organizations.

**Collaboration**
  

* Work closely with the broader account team to maintain clear responsibility and coordinated engagement across customer organizations and product areas.
* Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, System Architecture, Operations, Quality and Customer Service to convert customer requirements into executable internal actions.
* Effectively influence internal stakeholders in a matrixed organization without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Coordinate with TE teams globally to support development, qualification and production activities. Some evening communication with Asia will be required on a weekly basis.

**What your background should look like**
-----------------------------------------

**Professional Experience/Qualifications**

  

The Sr. Sales Development Representative will be an experienced sales professional with demonstrated success managing technically complex customers and developing new business opportunities.

Experience within hyperscale data centers, AI infrastructure, power distribution, interconnect or related markets is strongly preferred.

  

* 7+ years of relevant sales, account management or business development experience, preferably supporting Tier 1 hyperscale, cloud infrastructure or related technology customers.

* Undergraduate degree in engineering, business or a related field is required. A technical undergraduate degree is preferred given the customer and product complexity of the role. An advanced degree, such as a Master of Business Administration, is desirable.

* Experience in the AI, high-speed computing, data center or related infrastructure industry.

* Knowledge of interconnect, cable assembly, busbar, or related electromechanical products and associated manufacturing processes.

* Proven ability to identify and develop opportunities from early customer engagement through design-in and commercial award.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple simultaneous customer programs with different requirements, stakeholders and timelines.

* Strong commercial skills, including opportunity sizing, forecasting, pricing and negotiation.

* Ability to understand technical customer requirements and translate those requirements into commercial opportunities and internal actions.

* Proven ability to establish relationships across engineering, sourcing, supply chain and program management organizations.

* Skilled at communicating and leveraging differentiated value propositions.

* Ability to understand the big picture while maintaining sufficient attention to detail to drive program requirements and commitments to closure.

* Strong business sense and industry expertise with a growth and hunting mentality.

* Strong familiarity with CRM tools and systems, including Salesforce, is desirable.

* Technical aptitude; engineering or comparable technical background is strongly preferred.

* Ability to travel approximately 10 to 20%, including international travel as required.

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

**Leadership Qualifications**

  

The Sr. Sales Development Representative will be expected to demonstrate leadership through ownership, influence, customer credibility and execution, rather than primarily through direct people management.

**The Sr. Sales Development Representative should possess the following skills:**

  

* Sales Leadership: Demonstrated ability to identify opportunities, develop customer relationships and lead cross-functional teams toward commercial outcomes. Strong relationship-development, collaboration and influencing skills.
* Ownership and Accountability: Ability to take ownership of customer opportunities and drive internal and external actions through completion.
* Delivery and Results Oriented: Ability to find solutions and generate results in a dynamic environment with multiple competing priorities.
* Influencing Skills: Keen listening, open-mindedness and strong interpersonal skills, enabling effective alliances with internal and external stakeholders.
* Communication Skills: Comfortable communicating both formally and informally with customer stakeholders, technical teams and senior executives. Able to consolidate complex program activity into clear requirements, actions, timelines and business implications.
* Customer Development: Strong ability to establish new relationships and expand engagement within complex customer organizations rather than relying solely on established contacts.
* Adaptability: Able to thrive in a fast-paced global environment where flexibility, resilience, comfort with ambiguity and adaptability to change are essential.
* Technical Curiosity: Able and willing to develop sufficient understanding of customer architectures, applications and TE technologies to engage credibly with both commercial and technical stakeholders.

**ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY**

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at www.te.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat, Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

  

**COMPENSATION**
  

* Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $113.5k - 170.3k annually (subject to change dependent on physical location)
* Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
* Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

  

**BENEFITS**
  

* A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

**EOE, Including Disability/Vets**

  

**IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD**
  
TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity **never requests payment or fees** from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come **only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com**. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

0f253daa27745688bb98.title: Operations & Transaction Manager (Real Estate Investment/Wholesale)
0f253daa27745688bb98.description:
**Job Title: Operations & Transaction Manager (Real Estate Investment/Wholesale)**

**Location: Remote / Kansas (Topeka, Wichita, Salina)**

**Job Type: Full-Time**

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Base Salary: $35,000 - $45,000 (Depending on experience)**
* **Performance Bonus: $150 - $250 bonus for every transaction that successfully closes. When you help push deals across the finish line, your earning potential grows. We are assertively spending and hiring toward the goal of >10 transactions per month.**
* **Health Stipend: $300 monthly health/wellness stipend (can be used toward your own premiums, out-of-pocket medical expenses, or taken as supplemental income. This is how we provide health insurance).**
* **Schedule: 100% Remote (Must be available during standard Central Time business hours).**
* **Paid Time Off: 10 days of PTO plus standard major Federal holidays.**
* **Tech Stipend: $50/month to cover high-speed internet/cell phone usage.**

**About Us**

**We are a fast-paced and expanding 21-year-old real estate investment company now operating in the Topeka, Wichita, and Salina, Kansas markets that values hard work and human dignity. We have a highly effective and long tenured offshore VA team that handles our front-line inbound calls, lead follow-up, and appointment setting. We are looking for a highly organized, US-based Operations & Transaction Manager to be our back-office hub. You will manage our CRM systems, oversee complex direct mail list management, and relentlessly drive signed contracts to the closing table. If you love creating order and ensuring no detail falls through the cracks in a healthy, principled environment where people are treated with respect, then this Seat is for you.**

**Our Core Values (Who We Are)**

**We operate our business on principles of hard work, integrity, and caring for others. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and hire strictly based on a candidate's ability to demonstrate these behavioral core values:**

* **Driven, Yet Gracious (A Refined Executor): We need someone who is highly motivated, goal-oriented, and knows how to drive a project across the finish line. However, maturity is key—you have learned how to achieve goals without running people over. You value relationships just as much as results and lead with a servant’s heart.**
* **Fiercely Honest & Kind: We do the right thing even when it is hard. We believe in speaking the truth in love to all sides of the transaction, combining candid honesty with genuine kindness.**
* **Clear Communicators: We eliminate confusion by communicating directly, clearly, and proactively. Our “Yes” is “Yes” and our “No” is “No”. We don't do passive aggressive. We don’t pass the buck. We identify and solve problems together.**
* **Mutual Respect: We deeply care for the needs of others—our sellers, our buyers, our team, and our partners—while also establishing healthy boundaries to ensure the success of the business. We don’t just look out for our own interests, but also for the interests of others.**
* **Diligent & Hard-Working: We bring a strong work ethic to everything we do, working not just for a paycheck, but because we believe our work serves a higher purpose. We go the second mile.**

**Role Summary**

**The Operations & Transaction Manager is the operational engine of the company. You will oversee our CRM architecture, manage day-to-day financial and vendor administration, meticulously scrub and prep our direct mail lists, and own the real estate transaction coordination from contract to close. Your primary goal is to remove administrative bottlenecks so the leadership team can focus entirely on high-level growth, closing deals, and community initiatives.**

**The 6 Core Roles & Accountabilities**

**1. List Management & Direct Mail Operations:**

* **Manage relationships with 4 distinct list-providing vendors to procure and organize seller data**
* **Perform high-level data scrubbing in Excel (removing duplicates, ensuring street name conformity like "St" vs "Street", formatting data)**
* **Accurately assign and track specific marketing phone numbers to their corresponding direct mail pieces to ensure perfect lead attribution.**

**2. CRM & Systems Hub:**

* **Own the CRM system architecture**
* **Ensure lead routing is flawless so our front-line VAs can operate efficiently**
* **Manage integrations and scripts with our answering service and ensure all VA-set appointments hit the leadership team's calendar perfectly**

**3. Transaction Coordination (Contract to Close):**

* **Take ownership of all properties once under contract, ensuring a smooth path to the closing table**
* **Coordinate with local title companies, manage DocuSign workflows, track Earnest Money (EM) deposits, review title commitment requirements, review settlement statements, and ensure all closing documents, amendments, and lien releases are executed accurately and on time**

**4. Financial Administration:**

* **Process inbound and outbound invoices and manage routine payments (via PayPal, QuickBooks Payment, contractor payouts, etc.)**
* **Manage utility setups, transfers, and cancellations for all properties**
* **Liaise directly with our CPA vendor to provide timesheets, transaction receipts, income, and necessary QuickBooks updates**

**5. Vendor, IT & Calendar Management:**

* **Act as the primary point of contact for IT, software platforms (Microsoft, Automated Genius, website hosting), and external marketing vendors.**
* **Book, confirm, and cancel property appointments (coordinating closely with partners like property managers, inspectors, buyers, sellers, etc.).**
* **Act as the US-based point of escalation if a VA encounters a complex issue they cannot handle.**

**6. Document Processes & Systems:**

* **Create and maintain simple, step-by-step checklists for your daily back-office tasks so the business runs on clear systems rather than just tribal knowledge.**
* **Write clear instructions for the offshore VA team so they can execute their tasks without confusion and let their "Yes" be "Yes."**
* **Proactively update our checklists when you find a better, faster way to do things, helping the entire team go the second mile with less friction.**

**How We Measure Success (Your Scorecard)**

* **List & Marketing Integrity: Zero errors in mail-piece tracking numbers or duplicate mailings due to poor data scrubbing**
* **Closing Compliance: 100% of transaction documents (Contract, Addendums, Amendments, Earnest Money, Third Party Authorizations, etc.) are submitted and verified within one business day of contract signing**
* **Systems Uptime: Zero missed utility payments, lapsed software subscriptions, or dropped vendor communications per month**
* **Pipeline Integrity: 100% of VA-set appointments are correctly tagged, routed, and calendar-synced in Microsoft Outlook without manual intervention from the leadership team**

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Advanced Excel Competency: You must be highly proficient in Excel for heavy data sorting, deduplication, text formatting, and standardizing large datasets**
* **Proven experience in real estate transaction coordination, operations management, or as a high-level Executive Assistant**
* **Deep familiarity with CRMs (REI BlackBook, RESimpli, Salesforce experience is a massive plus)**
* **Proficiency with digital transaction tools (DocuSign), basic financial software (QuickBooks), and Microsoft products (especially Outlook and Excel)**
* **Relentless attention to detail—you do not let things slip through the cracks**
* **Strong communication skills to effectively manage title companies, buyers, sellers, and external vendors**

**How to Apply**

**Please send your resume and a brief cover letter outlining your experience with real estate transaction coordination, CRM management, and Excel data scrubbing to colm@bluestemproperty.com .**

***Attention to detail is critical for this role. To apply, you MUST include the word 'BlueStem' in the subject line of your email. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.***

Pay: $53,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Real estate • transaction coordination : 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

0cdf8d4ec89083ec2b41.description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.

  

**Fraud Detection | Transaction Monitoring | Risk Analysis | SQL | Power BI | Fraud Operations**

Join our team as a **Fraud Support Analyst**, supporting fraud prevention and risk management through terminal reviews, merchant validation, transaction monitoring, fraud investigations, and data analysis.

In this role, you will primarily support the Misaligned Terminal Blocking Solution by reviewing flagged terminals, validating merchant legitimacy, and maintaining block lists.

You will also analyze transactional and operational data to identify fraud patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and emerging risks, partnering with cross-functional teams to strengthen fraud controls and deliver accurate, actionable, and auditable decisions within established service level agreements (SLAs).

**Responsibilities**

**Terminal Review & Fraud Investigation**

* Review system-flagged terminals using established fraud investigation criteria and public or third-party sources to validate merchant legitimacy and identify misaligned, suspicious, or corrupt terminals.
* Research store websites, business listings, licensing records, Google Maps, and other available sources to support merchant validation and fraud detection decisions.
* Add, update, or remove flagged terminals and maintain fraud block lists in accordance with standard operating procedures and SLAs.
* Document evidence, findings, and actions to maintain auditability and compliance with applicable policies, regulations, and governance requirements.

**Fraud Analysis & Reporting**

* Extract, integrate, and analyze data from multiple systems to identify fraud trends, transaction anomalies, vulnerabilities, and operational risks.
* Monitor fraud strategies and controls to evaluate effectiveness and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Generate and analyze fraud reports, block list updates, dashboards, and activity summaries.
* Communicate fraud findings, trends, risks, and recommendations to Fraud Operations, internal leadership, cross-functional stakeholders, and clients.

**Cross-Functional Support**

* Partner with Fraud Operations, Technical Support, Product/Platform, and Client Support teams to define analytical requirements, escalate issues, troubleshoot problems, and improve fraud prevention solutions.
* Support fraud teams by researching issues, analyzing data, and assisting with technical and operational troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field plus at least one year of relevant experience; or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
* If substituting professional experience for a degree, at least three years of experience in fraud analysis, fraud operations, risk analysis, business analysis, data analysis, transaction monitoring, statistical reporting, or a related analytical role.
* Experience interpreting complex data, identifying trends and anomalies, developing practical recommendations, and communicating findings to stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in SQL.
* Experience developing interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence tools.
* Strong data analysis, data mining, data management, interpretation, and visualization skills, including experience working with large datasets from multiple systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft tools including Copilot, Excel, Outlook, Word, Teams, and PowerPoint, with the ability to learn additional analytical technologies.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to make independent, data-driven decisions, manage competing priorities, and meet SLA-driven deadlines.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing technical documentation, reports, queries, presentations, and explaining findings to nontechnical audiences.
* Must be either a U.S. Citizen or a Lawful Permanent Resident.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree, Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE) certification, or another recognized fraud or risk certification.
* Experience in fraud detection, fraud prevention, risk operations, compliance, payments, or financial services.
* Experience with fraud rules, transaction monitoring, case management systems, operational SLAs, and workflow-driven processes.
* Ability to interpret basic system logic and partner with technical teams to troubleshoot fraud-related issues.

**Work Environment**

* Works primarily with fraud monitoring applications, analytical reports, dashboards, and Microsoft tools.
* Must be able to respond promptly to time-sensitive fraud alerts and SLA-driven tasks.
* Regular collaboration with Fraud Operations, Technical Support, Product/Platform, Client Support, internal leadership, and clients.

**Why Join Us**

This role provides the opportunity to combine fraud investigation, data analytics, SQL, transaction monitoring, and risk analysis to help identify suspicious activity and strengthen fraud prevention controls. You’ll work across fraud, technical, product, and client-facing teams while developing expertise in data-driven fraud detection and operational risk management.

**Flexible Working**

At Conduent, we want you to be yourself. We recognize that everyone is different and that how people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too.

In this role, you can expect the following working conditions:

* **Remote work**: Enjoy the convenience of working from home and maximize your time by unplugging at the end of your workday.

**Working For You**

Perks and rewards designed for you:

**Retirement Savings:** We will support you as you save for your future.

When you join Conduent, you are engaged in creating the future - both our company’s and your own. With more than 60,000 associates across 24 countries, we will provide you the opportunity to grow with a team of people who will challenge and inspire you to be the best!

183d7c0b83cfc1710048.title: Vice President of Marketing
183d7c0b83cfc1710048.description:
About IMG Academy
  
IMG Academy is the world’s leading sports education brand, providing a holistic education model that empowers student-athletes to win their future while preparing them for college and for life. IMG Academy has been nationally recognized by organizations including Sports Business Journal, USA Today, and the Best and Brightest Companies to Work For for its workplace culture, innovation, and commitment to developing people both on and off the field.
  
  
IMG Academy provides growth opportunities for student-athletes and partners through an innovative suite of on-campus and online experiences:
  

* Boarding school and camps, delivered on a state-of-the-art campus in Bradenton, Florida
* Online coaching through IMG Academy+, focused on personal development through the lens of sport and performance
* Online college recruiting through NCSA College Recruiting and SportsRecruits, providing industry-leading recruiting education, tools, and access to a network of more than 40,000 college coaches for student-athletes, families, club coaches, and event operators
* Elevate by IMG Academy, a performance and personal development solution that delivers mindset, leadership, and wellbeing programming to schools, colleges, and organizations through a combination of digital content and immersive experiences

Position Summary
  
  
NCSA College Recruiting is seeking a results-driven, hands-on Vice President of Marketing to lead its next phase of growth. The VP owns NCSA’s end-to-end marketing strategy and performance, with direct accountability for qualified leads, website traffic, conversion, enrollment contribution, and marketing-driven revenue, and leads four functional teams
  
  
This is a player-coach role for a commercially minded growth leader, not simply a marketing strategist: someone analytically rigorous about what drives performance shifts and able to move quickly from insight to execution. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in performance marketing, SEO, conversion rate optimization, lifecycle/CRM, and marketing analytics, and a proven record of building and coaching teams in consumer growth and digital acquisition.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Own Marketing Growth, Lead Generation & Enrollment Performance
  
  
Own integrated marketing plans and targets for qualified leads, enrollment contribution, conversion, customer acquisition cost, and marketing-attributed revenue.
  
  
Diagnose and address declines in organic traffic and lead volume; build sustainable growth across paid, organic, referral, and owned channels.
  
  
Partner with Sales, Product, Finance, and Data teams to improve lead quality, lead-to-enrollment conversion, forecasting, and unit economics.
  
  
Identify new audience opportunities, including younger athlete families and broader IMG Academy cross-sell pathways.
  
  
Own marketing budgets, channel mix, prioritization, and measurable return on investment.
  
  
Lead Growth & Performance Marketing
  
  
Build and optimize acquisition across SEO, AI-driven discovery, paid search, paid social, ecommerce, and emerging channels.
  
  
Lead website performance and conversion rate optimization for NCSAsports.org, with a rigorous cadence of landing-page, offer, and funnel testing.
  
  
Strengthen visibility in search and AI-generated answers through authoritative content, technical foundations, and clear product information.
  
  
Improve conversion paths, pricing transparency, and digital purchasing experiences in partnership with Product and Digital teams.
  
  
Launch and scale ecommerce as a new channel for NCSA, working closely with the Product team and owning its marketing strategy, customer acquisition, conversion, and revenue performance.
  
  
Lead marketing for digitally delivered products such as IMG Academy+ Personal Coach and IMG Academy+ Essentials.
  
  
Use weekly performance insights to rapidly adjust investment, creative, targeting, and user experiences.
  
  
Build a High-Performing Lifecycle & CRM Engine
  
  
Own segmentation, personalization, customer journeys, email, marketing automation, lead nurture, retention, and revenue optimization.
  
  
Evolve NCSA from a primarily lead-generation model toward a coordinated customer growth engine across acquisition, qualification, enrollment, and retention.
  
  
Leverage first-party audiences, customer data platforms, and enriched data to improve relevance and conversion.
  
  
Align with Sales on MQL definitions, lead scoring, handoffs, nurture programs, and the measurement of incremental enrollment impact.
  
  
Develop renewal, upsell, and cross-sell programs across NCSA and IMG Academy offerings.
  
  
Strengthen Brand Positioning, Content & Consumer Trust
  
  
Own brand stewardship, messaging, creative strategy, consumer sentiment, and positioning in a competitive college recruiting market.
  
  
Communicate NCSA’s distinctive value through athlete exposure, personalized guidance, and connections with college coaches.
  
  
Address pricing, reputation, competitive alternatives, and perceived value through research-backed, transparent communications.
  
  
Lead content and social programs that strengthen consumer trust and drive search visibility, AI discoverability, and qualified demand.
  
  
Apply AI-enabled workflows to improve content quality, speed, and operating efficiency.
  
  
Drive Marketing Operations, Analytics & Execution
  
  
Create an accountable operating cadence of KPI reviews, reporting, campaign planning, testing, and corrective action.
  
  
Oversee campaign operations and dedicated analytics support, working closely with enterprise Data & Analytics.
  
  
Measure traffic, lead quality, funnel conversion, enrollment contribution, CAC, marketing ROI, and brand health.
  
  
Turn complex performance data into clear explanations of what is changing, why it is changing, and what the team will do next.
  
  
Ensure effective deployment of marketing technology, CRM, automation, and data capabilities.
  
  
Lead & Develop Four Functional Teams
  
  
Lifecycle & CRM - customer segmentation, email and automation, journeys, nurturing, retention, and revenue optimization.
  
  
Growth & Performance Marketing (Demand Generation) - qualified lead growth, acquisition, pipeline contribution, and website performance.
  
  
Brand & Content - brand stewardship, consumer sentiment, creative, messaging, content production, and AI-enabled workflows.
  
  
Marketing Operations & Analytics - operational discipline, performance reporting, and dedicated analytical support.
  
  
Coach functional leaders while remaining personally engaged in problem solving, prioritization, and execution; partner across Sales, Product, Technology, and Data.
  
  
Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  
  

* 12+ years of progressive marketing experience with significant leadership responsibility in consumer growth and digital acquisition.
* Documented success improving qualified demand, customer acquisition, funnel conversion, and revenue performance.
* Experience with high-consideration, sales-assisted B2C purchases, consumer subscriptions, education services, or similar business models.
* Deep working expertise across performance marketing, SEO, CRO, lifecycle/CRM, marketing analytics, and digital customer experiences.
* Strong fluency in acquisition economics, attribution, experimentation, forecasting, and marketing investment optimization.
* Demonstrated ability to build and coach teams, partner cross-functionally, and communicate effectively with executive leadership.
* A hands-on operating style and the ability to turn ambiguous performance problems into focused, measurable action.

Preferred Skills
  
  

* Experience in education, youth sports, recruiting, consumer marketplaces, or digital subscription products.
* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, customer data platforms, enrichment, and advanced personalization.
* Experience in AI search discovery/AEO, content-driven growth, and direct-to-consumer ecommerce.

**Background Requirements:**  

* Requires a background check upon offer

Some positions, particularly those that have responsibilities working with student-athletes and supporting IMG Academy on campus with events involving minors, may require a L2 background screen. The requirement will be communicated during onboarding, and instructions for submission of level 2 backgrounds will be provided. Learn more about the screening process and requirements by visiting the Florida Care Provider Background Screening Education & Awareness website: https://info.flclearinghouse.com.
  
  
**Benefits:**  
As a full-time member of our team, you will enjoy a comprehensive offering listed below. Connect with your talent acquisition specialist to learn more about benefits for our part-time roles.
  

* Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision
* Flexible Spending Account and Health Savings Account options
* 401k with an Employer Match
* Short Term and Long Term Disability
* Group and Supplemental Life & AD&D
* Gym Discount Program
* Pet Insurance
* Wellbeing Program
* and more!

Don’t meet every single requirement? We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**Get to know us better:**  
www.ncsasports.org
  
www.ncsasports.org/careers
  
  
NCSA provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

f6162b0b75f4ae00c1bc.title: Supplier Quality Representative (SQR) – Precast Concrete (ESS-448)
f6162b0b75f4ae00c1bc.description:
**Location Requirement:** Candidate must reside within reasonable commuting distance of the assigned supplier location in Eastern Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Southern New York.

**Schedule:** Full-Time | Monday through Friday, 5 days per week.

**Experience / Qualifications:**

* Minimum **1+ year of precast concrete experience.**
* Formal certification is **preferred but not required.**
* Candidate should be local to Eastern Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Southern New York.

**Job Responsibilities:**  
The SQR will provide full-time, on-site quality oversight related to precast concrete activities. Responsibilities include witnessing and/or reviewing the following:

* Forming.
* Concrete pours.
* Post-pour inspections.
* Documentation reviews.
* Shipping preparation.
* Release for shipment.

**Supply Chain - Supplier Quality and Expediting.**

**Position Summary:**

This position entails visits to supplier and vendor shops to perform the activities defined by the quality surveillance assignment. The Supplier Quality Representative verifies, through monitoring, observation, document review, witnessing of examinations and tests, and selective hands-on inspection, that supplier-furnished material and equipment includes the defined attributes of recognized codes and standards and company procurement document requirements. Rejects material found nonconforming to procurement document requirements. Collaborates with the supplier and project supplier quality personnel to identify a course of action to achieve satisfactory disposition of disclosed nonconformances, releases conforming material for shipment, and reports surveillance results to company project personnel and the customer.

**Responsibilities:**

The Supplier Quality Representative represents the company as the supplier’s primary contact and performs quality surveillance activities defined by the assignment scope to verify that supplier-furnished material and equipment conforms to the technical and quality requirements of the procurement documents. Acting in this capacity, the Supplier Quality Representative performs the following:

**Requirements and Pre-Fabrication Readiness:**

* Reviews the procurement document requirements with supplier representatives to ensure they are understood and implemented, including client-specific and code-driven requirements.
* Participates in kickoff and pre-fabrication meetings; confirms witness and hold points, inspection and test planning, documentation deliverables, and traceability expectations before production begins.
* Verifies that qualified procedures, qualified personnel, calibrated equipment, current approved drawings and revisions, and released material are in place prior to the start of work.

**Surveillance and Verification:**

* Performs the surveillance activities defined by the assignment and the company's quality surveillance plan, which establishes what the company verifies and at what level; the supplier’s inspection and test plan governs the supplier’s own regime, and the two meet at witness and hold points.
* Monitors supplier personnel activities, including the witnessing of operations, inspections, examinations, or tests, to verify purchase order document requirements have been met - first operation and nondestructive examination, welding, fit-up and dimensional verification, blasting and coating, pressure and functional testing, final inspection, factory acceptance testing, and pre-shipment verification.
* Reviews supplier-generated quality verification documentation to verify conformance to procurement document requirements, including material test reports, traceability and heat records, nondestructive examination reports, personnel and procedure qualifications, calibration records, coating records, and data books.
* Verifies that sub-suppliers and subcontracted operations are disclosed, qualified, and controlled, and that sub-tier findings and records are included in supplier reporting.
* Reviews supplier documents submitted to the company with or without comments; does not sign, initial, stamp, or otherwise endorse supplier inspection and test plans or other supplier documents.

**Nonconformance and Corrective Action:**

* Rejects material found nonconforming and documents the condition objectively with reference to the governing requirement and supporting photographic evidence.
* Collaborates with the supplier and project supplier quality personnel to identify a course of action to achieve satisfactory disposition of disclosed nonconformances; refers design-driven items to the Responsible Engineer for technical disposition.
* Verifies corrective action in the shop using supplier evidence together with the representative’s own observation; ensures open actions carry an owner, due date, closure evidence, and follow-up verification, and reports repeat findings and adverse trends.

**Release, Reporting, and Schedule Interface:**

* Releases conforming material for shipment and notifies other company functional organizations to assist in coordination of their activities.
* Reports the results of quality surveillance activities to provide company project personnel and the customer with the status of surveillance activities, using timely and accurate surveillance reports as the auditable record of attendance, observations, and actions.
* Provides early notification of quality or fabrication progress risk to the Area Supervisor and project supplier quality personnel, and coordinates with area expediting personnel so quality and progress status are consistent.
* Supports remote and technology-enabled surveillance, including hands-free video collaboration, three-dimensional scanning, and model overlay tools that extend Engineering and project visibility into the shop; these tools supplement, and do not replace, in-shop presence and judgment.
* Maintains assignment, notice-of-inspection, finding, certification, and photographic records in the applicable company systems.

**Qualifications and Skills:**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Two years of related experience involving 2,000 hours of in-shop surveillance, examination, or testing activities; or
* High school diploma or equivalent and 1,000 hours of in-shop surveillance, examination, or testing activities; or
* Associate Degree, or the equivalent of two years of full-time college coursework in a related discipline, plus 500 hours of in-shop related experience in equivalent inspection, examination, or testing activities.
* Valid driver’s license and the ability to travel routinely to supplier facilities within the assigned area.
* Ability to obtain and maintain any client, facility, or export-control access required for assigned suppliers.

**Additional Qualifications:**

* The demonstrated ability to work under moderate supervision and to reach defensible conclusions independently while in a supplier facility.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including clear and factual surveillance report writing.
* Computer skills must consist of a working knowledge of word processing and spreadsheet applications, electronic submission of reports and assignment tracking, and digital camera use.
* Additional hours of in-shop quality surveillance or related experience with equipment or materials common to the company marketplace.
* Commodity experience in one or more of the following: structural steel and plate work; piping, spools, valves, and supports; pressure vessels, exchangers, tanks, and skids or modules; rotating equipment and packaged units; electrical and instrumentation equipment, including transformers, switchgear, and e-houses; protective coatings and linings; precast and prestressed concrete products.
* Working familiarity with the applicable codes and standards for the assigned commodity, such as the ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code (Sections I, V, VIII, and IX), ASME B31.1 and B31.3, AWS D1.1, API standards, and AMPP/SSPC coating standards.
* Industry certifications such as ASNT Level II in one or more nondestructive examination methods, AWS Certified Welding Inspector, AMPP/NACE coating inspector, or NPCA Production and Quality School certification.
* Experience with quality programs applicable to the assignment, including ISO 9001, 10 CFR 50 Appendix B, or NQA-1.
* Experience on engineering, procurement, and construction projects in energy, nuclear, liquefied natural gas, mining and metals, or major infrastructure.
* Experience with supplier assessment, surveillance level determination, supplier requalification, or supplier document and certification data book control.
* Experience with international suppliers and translated documentation; a second language relevant to the assigned region is an advantage.
* Ability to work safely in an industrial fabrication environment with exposure to noise, heat, cold, dust, fumes, and moving equipment, wearing required personal protective equipment at all times.
* Ability to climb ladders and stairs, work at elevation, enter confined or restricted spaces where authorized, stand and walk for extended periods, and lift and carry inspection equipment of approximately 25 pounds.
* Vision and hearing, with correction as needed, sufficient to perform visual examination and witness testing.
* Include any and all industry certifications with your resume, including issue and expiration dates.

SureWerx is a leading manufacturer of innovative safety, tool and equipment products and solutions. Since 1957, we've been trusted to keep all who use our products safe in even the most challenging environments. Today, our growing family of world-leading brands serves customers and partners across the U.S., Canada and Europe.

  
  

At SureWerx, you'll have the opportunity to challenge yourself in a supportive, growth-oriented culture of industry leaders. You’ll help chart our future as we continue to expand into new products, services and markets. And we’ll invest in your career development, enabling you to grow and succeed.

  
  

We are seeking a detail-oriented Shipping Associate to join our supply chain team. This role oversees packaging, labeling, carrier coordination, and documentation using ERP systems, UPS WorldShip and FedEx. The Shipping Associate supports the company’s supply chain efficiency by optimizing shipping workflows, minimizing errors, and upholding quality standards.

  
  

We are looking for a permanent full-time Shipping Associate at our manufacturing facility in Sellersville, PA. The in-person role is Monday-Friday from 7:30am – 4:00pm.

  
  

**Responsibilities:**

  
  

**Shipping Operations:**

* Prepare outbound shipments by verifying order accuracy, selecting appropriate packaging materials, and securing items for transit.

* Quality inspect and fold garments before packing.

* Accurately package, label and weigh items to be shipped.

* Work with other colleagues to determine expected daily shipments.

* Operate UPS WorldShip, FedEx and ERP systems (Global Shop) to generate shipping labels, manifests, and tracking details.

* Coordinate with carriers to schedule pickups, negotiate rates, and resolve delivery discrepancies.

* Enforce FIFO (First-In-First-Out) principles to prioritize urgent shipments and prevent delays.

* Monitor shipping costs and recommend cost-saving strategies, such as consolidating shipments or selecting alternative carriers.

  
  

**Documentation & Compliance:**

* Prepare bills of lading, commercial invoices, and customs documentation for international shipments.

* Ensure compliance with DOT, IATA, and OSHA regulations, particularly for hazardous materials or restricted items.

* Maintain digital records of shipping documents in the ERP system for auditing and traceability.

* Conduct pre-shipment inspections to verify compliance with customer specifications and regulatory requirements.

  
  

**Inventory Coordination:**

* Collaborate with warehouse teams to locate and pull items for shipment, minimizing downtime between order fulfillment and dispatch.

* Perform cycle counts on high-priority inventory to ensure stock accuracy before shipping.

* Report inventory discrepancies, such as shortages or damaged goods, to the Warehouse Coordinator for resolution.

  
  

**Receiving:**

* Receive and inspect raw materials.

* Move raw materials to their physical locations.

* Enter pertinent data into various electronic logs.

* Maintain accurate inventory in electronic logs.

**Safety and Quality Assurance:**

* Adhere to safety protocols when operating equipment (e.g., pallet jacks) and handling heavy or hazardous materials.

* Inspect packaging for defects and reinforce boxes to prevent damage during transit.

* Participate in monthly safety training and report near-misses or incidents to supervisors.

  
  

**Customer Service Coordination:**

* Liaise with the customer service team to address shipping inquiries, update delivery timelines, and resolve issues like lost packages.

* Proactively communicate delays or carrier disruptions to affected stakeholders.

  
  

**Technology & Reporting:**

* Generate daily shipping reports to track metrics like on-time delivery rates, cost per shipment, and carrier performance.

* Troubleshoot technical issues with UPS WorldShip, FedEx or ERP systems and escalate to IT when necessary.

* Other tasks as needed.

  
  

**Requirements and Skills:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; certification in logistics or supply chain management preferred.

* 1–2 years of experience in shipping, logistics, or warehouse operations.

* Proficiency in ERP systems and shipping platforms (UPS WorldShip, FedEx).

* Familiarity with carrier portals (FedEx, UPS), freight classification, and customs documentation.

* Strong attention to detail to minimize shipping errors and ensure compliance.

* Ability to lift 50 lbs. and stand for extended periods.

27e4b41a56f33db8add6.title: Associate Director, Market Research
27e4b41a56f33db8add6.description:
Vera Therapeutics is a commercial-stage biotechnology company focused on the pursuit of truth in science to transform medicine in autoimmune disease, starting with the kidney. Vera Therapeutics’ flagship commercial product is TRUTAKNATM (atacicept-vymj), a B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and A proliferation-inducing ligand *(*APRIL) inhibitor. Vera Therapeutics is evaluating multiple diseases where the reduction of autoantibodies through inhibition of BAFF and APRIL may prove clinically meaningful. Vera Therapeutics was founded in 2016 and is based in Brisbane, California. To learn more, visit www.veratx.com.

At Vera, our values are the cornerstone of our culture and guide how we work together every day. We lead with empathy, act with an owner’s mindset, demand clarity, work without fences, and execute with urgency because patients are counting on us. From how we hire and develop our people to how we advance rigorous science, we are building a team committed to transforming medicine in autoimmune diseases, starting with the kidney.

**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Associate Director, Market Research owns and leads market research for the commercial team and reports to Senior Director, Strategic Insights & Analytics. This person will be commercial team’s primary research expert, identifying brand growth opportunities and proactively shaping brand strategy and tactics as the market evolves. Role may offer opportunities to support secondary data analytics and/or competitive intelligence depending on business needs and interests.

In this hands-on, highly visible individual contributor role, you will help shape commercial decisions at a small, fast-moving biotech. You will partner with Marketing, Sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations and present recommendations to senior leaders. Bring curiosity, creativity, technical expertise, analytical rigor, sound business judgment, and strong communication skills to proactively identify research needs and translate findings into evidence-backed decisions and actions.

Experience integrating primary research with secondary data analytics, and/or competitive intelligence is a strong plus.

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Own and lead market research**

* Develop and own market research roadmap, prioritizing the most important business questions about launch performance, support indication expansion, customer segmentation, forecast inputs, competitive response, and landscape assessment, including syndicated reports. Address these questions through research with healthcare professionals (HCPs), patients, and allied healthcare professionals.
* Independently translate business questions into research objectives and select fit-for-purpose qualitative and quantitative approaches. Scope and design research instruments, including survey instruments, discussion guides, stimuli, presentations, and other relevant deliverables.
* Proactively drive thoughtful analytics leveraging market research data to uncover actionable insights that inform business decisions.

### **Deliver insights that drive decisions**

* Analyze and synthesize research into clear, concise stories that answer the business question, explain the implications, and recommend action tied to business impact.
* Deliver presentations to senior leadership and cross-functional teams with clarity and command.
* Where relevant, integrate primary research with secondary data analytics, and competitive intelligence to give stakeholders a holistic view of the market and the brand.

### **Manage execution and vendors**

* Execute research in accordance with applicable data privacy, data governance, fair market value, and external stakeholder engagement requirements, coordinating with relevant internal partners throughout study design and execution.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects to timelines and quality standards.
* Drive and monitor analytics with research vendors, critically evaluating methods, data quality, analysis, and interpretation to ensure technical rigor, accuracy, relevance, and meticulous quality across all deliverables.
* Provide input into vendor selection; lead day-to-day vendor communication and oversight; ensure alignment with business needs and on-time delivery; and raise risks and issues early.

### **Partner across the business**

* Partner with Marketing, Sales, Market Access, Medical Affairs, and Commercial Operations to understand their business needs, identify critical insight gaps, and shape research priorities. Build strong working relationships that keep the research agenda connected to the decisions each function needs to make.
* Contribute research insights to brand planning, launch planning, and quarterly business reviews.
* Act as a thought partner who builds alignment on research strategy and implications.

**Qualifications**
------------------

### **Required**

* Bachelor's degree; advanced degree (MBA, MS, MPH, or related field) strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of market research or insights experience, with hands-on experience supporting a product launch and tracking performance in a dynamic market. Pharmaceutical or biotech, consulting experience is preferred; experience supporting a launch is ideal.
* Advanced expertise in designing and executing both qualitative and quantitative primary research, with the judgment to choose the right methodology and to interpret directional vs. statistically significant results.
* Proven ability to independently own research projects end to end, from scoping to final readout, with minimal oversight.
* Ability to synthesize complex data into a clear story and a recommendation, and to present it with confidence to senior stakeholders.
* Ability to interpret secondary data and integrate it with primary research, including assessing data limitations.
* Strong critical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to proactively clarify business context and make trade-off recommendations.
* Track record of managing external research vendors and timelines across multiple priorities.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, at the pace of a small, agile biotech, and in a fast-changing competitive landscape; collaborative and open communicator who builds trust across functions.
* Willingness to travel up to 25%: Periodic travel is expected for team meetings, national and regional sales meetings, and onsite collaboration weeks at the Brisbane, CA headquarters.

  

### **Preferred**

* Experience with secondary data and analytics, such as syndicated and claims data (e.g., IQVIA, Symphony Health, Komodo), specialty pharmacy or patient services data, or brand and launch performance analytics.
* Experience in competitive intelligence, including tracking competitor developments and translating them into implications for the brand.
* Experience in rare disease, specialty, or nephrology/immunology markets.
* Experience applying emerging AI methods to research and insights (e.g., text analytics, AI-assisted synthesis, advanced segmentation), and comfort exploring new tools and approaches to improve speed and efficiency.

Vera Therapeutics Inc. is an equal-opportunity employer.

Vera Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

For this role, the anticipated base pay range is

$185,000 - $225,000 USD

At Vera, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Vera Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, flexible time off, and a number of paid holidays.

**Notice to Recruiters/Staffing Agencies**

Recruiters and staffing agencies should not contact Vera Therapeutics through this page. All recruitment vendors (search firms, recruitment agencies, and staffing companies) are prohibited from contacting our hiring manager(s), executive team members, or employees.

We require that all recruiters and staffing agencies have a fully executed, formal written agreement on file.

Vera Therapeutics’ receipt or acceptance of an unsolicited resume submitted by a vendor organization to this website or employee does not constitute an actual or implied contract between Vera Therapeutics and such organization and will be considered unsolicited and Vera Therapeutics will not be responsible for related fees.

**Fraud Alert**

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are a top priority for us. At Vera Therapeutics, recruiters only direct candidates to apply through our official career page at https://veratx.com/careers/.

Recruiters will always contact you using the domain of veratx.com. We will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information like social security numbers. If you are unsure if a message is from Vera Therapeutics, please email human resources.

**CA Privacy Notice**

Applicants residing in California should review our California Privacy Notice for Employees, Job Applicants, and Contractors, which describes the categories of personal information we collect, how we use it, and your privacy rights under the California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act: https://veratx.com/ca-privacy/.

**SUMMARY**
-----------

This employee is responsible for various clerical and administrative tasks to support the administrative needs of the District Attorney’s Office and its professional staff and ensure efficient operation of the office. Specific job duties will vary based on the assignment to the particular division of the District Attorney’s Office. Generally, responsibilities include, but are not limited to: answering phones, typing, transcriptions, drafting documents and correspondence, filing court documents, preparing witness subpoenas, maintaining appointment calendars, maintaining internal office records, processing paperwork, collecting files to be handled in court during criminal lists, and other tasks as assigned by the Supervising Secretary, Assistant Chief, Division Chief, or Chief of Staff. Office Support Staff will regularly interact with other employees of the District Attorney’s Office, other county agencies and members of the public. They are expected to be cordial and professional at all times.

  
  

* **Position covered by a collective bargaining agreement.**

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**
-----------------------------------------

* Provide administrative support to ensure efficient operation of the Office.
* Answer phone calls, answer basic questions, and either direct the calls as appropriate or take messages.
* Maintain calendar, coordinate and schedule meetings.
* Perform miscellaneous clerical tasks such as: typing, filing, copying, scanning documents, etc.
* Prepare and send out subpoenas to victims, witnesses and law enforcement for court proceedings.
* Record and submit monthly expense reports for attorneys.
* Transcribe recordings.
* Draft, format and file legal documents with supervision of legal staff.
* Assist attorneys with preparing criminal files for court.
* Assist with records management, storage and destruction.
* Other tasks as needed to support the administrative needs of the Office and professional staff.

------------------------------

* Typing/Word Processing skills.
* Telephone manners.
* Communication skills, both verbal and written.
* Grammar & spelling skills.
* Schedule flexibility.
* Knowledge of Office policy/procedure.
* Knowledge of Office mission/structure.
* Knowledge of Criminal Procedure Rules.
* Knowledge of Office organization and mission.
* Must be able to work under pressure and maintain composure under stressful situations.

--------------------

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision and depth perception.

fca1eb283d87618a544c.description:
About Us:

We specialize in providing non-core, mission critical facilities maintenance and management services to large organizations with geographically dispersed properties in various industries such as retail, restaurants, banking, telecommunications, and others with multi-location business operations.

Job Summary:

The Facilities Coordinator is a key contributor in the execution of USM’s customer commitments. This position is responsible for being the first point of contact for customers and suppliers, providing accurate and timely information, assisting customers and suppliers with their concerns and resolving issues when applicable, managing voicemail, and 3rd party systems. This position works in partnership with other members of the team to ensure all services issues are addressed in a timely manner based on the requirements of the customers and suppliers, and has a significant responsibility directly impacting business profitability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

Answers and completes inbound/outbound communications (phone, email, etc.) as assigned. Projects a professional and positive image of USM to all customers and suppliers. Documents all notes/issues/escalations in company’s work order management system (NAS) so that they can be acted upon in a timely and accurate manner.

  

Resolves service issues with customers and suppliers when applicable and escalates when appropriate.

  

Manages recurring services and their statuses as well as all additional customer requests (above scope and on-demand services) from obtaining quotes and writing proposals to service completion/verification.

Reviews daily, weekly, and monthly Integrated Voice Response (IVR) reporting for exceptions and addresses with appropriate parties via telephone and email, as applicable.

Reviews and analyzes field inspection reports submitted by Field associates and enters appropriate work orders or issues into proprietary database.

(prior years’ work/related experience)

SIMA certified, NALP certified, Licensed Irrigator, and/or horticultural degree preferred

Professional, friendly demeanor with a customer- oriented attitude.

Experience in floor care, landscaping/snow removal, building repair and maintenance, or the trades (HVAC, Floor Care, Electrical, Plumbing, and /or Roofing) preferred.
