88298d1ff9ff5f6965d6.title: EverPro - Marketing Automation Manager (Remote, US)
88298d1ff9ff5f6965d6.description:
EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically-tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Its modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. With its EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell brands specializing in Home, Health, and Wellness service industries, EverCommerce provides end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications. Learn more at EverCommerce.com.

We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our Company, Culture and Values here: https://www.evercommerce.com/about-us/careers/

**EverPro,** a business within EverCommerce, provides software and solutions designed to help home and field service businesses run and grow their companies with greater efficiency and confidence. EverPro brings together purpose-built tools across key trades—including field service, remodeling and roofing, landscaping, and pest and lawn—so service professionals can manage operations, engage customers, and drive long-term growth.

Our solutions support the full lifecycle of running a service business, from scheduling and dispatching work, to estimating, invoicing, and payments, to customer communication, reputation management, and business insights. Together, these connected solutions help service pros win more jobs, save time, and build stronger, more resilient businesses.

We’re looking for a **Marketing Automation Manager** to join the EverPro Lifecycle Marketing team, supporting two fast-growing mobile invoicing products: **Joist** and **Invoice Simple**.

In this role, you’ll be responsible for **designing, building, and operating scalable lifecycle journeys** that support customer engagement, feature adoption, retention, and revenue growth. You’ll translate lifecycle campaign direction into high-quality execution across email, push notifications, and in-app messaging—ensuring journeys are reliable, maintainable, and effective.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **owning execution and systems**, takes pride in quality and operational excellence, and wants to deepen their expertise in marketing automation within a Product-Led Growth (PLG) environment.

**Responsibilities:**

Campaign Execution & Delivery

* Build and launch multichannel campaigns in Braze across email, push, and in-app messaging.
* Implement personalization, dynamic content, and behavioral targeting.
* Own campaign QA, testing, and accurate, on-time deployment.
* Support localization and coordinated campaign delivery as needed.

Data, Eventing & Technical Reliability

* Manage customer events, attributes, event properties, and data logic used in lifecycle automation.
* Validate data accuracy, event tracking, and trigger functionality.
* Troubleshoot data and integration issues with Data, Product, and Engineering teams.

Journey Governance & Monitoring

* Monitor journey health, audience flows, and delivery performance.
* Maintain frequency caps, suppression rules, and cross-journey coordination.
* Identify and resolve execution risks to protect customer experience and reliability.

Experimentation & Optimization

* Configure A/B tests, control groups, and experiment variants with accurate audience allocation.
* Ensure test setup, tracking, and measurement align with experiment requirements.
* Monitor experiment integrity, flag anomalies, and support optimization.

Automation Scalability & Improvement

* Develop reusable templates, journey frameworks, and documentation.
* Improve automation efficiency, reliability, and operational processes.
* Establish and maintain automation standards and best practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner with Lifecycle Marketing Managers, Creative, Analytics, Data, Product, and Engineering teams.
* Provide technical guidance, identify dependencies, and recommend practical solutions.
* Manage competing priorities while maintaining execution quality
  

  

**Skills and Experience needed for success in this role:**

* 4+ years of experience in marketing automation, CRM operations, or related roles.
* Hands-on experience building automated journeys in Braze or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of customer data, events, attributes, segmentation, personalization, and journey logic.
* Experience troubleshooting data, targeting, trigger, and integration issues.
* Experience implementing A/B tests, control groups, and experiment measurement.
* Strong knowledge of journey governance, QA, suppression rules, and frequency capping.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  

  

**Where:** US Remote
  
The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States – if you’re close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

  

**Benefits and Perks**

* Flexibility to work where/how you want within your country of employment – in-office, remote, or hybrid
* Day 1 access to a robust health and wellness benefits, including an annual wellness stipend
* 401k with up to a 4% match and immediate vesting
* Flexible and generous (FTO) time-off
* Employee Stock Purchase Program

**Compensation:** The target compensation for this position is $70,000 to $80,000 USD per year in most US locations. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including location, local market variances, and candidate experience and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.

  

EverCommerce is an equal opportunity employer and we value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We look forward to reviewing your credentials and getting to know more about your experience!

  
  

EverCommerce uses approved artificial intelligence (“AI”) tools to support its business operations. Employees are encouraged to use authorized AI tools, when appropriate for their roles, to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. All AI use must comply with company policies, including requirements concerning confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, accuracy, and human review. Employees remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-assisted work.

a21e7728a97188cc2809.title: Compliance Officer
a21e7728a97188cc2809.description:
Req Id: 45071

**Job Title:** **Compliance Officer**
=====================================

City: Remote/Virtual

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Purdue Global is seeking an accomplished, forward-thinking Compliance Officer to provide leadership for the university’s compliance, ethics, and enterprise risk management programs.

  

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer and maintaining a collaborative relationship with the Chief Counsel, the Compliance Officer will serve as a strategic advisor to the CEO and university leadership. This individual will establish, guide, and maintain a comprehensive compliance, ethics, and risk mitigation program that supports Purdue Global’s mission while aligning with the Purdue system’s enterprise-wide compliance framework.

  

The Compliance Officer will provide leadership across a complex regulatory landscape that includes federal and state higher education requirements, accreditation, educational technology governance, data privacy, accessibility, multi-state employment compliance, and enterprise risk management. The successful candidate will bring sound judgment, executive presence, and the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical institutional strategies.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Regulatory and Statutory Compliance**

* Direct and oversee compliance strategies related to federal and state higher education regulations.
* Provide institutional leadership regarding Title IV financial aid regulations, Title IX, the Violence Against Women Act, FERPA, and consumer protection disclosure requirements.
* Oversee compliance with State Authorization Reciprocity Agreements and other multi-state authorization requirements affecting online education.
* Monitor federal and state legislative and regulatory developments and lead proactive institutional responses.
* Coordinate compliance activities involving the U.S. Department of Education, Office for Civil Rights, Indiana Commission for Higher Education, state workforce agencies, and other regulatory bodies.

**Enterprise Risk Management and Policy Leadership**

* Design, implement, and lead the university’s enterprise risk management practices in alignment with Purdue system frameworks.
* Identify and assess operational, cybersecurity, financial, academic, regulatory, and reputational risks.
* Collaborate with Purdue system Risk Management and Internal Audit teams.
* Develop compliance dashboards, risk registers, and key risk indicators that support timely decision-making and proactive mitigation.
* Connect risk indicators with Purdue Global quality assurance measures and strategic academic and operational initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Emerging Technology and Digital Learning Governance**

* Participate in enterprise processes that establish and maintain compliance frameworks for artificial intelligence and machine learning in academic and administrative operations.
* Provide leadership regarding artificial intelligence ethics, educational technology governance, and responsible institutional use.
* Champion digital accessibility requirements, including the Americans with Disabilities Act, Sections 504 and 508, and Web Content Accessibility Guidelines.
* Monitor student and employee data privacy requirements under FERPA, state privacy laws, and applicable international frameworks such as the General Data Protection Regulation.
* Partner with the Chief Information Officer and other leaders to address risks associated with remote proctoring, biometric and related data, cloud-hosted instructional tools, and emerging technologies.

**Accreditation**

* Partner with the Chief Academic Officer, academic deans, and accreditation liaisons to support continued compliance with institutional and programmatic accreditation requirements.
* Support compliance with Higher Learning Commission expectations and specialized accrediting bodies.
* Ensure adherence to federal distance education requirements, including Regular and Substantive Interaction standards.

**Audits, Investigations, and Employment Compliance**

* Direct institutional preparation and response for federal compliance audits, annual Single Audits, state agency reviews, and independent evaluations.
* Oversee responses to reports received through the university’s anonymous whistleblower hotline.
* Direct objective, timely, and legally sound reviews of reported noncompliance.
* Collaborate with Human Resources on multi-state employment compliance for a distributed workforce, including requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act, Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, Office of Federal Contract Compliance Programs, and Americans with Disabilities Act.

**Executive Advising and Leadership**

* Serve as a trusted compliance and risk advisor to the CEO and university leadership.
* Prepare and present executive summaries, compliance dashboards, quarterly risk registers, and recommendations to the CEO, university board, and Core Leadership Team.
* Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of compliance directors and specialists.
* Navigate sensitive academic and administrative matters with discretion, diplomacy, and sound judgment.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Master’s degree in higher education administration, public policy, business administration, or a closely related field.
* Ten years of progressively responsible leadership experience in compliance, regulatory affairs, legal services, or risk management.
* At least five years of senior-level leadership experience within a higher education environment.
* Significant experience interpreting and applying U.S. Department of Education regulations, including Title IV, FERPA, and Title IX.
* Experience with multi-state authorization requirements affecting online or distance education.
* Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and managing long-term operational and strategic initiatives.
* Experience designing or coordinating enterprise risk management frameworks in collaboration with internal audit, legal, risk management, or related university functions.
* Strong executive communication, negotiation, mediation, and advisory skills.
* Ability to manage confidential matters and navigate complex academic and administrative decision-making processes.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Juris Doctor degree.
* Advanced knowledge of accreditation, online education, and distance learning regulatory requirements.
* Experience with educational technology governance, artificial intelligence and machine learning compliance, data privacy, and digital accessibility standards.
* Experience developing executive-level risk registers, compliance dashboards, and key risk indicators.
* Compliance leadership experience within a large university system or complex online higher education institution.

**About Purdue Global**
-----------------------

Purdue Global is Purdue University’s online university for working adults. The university provides flexible, career-focused educational opportunities designed to help students develop the knowledge and skills needed to achieve their professional goals.

The Compliance Officer will have the opportunity to shape a comprehensive compliance and risk management program that supports innovation, academic quality, institutional integrity, and responsible growth across a dynamic online university.

**Application Procedures**
--------------------------

This is a remote position. The successful candidate must be able to work effectively within a highly collaborative, geographically distributed environment and may be required to travel periodically for university meetings, audits, regulatory engagements, or other institutional activities.

  

**Application materials should include:**

* A cover letter describing the candidate’s interest in the position and relevant leadership experience
* A current résumé or curriculum vitae
* Contact information for professional references ( references will not be contacted without permission from the candidate)
* Application deadline: December 10, 2026
  

**Additional Information:**

* The anticipated annual salary for this position is $175,000. The final salary offer will be determined based on various factors, including internal equity, available budget, and relevant experience.
* Purdue University Global will not sponsor employment authorization for this position.
* A background check will be required for employment in this position.
* We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions.
* Exempt (Not Eligible For Overtime) This position is generally classified as exempt unless a non-exempt classification is required by applicable state law.

**Job Family**
--------------

Legal and Compliance

**EOE**
-------

Purdue University is an equal opportunity/equal access university. Our goal is to recruit and retain talent from a broad pool of applicants. Purdue Global celebrates a variety of perspectives, experiences, and skills to support a success-focused environment for employees and students. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. All are encouraged to apply.

b29427699591bdf5cb3a.description:
**Job Title:** Regional Sales Manager - Southeast

**Region:** United States: FL, GA, NC, SC, VA, TN, AL, MD, DC, WV, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands

**Reports To:** Senior Regional Sales Manager (SRSM)

**Department:** Business Development

  

**Genea Overview:**

As leaders in property technology, Genea provides cloud-based physical security, submeter billing and on-demand HVAC solutions to over 1 million users across 39 countries. But Genea is more than just a workplace. We’re a mission-driven team that collaborates, innovates, and engineers the proptech solutions of tomorrow to solve the challenges of today. We pride ourselves on fostering an environment of teamwork, transparency and authenticity, where you can be yourself. But don’t take our word for it. Genea has been recognized as a Top Workplace in 2021-2026, with a rating of 4.4 out of 5 stars on Glassdoor. Our team members love our competitive benefits including 401k matching; PTO; 100% paid parental leave; 100% paid employee health, dental and vision benefits; remote work options; and an award-winning workplace culture.

  

**Job Overview:**

The Regional Sales Manager is the on-the-ground partner to the Senior Regional Sales Manager (SRSM), supporting channel management and development efforts in the region they share with their dedicated SRSM for Genea Security. Working closely and reporting directly to the SRSM, this individual extends the team's reach by traveling throughout the territory to deliver demos, visit client sites, meet with partners, and represent Genea at tradeshows, especially when the SRSM is unable to attend. This is a heavy-travel role suited to a motivated solutions salesperson who is building expertise in the channel, SaaS applications, end customers’ adoption of cloud technologies, and go-to-market strategies. This position reports directly to their dedicated SRSM.

  

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Share the regional revenue quota with the SRSM, executing jointly developed sales strategies and using data to forecast and manage activity toward targets and company goals
* Coordinate with partners to execute business plans that meet sales objectives, and train them on Genea's software product portfolio and services
* Travel extensively throughout the territory, with weekly trips to meet with technology partners, VARs, and new and existing customers, including covering demos, client site visits, and events when the SRSM is unavailable
* Track opportunities, leads, and pipeline in accordance with established company processes, keeping the SRSM informed of sales performance, field activity, and customer feedback
* Support the SRSM and partners in preparing sales proposals and quotations to win business
* Help address partner-related issues and sales conflicts in a timely manner, escalating pricing issues to the SRSM
* Stay current with latest developments in marketplace and competitor activities
* Deliver customer presentations and represent Genea at sales meetings, partner conferences, and tradeshows, alongside or on behalf of the SRSM, and support partner marketing campaigns
* Develop expertise in delivering in-person end-user demos of the Genea access control and visitor management solutions
* Work with Operations and Customer Experience teams to ensure new clients are successfully onboarded and that the product they were sold meets or exceeds their expectations
* Collaborate with the Head of Partnerships to identify, recruit, and onboard new channel partners within the assigned territory.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by management

  

**Qualifications:**

* 2+ years of sales experience, preferably with a SaaS or security technology company in a channel environment
* Familiarity with access control and video surveillance solutions preferred
* Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed sales goals by identifying, qualifying, and closing new business
* Experience with CRM tools (Salesforce)
* Strong presentation and communication skills, including comfort delivering live product demos to customers and partners
* Must reside in either Florida or Georgia
* Ability and willingness to travel approximately 75% of the time, including overnight and short-notice trips
* Valid driver's license and clean driving record required for business-related driving
* Bachelor's Degree with a concentration in Business, Communications, or related focus area preferred

  

**Estimated Salary Range:** $110K base salary, with $170K on-target earnings (OTE) including sales commission and bonuses; commission is uncapped

The salary range listed is our best estimate based on the role's requirements and market conditions, but the final offer may be higher or lower depending on the candidate's experience and qualifications.

dffc8c1eb592c7b20adc.title: Systems Administrator, Operational Technology
dffc8c1eb592c7b20adc.description:
RedCloud seeks a **Systems Administrator, Operational Technology** to support immediate client operations.  
  
**Location**: Remote, United States  
  
**Overview:**  
As a Systems Administrator, you will be responsible for deploying, maintaining, and supporting mission-critical enterprise systems, Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure, workstations, and local server environments. You will ensure high availability, performance, and security across multi-platform client environments (Linux and Windows), OT/industrial networks, and supporting infrastructure.  
  
In this role, you will interface closely with internal engineering teams, corporate operations engineers (CorpEng), and third-party vendor teams to troubleshoot complex technical escalations, automate operational workflows, and implement infrastructure enhancements.  
  
**Responsibilities include but are not limited to:**

* System Deployment & Management: Provision, configure, patch, and maintain operating systems across heterogeneous environments (predominantly Debian/Ubuntu-based Linux, macOS, and ChromeOS, with some Windows Server/Client).
* Identity & Access Management: Administer enterprise directory services, single sign-on (SSO), OAuth, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) following strict least-privilege security principles.
* Automation & Scripting: Develop, test, and maintain automation scripts (Python, Bash, or PowerShell) to streamline routine system maintenance, configuration management, and log auditing.
* Incident & Problem Management: Serve as Tier 2/Tier 3 escalation support for high-impact system incidents, providing root-cause analysis (RCA), documentation, and remediation.
* Hardware, OT & Data Center Operations: Manage lifecycle and maintenance of local on-prem server racks, OT/SCADA systems, storage arrays (NAS/SAN), industrial network switches, and uninterruptible power supplies (UPS).
* Monitoring & Reliability: Monitor system health, system resource utilization, and uptime using observability platforms; respond to service alerts and threshold breaches.
* Security & Compliance: Ensure all managed endpoints and servers adhere strictly to corporate security baselines, encryption standards, vulnerability patching cycles, and asset inventory controls.
* Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Author and update technical runbooks, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and architecture diagrams.
* IT/OT Security & Group Policy Management: Design, deploy, and enforce enterprise Group Policy Objects (GPOs), Active Directory policies, and IT/OT security configurations to secure control networks and maintain system compliance across enterprise environments.

**Required knowledge, skills, and abilities:**

* Experience: 3+ years of professional hands-on experience in system administration, IT infrastructure support, or corporate systems engineering.
* OS Expertise: Strong administration, configuration, and troubleshooting skills in Linux (Debian, Ubuntu, or RHEL) and/or Windows at the command-line level.
* Networking Fundamentals: Solid grasp of core networking protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and SSH).
* Scripting: Demonstrated ability to read, write, and debug basic scripts in Bash or Python to automate administrative tasks.
* Enterprise Tools: Experience managing systems using configuration management tools (e.g., Puppet, Ansible, SaltStack, or Chef) and Mobile Device Management (MDM / Jamf).

**Preferred qualifications:**

* OT & SCADA Systems: Hands-on experience with SCADA systems, industrial control networks, and operational technology (OT) security/monitoring infrastructure.
* Directory & Auth Systems: Hands-on experience with LDAP, Google Workspace Enterprise Administration, Kerberos, or SAML-based identity providers.
* Hardware Lifecycle: Practical experience with enterprise-grade server hardware installation, cabling, and basic data closet/IDF maintenance.
* Security Acumen: Familiarity with Zero Trust network models (e.g., BeyondCorp architecture) and modern endpoint detection and response (EDR) platforms.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  
US: $115,000 - $133,000(USD)+ bonus programs + benefits.  
  
Benefits and bonus information can be found at https://www.redcloudconsulting.com/careers  
  
RedCloud requires employees have the legal ability to work in the country hired during their employment period. During onboarding, proof of eligibility to work in the applicable country will be requested. RedCloud does not provide visa sponsorship.  
  
**About Us:**  
RedCloud Consulting is a global business and technology consulting firm supporting clients across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East. For more than two decades, RedCloud has partnered with organizations ranging from high-growth mid-market companies to global enterprises, helping them solve complex business and operational challenges—leveraging modern data platforms, artificial intelligence, and secure digital foundations to drive smarter decisions and scalable outcomes.  
  
Anchored in a foundation of *integrity-based consulting*, RedCloud brings together senior-level experts who work side by side with client teams to design and implement durable, high-impact solutions. Our approach emphasizes trust, accountability, and long-term value—balancing stability, growth, and innovation to help organizations operate securely and confidently in an increasingly complex global environment.  
  
RedCloud delivers a comprehensive range of services across its core practices: **Data & AI, Delivery Excellence, Digital Solutions, Marketing & Sales, Privacy, Security, Data Center and Critical Infrastructure Security, and Strategy & Transformation**. As our clients expand globally, so do we—providing consistent, expert support across regions while remaining agile, collaborative, and deeply invested in client success.  
  
Recognized for both performance and culture, RedCloud has been named #1 Best Company to Work For in Washington (Mid-Sized Businesses) by *Seattle Business Magazine*, a “Fastest Growing Company” multiple times on the *Inc. 500/5000* list, and recognized by Consulting Magazine as a Leader in Technology Consulting.

d0f4aeb0c2aee96a71c4.description:
**Job Summary**

As a Marketing Operations Manager, you’ll build and improve the systems that help marketing teams plan campaigns, reach the right audiences, and understand results. You’ll lead marketing operations across multichannel and B2B marketing, connecting demand generation, lead generation, and sales processes through effective technology and data practices.

**Duties**

* Manage marketing automation and email campaign management, including campaign setup, email automation, lead segmentation, and product market segmentation.
* Administer and implement marketing automation tools and CRM systems, such as Marketo, Salesforce, Eloqua, HubSpot, Pardot, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
* Monitor digital marketing performance and deliver web analytics reporting using Google Analytics and other data analytics tools.
* Apply data analysis and attribution modeling to assess campaign performance and guide marketing decisions.
* Coordinate marketing project management and cross-functional collaboration across marketing, sales, and technical teams. **Your impact:** Clearer campaign insights help marketing and sales teams focus on relevant audiences and improve follow-up.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, email marketing, digital marketing, and demand generation marketing.
* CRM system proficiency and experience with email marketing software and marketing analytics.
* Data analysis skills, including familiarity with SQL and data analytics tools.
* Technical proficiency with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to support campaign setup and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of multichannel marketing, digital marketing performance monitoring, web analytics reporting, and attribution modeling.

Pay: $70,300.00 - $160,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule

87b83fa1cb2d61119b77.title: Clinical Services Associate
87b83fa1cb2d61119b77.description:
**Description**

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Clinical Services Associate (Medical Assistant)**

**Entity: (Clinical Care Associates) /Penn Primary Care (PPC) and Penn Specialty Practices (PSP)**

**Department: Chestnut Hill Family Practice**

**Location: Penn Family Medicine Chestnut Hill - 906 Bethlehem Pike AND 8200 Flourtown Avenue, Suite 2, Wyndmoor (could work out of either location)**

**Hours: Full Time**

**\*\*Please upload your Medical Assistant Diploma, Medical Assistant Certificate, and BLS certification card with application. \*\***

**Summary:**

The Clinical Services Associates (CSA) (MEDICAL ASSISTANT) assists the practice manager and physicians in maintaining a patient/customer focus, supports the delivery of high-quality care, shares a passion for patient and customer centered care, and assists in meeting or exceeding patient satisfaction and financial/operational targets. The CSA supports the practice by performing clinical and administrative duties as a Medical Assistant and as a Patient Services Associate. The practice will determine, based on operational need, how much time will be spent in each capacity (MA and PSA).

Are you looking for an organization that actively supports your career growth? If so, a Clinical Services Associate opportunity at Penn Medicine can help get you there! Clinical Services Associates have an opportunity to join our organization and make a difference in the lives of our patients. Clinical Services Associates with Penn Medicine are in a unique position to gain valuable knowledge which can be leveraged to move not only into more advanced clinical roles but also operational roles. Through our generous tuition benefit as well as our commitment to promoting from within Penn Medicine sees more than 30% of our employees secure advancement opportunities into roles such as a Clinical Services Coordinator, Nurses, and Practice Managers just to name a few!

Penn Medicine employees enjoy a comprehensive benefit package to include generous paid time off and paid holidays. And health insurance premiums which have remained flat for 5 years!

Want to hear more? Submit your application today for this Clinical Services Associate opportunity and learn more about what a career path at Penn Medicine could look like for you!

**Responsibilities:**

Patient Care Accountabilities:

* Promptly rooms patients, using EMR to alert provider that patient is ready: reviews past medical, surgical, family, smoking history, allergies, medications; notes corrections in EMR, notes medication refills needed for the physician to review, initiates self-management goal setting where appropriate, obtains patient’s vital signs and documents in EMR, prepares chart for patient visit, understands insurance restrictions for lab work, referral needs, precertification requirements, etc.
* Observes patient condition and communicates any abnormal data or changes to provider.
* Assist patients as needed with walking, transfers, dressing, undressing, preparing for the exam, remains in exam room when necessary/requested.
* Specimen management: obtain specimens for testing if applicable (including performing phlebotomy and anterior nares nasal swab collections), performs laboratory and screening tests, records results in EMR and reconciles with logs where appropriate, documents and reports findings to providers, performs all quality controls as per Point of Care Testing guidelines, prepares specimens for transport as necessary.
* Performs EKGs and other outpatient screening tests as per MD order and after properly preparing the patient; accurately documents results in EMR.
* Assists with minor surgical procedures by handing instruments, maintaining sterile field, positioning of patient and other duties within scope of responsibility. Functions as a witness for procedural consents if required.
* Responds appropriately to emergency/code situations.
* CCA CSAs, if applicable as per regulatory guidelines administers prescribed medications, gives injections and vaccines; reads PPD results, under the direction of the provider/orders and documents in EMR.
* Demonstrates competence in the observation, treatment, and care of the specific patients served in that practice, whose ages may range from neonate to geriatric.

Clerical / Other Accountabilities:

* Responsive and proactive telephonic patient care - including care coordination with specialists, ancillary services, hospitals, labs, home care agencies, and all other involved health services.
* Obtain and scan documents as appropriate and required for visit: test results, faxes, reports, notes, referrals, etc.
* Completes medical forms and other clinical requests for information as appropriate and required. Prepares and sends patient correspondence as required. Assists nursing staff with the maintenance of patient education materials, as needed.
* CCA CSAs: Promptly performs call-backs as directed by provider, giving patients information within their scope of practice. Provides patients with follow up care instructions.

Environmental / Safety Accountabilities:

* Adheres to universal body fluids precautions and infection control policies. Disposes of infectious waste properly. Promotes infection control by using appropriate hand washing techniques.
* Ensures that the patient care areas are kept neat, orderly, well stocked and properly prepared.
* Cleans, disinfects, and sterilizes instruments and equipment according to protocols and checks that the instruments and equipment are in proper working order. Notifies Supervisor of malfunctions. Sets up equipment and instruments as per practice protocol.
* Cleans and restocks equipment as needed. Authorized to access secured area to obtain items such as intravenous solutions and medication preparation supplies for the purpose of stocking and maintaining pars in the medication carts. Retrieves supplies and medications/blood products from tube system. Secures stock items in appropriate location. Delivers patient specific medications/blood products to the assigned nurse or provider.
* Maintain temperature log for refrigerator or room temperature as needed.
* Maintains a safe environment and protects the patient from injury by observing the patient who may be at risk for falls, confusion, disorientation, or wandering behaviors.
* CCA CSAs if applicable as per regulatory guidelines: Maintains medication storage closet inventory and security; checks expiration dates; removes outdated items. Performs daily code/crash cart checks as assigned.

Patient Service:

* Strives to understand and anticipate patient needs, manages service recovery efforts when needed, enlisting management assistance as appropriate, identifies opportunities to improve the patient experience.
* As per practice/department protocols and/or measurements: answer phones in a timely manner, manage/handle patient requests and route appropriately, retrieve voicemails in a timely manner, take accurate and thorough messages and route appropriately through EMR.
* Schedule patient appointments (on phone or in person) by determining reason for visit, following established schedules and protocols, using appropriate billing area/appointment location, communicating changes and confirming appointments, and as needed, offering alternative and canceling/rescheduling appointments.
* Responsible for arriving/departing activities of patient at practice and performs point of service activities collects copays and records accurately, obtains necessary signatures/forms, obtaining insurance cards and referrals/authorizations, updates appointment status in EMR, and finalizes all check-out procedures.
* Communicates with patients regarding patient flow and wait times – keeps manager aware of potential issues as they arise.
* Issues referrals and obtains pre-authorizations for patients as required and as per protocol.

Financial:

* Maintains up to date knowledge of insurance requirements pertinent to patient service and billing procedures: including basic knowledge of all managed care plans and which insurers require a copayment or referral.
* Validates patient demographic/insurance information and/or registers new patients into EMR using established protocols
* Records receipts accurately to ensure end of day reconciliation; participates in cash reconciliation delineations.
* Resolves work queues and/or issues from front-end reports; proactively prioritizes recovery of missing charges.
* Orders supplies for the office and generate front-end process reports as requested.

Other / Regulatory:

* Ensures compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulatory standards (ex TJC, DOH, FDA, HIPAA, HCFA, DPW, LCGME, SCGME, etc)
* Flexible and readily adopts new processes and engages in practice operation changes.

  

**Credentials:**

* BLS/CPR, as a healthcare provider per the American Heart Association Required
* MA Certification (Required within 90 days of hire ONLY if position is in PA. Must have at time of offer in NJ.)

Education or Equivalent Experience:

* H.S. Diploma/GED Required
* Completion of an accredited Medical Assistant program (or higher-level equivalent) Required
* + OR 18 months of experience working as an MA may be considered in lieu of MA program completion.
  + OR 1+ year working as a Clinical Support Representative at Penn Medicine may be considered in lieu of MA program completion.
* 2+ years’ Medical Office or Customer Service experience.
* Associate’s degree preferred.

We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits program that includes one of the finest prepaid tuition assistance programs in the region. Penn Medicine employees are actively engaged and committed to our mission. Together we will continue to make medical advances that help people live longer, healthier lives.  
  
Live Your Life's Work

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. Candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, marital status, familial status, genetic information, domestic or sexual violence victim status, citizenship status, military status, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable law.

9f76d3f6ced58b8ef682.title: Lawn Care Customer Service Supervisor
9f76d3f6ced58b8ef682.description:
Description:

**Join the #1 Locally Owned Lawn Care Company in the Tri-State Area**

Green Lawn Fertilizing is proud to be the #1 locally owned and operated lawn care company serving Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and Delaware. Since 2004, we've grown to become one of the **Top 10 Lawn Care Companies in the U.S.** (as recognized by *Landscape Magazine*) and for the eighth consecutive year in 2026, have been **recognized as one of the “Top 100 Best Places to Work”** by the *Philadelphia Business Journal*.

We are consistently named one of the fastest-growing companies in the region by both the *Philadelphia 100* and *Fast 50*. Our growth is driven by one thing: an exceptional team dedicated to providing 5-star service to our customers every day.

Our mission is simple: to be the leader in the lawn care and pest control industry by delivering a superior customer experience. That starts with hiring exceptional people—like you.

**Lawn Care Customer Service Supervisor**

The Lawn Care Customer Service Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and managing the daily operations of the Customer Service Department for Green Lawn Fertilizing. This position leads both Residential and Commercial Customer Service Representatives, ensuring exceptional customer experiences, efficient department operations, and consistent service quality.

The ideal candidate is a strong leader who enjoys developing employees, resolving customer concerns, improving processes, and motivating a team to achieve department goals. This role plays an important part in customer satisfaction, employee development, and maintaining our high standards of customer service.

**What You'll Do**

**Position Details:**

* **Schedule:** Full-time, Monday–Friday, with occasional Saturdays based on business needs.
* **Hours:** Flexible scheduling, either 8:00 AM–5:00 PM or 8:30 AM–6:00 PM.
* **Team Leadership:** Oversee and lead both Residential and Commercial Customer Service Representatives.
* **Meetings:** Attend daily huddles with the Office Manager, conduct weekly 1:1 meetings with Customer Service Representatives, assist with bi-weekly office meetings, and participate in weekly management meetings.

**Education & Experience:**

* Degree in Business Administration or Business Management, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Prior experience as a Call Center Manager or Customer Care Manager is required.
* Experience overseeing customer service teams and managing daily call center operations is preferred

Requirements:

* Strong understanding of business CRM systems and the ability to quickly learn new software.
* Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, Outlook, and other related applications.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including strong active listening abilities.
* Customer-service-oriented with the ability to professionally handle and resolve customer concerns and grievances.
* Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
* Excellent grammar, attention to detail, and a positive attitude.
* Highly detail-oriented with a strong focus on accuracy.
* Effective time management skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and maintain excellent organizational skills.
* Attentive, patient, and able to remain professional when handling challenging situations.
* Ability to inspire, motivate, and develop team members.
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive working relationships across the team.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to sit for prolonged periods while working at a desk and using a computer.
* Ability to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Oversees both Residential and Commercial Customer Service Representatives and manage daily department operations.
* Handle customer inquiries and complaints, focusing on providing first-call resolution.
* Resolve escalated customer calls and service-related concerns.
* Monitor customer satisfaction, customer reviews, and overall service quality.
* Implement strategies and process improvements to enhance the customer experience.
* Train, supervise, and develop Customer Service Representatives.
* Analyze department data and performance metrics to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Conduct role-playing exercises and provide coaching to improve call quality and customer interactions.
* Maintain staffing levels at or above budgeted headcount.
* Recruit, interview, onboard, and train new team members.
* Collaborate with other department heads to ensure seamless customer interactions across the organization.

214a2fb01e8dd2790953.description:
Who We Are
  
Wellcove has been recognized as the nation’s leading full-service senior market solutions provider for over 25 years. Our solutions span the insurance senior market sector, focusing on long-term care and Medicare Supplement plans. However, we don’t stop there. Wellcove also addresses challenges faced in accident & health, disability, and supplemental health insurance programs.
  
  
Our team provides individuals and their families with peace of mind knowing their insurance needs will be met in a thoughtful, efficient manner. We are able to do this because of our dedicated associates, innovative solutions, and state-of-the-art technology.
  
  
Customer Support Representative
  
Job Purpose
  
The purpose of the Customer Support Representative for Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) and Facility Verification Department is to provide seamless support to clients by managing the usage, and compliance of the EVV and Facility systems/platforms. The Customer Support Representative offers retraining, troubleshooting, and ongoing guidance to enhance system efficiency, improve client satisfaction, and ensure the accurate and compliant delivery of Home Care and Facility invoices to LTC insurance carriers.
  
  
**Duties/Responsibilities:**  

* Serve as a point of contact for clients utilizing Wellcove’s EVV and Facility platforms, addressing inquiries and resolving issues promptly.
* Assist claimants, caregivers, home care agencies, and facilities in ongoing inquiries regarding the EVV and Facility platforms.
* Provide training and guidance to clients on the use of EVV and Facility platforms, tools, and processes.
* Gather required information from clients accurately record data in Wellcove’s platforms/systems.
* Maintain organized documentation for all client interactions, training sessions, and compliance activities.
* Provide outstanding customer service via phone and email, displaying professionalism, empathy, a sense of urgency, and a genuine willingness to help.
* Independently process caller requests accurately and promptly in Wellcove’s proprietary system and escalate as appropriate.
* Comply with customer support objectives and performance standards.
* Effective use of process resources to gain knowledge base and ensure the delivery of accurate information and error-free processing of requests.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**  

* Excellent computer skills including proficiency with Microsoft office applications.
* Accountable and able to work remotely and independently.
* Displays a positive ‘can do’/customer-first attitude.
* Excellent communication skills and appropriate etiquette, great phone manners, and ability to speak with a wide range of personalities. Demonstrate a high level of proficiency in the use of the English language in oral and written forms.
* Willingness to learn new duties and technology-related skills as required.
* Ability to effectively multi-task.
* Collaborative team spirit.
* Ability to pass background screening and drug test (includes marijuana).
* Ability to provide responses from three professional references.
* Able to provide a dedicated remote work location free from background noises, interruptions and desk clutter.
* Able to provide reliable internet connection and access to a smart phone.

**Education and Experience:**  

* Bachelor’s Degree, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience preferred.
* High School or GED required

**Physical Requirements:**  

* Sedentary work. Repetitive motion. Substantial movements (motions) of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers. The worker is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity such as: preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; extensive reading. Work is performed in an office environment and requires the ability to operate standard office equipment and keyboards.

At Wellcove, we strive to create an inclusive culture for all. We understand the importance of listening and incorporating various perspectives at every level of service. Our company does not discriminate based on gender identity, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or disability.

==================================================

**Build a Career Where Professionalism, Reliability, and Service Matter**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Disabled Veteran Solutions (DVS) is hiring dependable, technically skilled Customer Service Representatives to support essential programs serving individuals and communities nationwide.

We're looking for experienced customer service professionals who are confident managing inbound calls, navigating multiple computer systems, solving problems, and providing accurate, compassionate assistance.

**This is a structured, performance-driven remote call center position-not a flexible, work-at-your-own-pace opportunity.**

If you're someone who takes pride in being dependable, communicating professionally, and delivering excellent service, we'd love to learn more about you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

As an Inbound Customer Service Representative, you will:

* Handle inbound customer calls with professionalism, patience, and efficiency.
* Research customer inquiries and provide accurate information using multiple computer applications.
* Perform basic technical troubleshooting and create support tickets when needed.
* Schedule appointments and assist customers with service-related processes.
* Maintain accurate, detailed documentation of customer interactions.
* Conduct follow-up calls when necessary.
* Follow established procedures, privacy requirements, and quality standards.
* Meet established expectations for attendance, productivity, service quality, and professionalism.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Previous customer service experience in a professional, customer-facing environment.
* Strong computer proficiency, including the ability to navigate multiple applications and browser windows efficiently.
* Ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and effectively with English-speaking customers, both verbally and in writing.
* Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and ability to follow written instructions.
* Ability to manage customer interactions while accurately documenting information.
* Dependability and ability to maintain a consistent work schedule.
* Ability to work independently while remaining engaged with a remote team.
* Ability to complete applicable pre-employment screening and credentialing requirements.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 1–2 years of high-volume inbound call center experience.
* Previous remote customer service or technical support experience.
* Experience supporting healthcare, insurance, financial services, or government-related programs.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, CRM systems, and web-based customer service applications.
* Bilingual communication skills (English/Spanish).

**Remote Work Requirements**
----------------------------

Successful candidates must be able to maintain:

* Reliable high-speed internet with a wired Ethernet connection; Wi-Fi alone does not meet the connection requirement.
* A professional, private workspace suitable for handling confidential customer information.
* The ability to remain focused, available, and engaged throughout assigned working hours.
* The ability to meet established technical and connectivity standards.

**Training, SchedulingAttendance**
----------------------------------

DVS provides structured training to help new employees build the knowledge and skills needed for success.

**Initial Paid Training**

* Duration: First two weeks.
* Schedule: 9:00 AM–4:30 PM Eastern, Monday–Friday.
* Attendance is 100% required for all scheduled training sessions.

**Regular Work Schedule**

* Full-time position.
* Assigned shifts within Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–9:00 PM Eastern.
* Specific schedules are established based on operational requirements.

Consistent attendance, punctuality, and active participation are essential to success in this position.

**Pre-Employment Requirements**
-------------------------------

Selected candidates will be required to complete applicable pre-employment requirements, which may include:

* Criminal background screening.
* Drug screening.
* Employment documentation and verification.
* Client-specific credentialing or security requirements.
* Required onboarding documentation.

Candidates will receive detailed instructions and applicable completion deadlines. Timely completion of these requirements is important to maintaining the anticipated start date.

**Why Join Disabled Veteran Solutions?**
----------------------------------------

DVS is a certified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business committed to delivering exceptional service while creating meaningful employment opportunities.

When you join our team, you'll be part of an organization that values:

* **Purpose:** Supporting meaningful programs that serve individuals and communities.
* **Professionalism:** Taking pride in doing the job well.
* **Teamwork:** Working alongside colleagues who support one another.
* **Accountability:** Recognizing and rewarding dependable performance.
* **Development:** Opportunities to build valuable professional skills.

**Ready to Join Our Team?**
---------------------------

We're seeking individuals who are serious about building a successful remote customer service career and who are prepared to bring professionalism, technical confidence, and reliability to work every day.

If this sounds like you, we encourage you to apply.

**Disabled Veteran Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** Employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

Posting Title: Behavioral Health Patient Support Specialist (Remote) Overview:

The Behavioral Health (BH) Patient Support Specialist reports to Behavioral Health Support Services Coordinator or in lieu the VP of Operations-Behavioral Health and is a member of the Behavioral Health team. This role is responsible for delivering consistent, high-quality customer service to both internal team members and patients. The BH Patient Support Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient access and ongoing care coordination. This includes managing inbound and outbound patient communications, scheduling follow-up appointments, assisting with online check-in, updating and verifying patient insurance information, reviewing and collecting patient balances, coordinating with the billing team for escalation when necessary, and otherwise supporting patients in accessing virtual visits for behavioral health as needed. The BH Patient Support Specialist will listen to patient needs and take appropriate action, including documenting patient encounters, coordinating with providers regarding patient concerns, communicating with the Behavioral Health nursing team for medication or clinical referral requests, and coordinating records requests with both our internal BH records specialists and general medical records department. This role requires strong attention to detail, efficiency, and a commitment to providing a positive patient experience. The Patient Support Specialist will demonstrate proficiency in data entry, scheduling, and insurance processes while maintaining strict confidentiality and compliance with company standards. It is essential that they demonstrate efforts to maintain and improve job-specific competencies and perform other duties as assigned.

Why Choose Fast Pace Health?:

Fast Pace Health is a growing company! You will have the support and mentoring you need to become the best Behavioral Health Call Specialist you can be! We will help you grow your clinical competencies, and can offer you a rewarding career path. We work as a dynamic team to surpass our business goals by ensuring our patients receive the best care possible in a positive environment.
  
  
We offer competitive compensation and benefits such as holiday pay, PTO, medical, dental, vision and Work-Life balance, to name a few.
  
  
As a Fast Pace Health employee you will have the opportunity to participate in community events and outreach programs. This includes, but is not limited to, seasonal parades, book drives, festivals, trunk or treating, fun runs, and more. We dress up for holidays and celebrate with pot lucks. At Fast Pace, our community is our family, and we are a family first community.

Responsibilities:

**Essential Functions****:**

* Promote the five principles of Fast Pace: Communication, Teamwork, Empowerment, Quality of Care, and Friendliness
* Answer and coordinate inbound and outbound patient communications
* Triage patient needs and escalates appropriately
* Accurately document telephone encounters in the EHR system
* Schedule, reschedule and confirm intake and follow-up appointments
* Assist patients with online check-in and access to virtual visits
* Verify insurance eligibility and update patient information
* Collect co-pays or applicable fees for services
* Review and collect outstanding patient balances and coordinate with the billing team for escalation when necessary.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient records
* Obtain, upload, and manage required documentation within the EHR
* Register new patients and update demographic information
* Respond appropriately and professionally to escalated or dissatisfied patients
* Review schedules to ensure accuracy and support appointment utilization
* Coordinate with providers, nursing, and pharmacy regarding patient care needs
* Coordinate with Behavioral Health and company-wide records teams for patient requests
* Make reminder calls and/or texts and follow up with patients regarding appointments
* Complete all required compliance training and adhere to company policies
* Maintain professional and respectful relationships with patients, team members, and external partners
* Support a positive, team-oriented work environment
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with all regulatory and company standards

**Non-Essential Functions****:**

* Perform other duties as assigned by management.

Experience Requirements and Preferences::

**Experience:**

* 2+ years of healthcare experience in call center, scheduling, or outpatient clinic setting
* Behavioral health experience preferred
* Strong customer service experience
* Experience with electronic scheduling and EHR systems preferred
* Strong communication and multitasking skills

Education Requirements:: High School Diploma or Its Equivalent Compliance:

Fast Pace Health is committed to the principle of equal employment and creating an inclusive environment for the benefit of our employees, our patients and our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome job applications from qualified individuals without regard to race, creed, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, parental status, genetic information or any other legally protected characteristics or conduct.
  
Please refer to links below for information regarding your rights under certain federal laws:
  
https://www.dol.gov/whd/regs/compliance/posters/fmlaen.pdf
  
https://www.dol.gov/whd/regs/compliance/posters/eppac.pdf

In Mississippi Fast Pace requires pre-employment/drug/alcohol testing as a condition of employment. The law requires that Fast Pace notify applicants, in writing, upon application and prior to the collection of the specimen for drug and alcohol test, that they may be tested for “the presence of drugs [or alcohol] in their metabolites.” Miss. Code. Ann. § 71-7-3(5).

3d149b57541b8357acc5.title: Senior Specialist, Procurement
3d149b57541b8357acc5.description:
**Description of Position**
---------------------------

Reporting to the Director of Procurement & Contract Services, the Senior Procurement Specialist performs advanced professional and technical procurement work supporting the College's mission and responsible stewardship of public funds. The position plans, develops, conducts, evaluates, awards, and administers formal and informal competitive solicitations and contracts across a broad range of commodities, services, technology, equipment, and professional engagements. Current assignments may include information technology and Software-as-a-Service solutions, Career and Technical Education equipment, and marketing and creative services; portfolio assignments may change based on College needs.
  
  
The position partners with academic and administrative departments to translate operational needs into clear specifications and scopes of work; facilitates objective evaluation processes; negotiates commercial and public-sector terms; and maintains complete, auditable procurement and contract records. Work requires sound independent judgment, strong customer service, attention to detail, and consistent application of College policies, applicable Arizona public procurement requirements, grant conditions, and federal regulations when applicable.
  
  
**Please note:** Preference will be given to local Prescott candidates working on-site Monday through Friday, with the opportunity to work remotely one day per week once fully up to speed. Fully remote candidates residing in the greater Phoenix, Arizona area may be considered based on exceptional experience and a willingness to travel to Prescott approximately once per month to work with the team in person. Relocation assistance is not available, and out-of-state candidates will not be considered.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  
1. Solicitations and Strategic Sourcing (35%)

* Plans, drafts, issues, and administers formal and informal solicitations, including Invitations for Bids (IFBs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Qualifications (RFQs), and requests for quotations, from initial planning through award and contract implementation.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include information technology that may include computers, network and classroom technology, enterprise software, cloud-hosted applications, cybersecurity tools, telecommunications, and Software-as-a-Service solutions. Coordinates with Information Technology, data owners, accessibility personnel, and other stakeholders to address information security, privacy, FERPA, data ownership, records retention, integration, service levels, and accessibility documentation such as VPATs and Section 508 conformance.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include Career and Technical Education requirements that may include CNC and manufacturing technology, welding and automotive equipment, simulators, laboratory or instructional systems, specialized tools, and related installation, training, warranty, utility, safety, and maintenance requirements.
* Manages assigned procurements that may include marketing and institutional advancement requirements that may include branding, media buying, digital advertising, website and creative services, photography and video production, printing, promotional products, market research, and related professional services.
* Conducts market research; identifies qualified suppliers and cooperative contracts; analyzes total cost of ownership, pricing structures, licensing metrics, renewal exposure, implementation requirements, warranties, support models, and supplier performance risks.
* Plans and facilitates pre-solicitation meetings, pre-bid conferences, site visits, demonstrations, interviews, and proposal evaluation committees. Trains committee members on confidentiality, conflicts of interest, scoring requirements, documentation, and objective evaluation practices.
* Prepares award recommendations, bid tabulations, evaluation summaries, negotiation documentation, notices, and other procurement records that clearly support the basis for selection and best value determination.

2. Contract Development, Administration, and Compliance (35%)
  

* Reviews, drafts, negotiates, and administers contracts, amendments, renewals, purchase orders, statements of work, software license agreements, SaaS agreements, master service agreements, equipment purchase and maintenance agreements, and professional service agreements within delegated authority.
* Reviews supplier terms for commercial, operational, and public-sector risk, including pricing and escalation, automatic renewal, payment, ownership and licensing, confidentiality, data security, accessibility, indemnification, insurance, warranties, service levels, termination, governing law, audit rights, and records requirements. Coordinates legal, risk, information security, accessibility, and department review as appropriate.
* Interprets and explains College procurement policies, procedures, competitive requirements, documentation standards, delegated authority, and applicable grant or funding restrictions to departments and suppliers.
* Evaluates and uses cooperative purchasing contracts, including Arizona and national cooperative agreements, when the procurement method is authorized, the scope supports the requirement, pricing is fair and reasonable, and contract terms align with College needs and applicable law.
* Monitors contract milestones, renewals, pricing, deliverables, supplier compliance, and available remedies. Supports departments in resolving product deficiencies, service failures, billing discrepancies, software performance issues, and delivery, installation, or warranty disputes.
* Analyzes purchase requisitions, quotes, supporting documentation, and proposed purchasing methods for compliance, completeness, funding alignment, and operational readiness before commitment of College funds.

3. Customer Service and Internal Advisory Support (20%)
  

* Partners with academic, Information Technology, Facilities, Marketing, Finance, and other departments early in project planning to establish procurement strategies, realistic schedules, evaluation methods, implementation milestones, and contract administration responsibilities.
* Advises departments in developing clear, competitive, and outcome-based specifications, scopes of work, service levels, acceptance criteria, supplier qualifications, pricing schedules, and evaluation criteria.
* Explains procurement options and requirements in a practical, service-oriented manner while maintaining fairness, transparency, confidentiality, and consistent treatment of suppliers.
* Uses College financial, e-procurement, electronic signature, and contract management systems to process and track requisitions, purchase orders, solicitations, agreements, renewals, and supplier performance information.
* Develops and delivers procurement guidance, templates, checklists, desk procedures, and training materials for College employees and evaluation committee members.

4. Records, Reporting, and Other Duties (10%)
  

* Maintains complete, organized, and auditable procurement and contract files in accordance with College procedures, public records requirements, applicable records retention schedules, and grant documentation requirements.
* Maintains solicitation and contract templates, standard forms, cooperative contract documentation, supplier records, and assigned procurement procedures.
* Compiles procurement activity, savings, cycle time, competition, contract status, supplier performance, and compliance information for management reporting and continuous improvement.
* Participates in supplier outreach, training, professional development, site walks, equipment inspections, and cross-functional College initiatives.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.

**Minimum Expectations & Requirements**
---------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Associate degree from a regionally accredited institution in business administration, public administration, supply chain management, finance, information technology, or a closely related field.

**Experience:**

* Three years of progressively responsible experience in Arizona public procurement, with demonstrated experience applying Arizona public-sector procurement requirements, including purchasing, sourcing, competitive solicitations, contracting, or closely related activities.

* Experience developing or administering informal or formal competitive procurements, including specifications or scopes of work, supplier communications, quote or proposal analysis, and award documentation.
* Working knowledge of purchasing cycles, including requisition review, competitive sourcing, purchase order issuance, receiving, contract administration, and invoice resolution.
* An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential duties of the position may be considered.

  
**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to analyze detailed technical and commercial information, organize multiple procurements and deadlines, and produce clear, accurate, and defensible written work.

* Public procurement principles and practices, including competition, ethics, transparency, specifications, evaluation, negotiation, award, contract administration, sole-source justification, emergency procurement, cooperative purchasing, and documentation of fair and reasonable pricing.
* General understanding of Arizona public procurement practices, College purchasing policies, public records obligations, and federal requirements applicable to federally funded purchases.
* Commercial and operational considerations associated with SaaS licensing, cloud hosting, data security, accessibility, implementation, integrations, service levels, renewals, and software support.
* Equipment procurement considerations such as delivery, installation, utilities, site readiness, training, safety, warranty, maintenance, acceptance testing, and total cost of ownership.
* Professional services procurement considerations such as deliverables, approval rights, intellectual property, media usage, performance measures, fee structures, change control, and schedule management.
* Ability to interpret policies and contract terms; identify risks; develop practical options; and elevate legal, security, accessibility, safety, funding, or operational concerns to the appropriate reviewer.
* Ability to communicate effectively and diplomatically in writing and verbally with employees, suppliers, evaluation committee members, technical personnel, and leadership.
* Ability to negotiate favorable and balanced business terms while preserving integrity, fairness, confidentiality, and public accountability.
* Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain accurate records in a high-volume service environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications and the ability to learn College financial, procurement, contract management, and records systems.
* Demonstrates the ability to appropriately use artificial intelligence (AI) and other emerging technologies to support job responsibilities, improve efficiency, and enhance the quality of work. Uses AI tools responsibly and in accordance with College policies, data privacy, security, confidentiality, and applicable legal and ethical requirements. Exercises professional judgment when reviewing and using AI-generated information.

**Preferred Skills & Abilities**
--------------------------------

**Experience:**

* Experience procuring or administering contracts for IT hardware, enterprise software, SaaS or cloud solutions, industrial or skilled-trades equipment, and marketing and creative services.

* Professional experience in an Arizona community college, public university, school district, municipality, state agency, or other public-sector environment.
* Experience with Ellucian Banner or a comparable enterprise resource planning system and with electronic procurement, solicitation, signature, or contract lifecycle management systems.
* Experience with ESM Procurement, Sourcing and Supplier modules, or similar procurement systems preferably within an Ellucian Banner environment.

Be part of something bigger at Minaris — where every role contributes to creating hope for patients around the world. As a global leader in cell and gene therapy development, manufacturing, and testing, we turn breakthrough science into real-world treatments that change lives. Our team of over 1,000 experts across North America, Europe, and Asia has helped bring transformative therapies to market.
  
  
At Minaris, you’ll join a purpose-driven community focused on innovation, collaboration, and patient impact. Whether you’re in the lab, in the cleanroom, or behind the scenes, your work will directly support life-saving therapies and make a lasting difference. If you're passionate about advancing cutting-edge science and believe in the potential of cell and gene therapies, we invite you to help shape the future of medicine—one patient at a time.
  
  
Position Summary
  
The Downstream Process Development Associate Scientist will support viral vector process development activities, including process optimization, scale-up, technology transfer to manufacturing, and on-the-floor production support. This role is responsible for integrating downstream process development with analytical evaluation to ensure robust, scalable, and high-quality viral vector manufacturing processes.
  
The successful candidate will possess strong written and verbal communication skills and will actively contribute to technical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, technical training, report generation, and GMP-compliant documentation. The individual will play a key role in supporting process development, manufacturing readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  
Essential Functions and Responsibilities
  

* Contribute to design and independently execute experiments with supervision to improve recovery, consistency and robustness.
* Support development and troubleshooting of analytical methods as needed.
* Coordinate and interpret analytical testing to generate reports and present in client meetings.
* Support technology transfer activities to manufacturing and provide floor support during GMP runs.
* Maintain accurate and organized experimental records.
* Regular and reliable attendance on a full-time basis.
* Responsible for exhibiting professional behavior with both internal and external business associates that reflects positively on the company and is consistent with the company’s policies and practices.
* Embodies Minaris Advanced Therapies values and aligns daily actions with department and company culture.
* Other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills & Ability
  

* Demonstrated hands-on experience with downstream processing operations, including chromatography, clarification, tangential flow filtration (TFF), viral filtration, and fill/finish activities.
* Strong attention to details with a demonstrated eagerness to learn and apply new techniques and technologies.
* Motivated to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced, and rapidly growing environment while effectively managing multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated critical thinking, innovation, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical challenges.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong organizational, planning, and documentation capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively within cross-functional teams.

Education & Experience
  

* Master or Bachelors’ degree with major in Biological or Chemical Engineering, Biological Sciences or other science-related major.

o 2-5 years of relevant experience with a Bachelors’ degree.
  
o 0-3 years of relevant experience with a Masters’ degree.
  

* Experience working in GLP and/or GMP environments, particularly with viral vector process development is highly desirable.

Quality Requirements
  

* Ensure compliance with all FDA and Worldwide Quality & Compliance regulations in all aspects of your work.
* Adhere to established procedures and protocols, prioritize continuous training and skill development, and uphold the highest standards of data integrity to ensure accuracy, compliance, and operational excellence.

Working Environment

If changes are needed, partner with HR.

Off-shift, weekend and overtime duties may be required. While performing the job duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use English written and oral communication skills.
